articles.title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
articles.content: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.

articles.title_zh: Honeycomb-Surfels:为高效场景渲染和重建而压缩六边形基质
articles.content_zh: 小说取景合成和3D重建随着光场和浮出水面而迅速推进,然而它们的内存和计算需求限制了它们在受资源限制的环境下的使用. 我们介绍Hexels:新颖的平面六角形元素,具有一阶的空间色场,用于高效的3D场景和2D图像表现. 海克塞尔人利用当地平原地区,其外观相差不一,使用较少,较大的原始人. 它们的六边形支持提供了具有面积和边界效率的域,而局部色域捕捉到每个原始内部的外观变化. 在34个场景中,Hexels将PSNR比内存匹配的2DGS改进为4.53-7.38 dB跨数据集,同时需要更低的培训VRAM. 我们通过显示每个原始的Hexels在使用更低的训练VRAM和2.31倍快的FPS的同时,超过2DGS的功率,达到4.74分贝. 即使在不受限制的环境下,Hexels也提供互补的质量-模拟取舍. 为了高效地进行三维地表重建,Hexels将出错减少28.9%,而存储相匹配的2DGS则通过15个DTU扫描. 在6个坦克和坦普尔斯地表场景上,赫克塞尔斯在相较方法中实现了最高的平分F1(34.38%,而2DGS为31.72%). 我们还进一步表明,Hexels作为一个一般的原始人,在Image-GS之上改进了2D图像代表. 海克塞尔斯将帕雷托边疆推向地表相通原始人的质量效率取舍.

articles.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 思考世界:世界想象强化动能链
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型在机器人操控上取得了实质性进展,但其通俗化仍受行动标志机器人演示的多样性和覆盖面所制约. 人类视频提供了更广泛的行为和环境经验,而从中学习则面临可扩展数据和明确行动地面之间的根本取舍。 我们提出思维世界(ThinkWorld),这是一个VLA学习框架,它为世界动态中的行动推理提供依据,并通过用世界想象力强化学习来加强它. ThinkWorld代表每个动作思维作为"动能链"(CoD),是一系列离散运动符号,能捕捉连接当今世界与未来状态的中间动态,并充当跨表现体的共同动作代表. 我们首先以行动标注的演示初始化CoD,然后预测每个CoD所引出的未来,并强化那些预测更能与所观察到的结果相匹配的人. 这使得没有动作说明的视频能够提供从被观测到的状态过渡的直接监督,使人类和机器人的经验能够完善相同的推理空间. 模拟实验和在真机器人上进行的实验,展示了有效的人对机器人的转移和对看不见的任务和环境的强烈概括.

articles.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
articles.content: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Discrete Tokens能否作为视觉信号的无意识地表达?
articles.content_zh: 分明的视觉符号以类似于语言的离散形式代表了视觉,在共同的下个预测目标下为多式联运模型提供了本土界面。 然而,大量认为量化错误会造成不可避免的语义损失,从根本上限制了离散视觉符号的语义忠诚性,并将连续视觉表现定位为内在的上界. 使用多模式理解作为语义忠诚的代名词,我们重新审视这一假设,发现量化错误不可靠,因为有大得多错误的离散表达可以实现更好的理解. 相反,离散指数的有效比特预算是下游业绩的一个关键决定因素。 然而,现有的四分解器最终会饱和,因为额外的编码本会逐渐减少语义信息. 作为缓解这种饱和性的一种方法,我们引入了因果化的矢量分量法,它用对称并列的密码本来将视觉特征的互补的,固定维度的视角进行量化. 它在更大位预算方面继续改进,最终与多式联运中持续的视觉表现相匹配。 在工业规模的多模式数据培训方面,我们的模型在离散代表模型中取得了最先进的业绩,在9度平均比UniAR和Emu3-Chat分别高出22.8%和59.2%。 据我们所知,这也是第一个独立代表模式,具有强大的连续代表模式,如Qune3-VL,包括精细的OCR任务。 我们进一步确定了促进这种竞争力的关键原则和实际办法。 这些成果和见解支持了分散的视觉表现支持大规模本土多模式基础模型的潜力。 守则和模型见https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ。

articles.title: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Cross-View Temporal Object Correspondence
articles.content: Cross-view object correspondence identifies the same object across views. However, existing methods often rely on frame-wise matching or sequential tracking, which can propagate correspondence errors under appearance changes or occlusions. Therefore, we introduce cross-view temporal object correspondence, which requires preserving object identity across both views and time from a query mask. To address this, we propose XTrack, a unified framework which repurposes a pretrained video DiT with semantic and spatiotemporal priors for RGB-to-mask latent transport, jointly modeling cross-view matching and temporal tracking. However, naive video DiTs do not guarantee accurate cross-view grounding and often attend to semantically similar yet incorrect objects across views. Thus, we introduce focal cross-view attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crop strategies to ensure reliable grounding. Finally, beyond these architectural enhancements, we also tackle the lack of dense annotation by introducing a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse Ego-Exo4D annotations into dense supervision to enable effective video-level training. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of XTrack as a unified framework, ensuring robust temporal consistency and identity preservation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重用跨视频时间对象通信的视频传播变换器
articles.content_zh: 交叉视图对象通信在视图中识别出相同的对象. 然而,现有的方法往往依赖于相框匹配或相继跟踪,这种跟踪可以在外观变化或被占用的情况下传播函证错误. 因此,我们引入了交叉视图时间对象通信,这需要从一个查询口罩中保留整个视图和时间的物体身份. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出XTrack,一个统一框架,它重新使用一个预先训练的视频DiT,其中包含语义学和spatiotemporal前科,用于RGB到面具潜在传输,联合建模交叉视图匹配和时间跟踪. 然而,天真视频DiTs并不能保证准确的交叉取景定位,而且往往会关注各种观点中类似但不正确的物体。 因此,我们引入了焦点交叉视野的注意力协调、硬性负面条件和当地的作物战略,以确保可靠的地基。 最后,除了这些建筑改进外,我们还通过引入一个假标签校正管道来解决缺乏密集注释的问题,该管道将稀疏的"Ego-Exo4D"注释转换为密集的监理,以便能够进行有效的视频级培训. 我们的结果显示了XTrack作为一个统一框架的有效性,确保了强有力的时间一致性和身份保护.

articles.title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
articles.content: Visual generation requires both high-level semantic knowledge and fine-grained pixel details. We propose a learning paradigm that assigns these roles to autoregressive pretraining for knowledge acquisition and diffusion post-training for high-fidelity rendering. Within this framework, we study the objective, representation, and scaling of knowledge acquisition and rendering. Controlled comparisons identify autoregression as the stronger pretraining objective for downstream rendering, improving both learning efficiency and final generation quality. We further find that AR-only generation quality does not necessarily correlate with final performance; semantic quality matters more. This motivates a purely semantic tokenizer trained with language supervision alone, without an image decoder or reconstruction loss. We establish compute-optimal scaling laws for knowledge acquisition and rendering, and find that autoregressive pretraining lowers the fitted asymptotic rendering loss compared with pixel diffusion models trained from scratch. Guided by the laws, we train a 3B-parameter text-to-image model with only 6,600 H100 GPU-hours, achieving 86 on GenEval and 87 on DPG-Bench and validating the proposed paradigm at scale.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 知道,然后画出:视觉一代的新学习范式
articles.content_zh: 视觉生成既需要高级语义知识,也需要精细的像素细节. 我们提出了一个学习范式,赋予这些角色自发地进行获取知识的先行培训,并传播后行培训以进行高可靠性的渲染。 在这个框架内,我们研究获取和提供知识的目标、代表性和规模。 受控比较确定自旋是下游渲染的更强大的前期训练目标,既能提高学习效率和最终生成质量. 我们还发现,只使用AR的生成质量不一定与最终性能有关;语义质量更重要。 这激发了一个纯粹的语义活化器,仅靠语言监督而训练,没有图像解码器或重建损失. 我们为获取和渲染知识制定了计算-优化的缩放定律,并发现自回向预训比从零开始训练的像素传播模型降低了安装的不对称渲染损失. 在法律的指导下,我们培训了一个3B参数的文本到图像模型,只有6,600个H100 GPU小时,在GenEval上实现了86个,在DPG-Bench上实现了87个,并大规模验证了拟议的范式.

articles.title: Perceiving and Predicting Dynamic Sports: Spatiotemporal Intelligence in Vision Models for Egocentric Tennis Video
articles.content: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. Yet it remains unclear how well foundation vision models support these capabilities, particularly from a moving egocentric camera, which is a natural view for robots. To investigate this, we collect an annotated tennis dataset and train a suite of vision models on spatiotemporal tasks. Our dataset contains egocentric video synchronized with five allocentric videos, estimated global positions, labeled contact times, and annotated stroke types. We then evaluate seven prediction tasks from egocentric images: 2D ego player and 3D ball localization, future player and ball trajectories, forehand or backhand stroke anticipation, time to the next ego player ball contact, and 3D ball position at that contact. We compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models with jointly trained prediction heads. The best performing models achieve mean current-frame localization errors of 0.14 m for the ego player and 0.54 m for the ball, future forecasting errors of 0.34 m for the ego player and 0.91 m for the ball over 1.1 s, and a mean contact-time prediction error of 0.14 s. Auxiliary depth information substantially improves 3D ball localization, suggesting that inferring metric depth remains a challenge. Longer image histories do not improve ball forecasting, indicating that representations exploit scene context rather than rely solely on inter-frame motion. Finally, we propose a conditional diffusion model to generate whole-body kinematic tennis motion from vision encoder predictions on egocentric video at real-time rates, adapting movements as predictions are refined. These results move towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support real-time dynamic robots using egocentric video.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 感知和预测动态体育:Egocentral Tennis视频的视觉模型中的 Spatiotemporal Intelligence
articles.content_zh: 敏捷的机器人需要spatiotemporal智能来解释场景,互动的原因,以及预测未来的事件. 然而,仍然不清楚基础视觉模型在多大程度上支持了这些能力,特别是从一个动人的以自负为中心的相机,这是机器人的自然视野. 为了调查这一点,我们收集了一个注解的网球数据集,并培训一套关于瞬间任务的视觉模型。 我们的数据集包含以自我为中心的视频, 与五部以全方位为主的视频同步, 然后我们从以自我为中心的图像来评价7个预测任务: 二维自负球手和 三维自负球本地化, 未来的自负球手和球轨迹, 前手或后手中风预测, 时间到下一个自负球手球接触, 3D自负球在那个接触的位置。 我们比较图像编码器,视频编码器, 和视觉语言模型 与联合训练的预测头。 表现最好的模型实现的平均值为自负球员0.14米和球员0.54米的当前帧本地化误差,自负球员未来的预测误差为0.34米和球员超过1.1 s的0.91米,平均接触时间预测误差为0.14 s. 辅助深度信息大大地改善了3D球本地化,表明推断出公制深度仍然是一个挑战. 更长的图像历史并不能改善球的预测,表明表现会利用场景背景,而不是仅仅依靠帧间运动. 最后,我们提出一个有条件的传播模型,从视觉编码器的预测中产生全身运动网球运动,以实时的速度对以自我为中心的视频进行预测,随着预测的完善而适应运动. 这些结果逐渐更深入地理解了基础视觉模型如何利用以自负为中心的视频支持实时动态机器人.

articles.title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
articles.content: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VideoLVR:地下视频证据后期视觉原因
articles.content_zh: 思维链推理在多式大语言模型(MLLMs)的视频理解上有很大的进步. 然而,基于语言的推理痕迹并不能为模型重新审视相关视觉证据提供可靠机制,导致视觉遗忘并损害其通过视频内容进行推理的能力. 现有方法在推理时主要以两种方式维持视觉地基:要么是指使用文字坐标的证据,该坐标指定了象征性位置,而不是视觉内容本身;要么将被裁剪的区域或框架重新插入多模式上下文,以大幅扩展上下文为代价保留视觉细节。 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了VideoLVR,它构建了相关视频瞬间来自当地地区的潜在视觉证据,从而为中间推理步骤提供视觉支持. 为了监督潜在视觉证据的生成,我们引入了一个视觉符号预测目标,将视觉符号重建设定为对输入视频产生的词汇的预测,从而将视觉证据重建与文本生成统一在同一同物预测框架内. 这个共享的预测框架使 MLLMs 能够通过互放的文本符号和潜在视觉状态进行推理,同时整合不同时刻的证据. 我们进一步将VideoLVR扩展为强化学习,将被抽样的视觉标志与文本标志一起作为行动,并利用最终的答案奖励共同优化政策。 通过在推理过程中高效地重新审视与任务相关的视觉信息,VideoLVR可以改善视频理解,而不会大幅度地扩展多模式背景. 对多段视频基准的实验显示了其有效性,特别是在需要精细图像证据的任务方面.

articles.title: MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
articles.content: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. However, existing benchmarks provide limited guidance on identifying capability gaps between on-device models and server-side models. We introduce MoI-Bench, a benchmark grounded in mobile user needs, comprising 64 subtasks and 1150 samples. It defines 16 operations, such as removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories covering content such as portraits and text. These form two orthogonal axes whose applicable combinations define specific tasks, such as removing facial makeup. To better guide model improvement, we further propose MoI-Eval, which introduces task-specific criteria covering instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation. We further construct sample-level evaluation questions and aggregate their scores into overall quality and capability profiles along the operation, target and criteria axes. We evaluate representative on-device and server-side models and measure mobile deployment costs. Results show that this decoupled Operation x Target design provides finer-grained guidance for improving compact models. For example, it highlights the need to prioritize specific capability gaps (e.g., text-replacement) over broad application-level goals (e.g., improving text editing). Unlike conventional benchmarks that rank models using a single score, we introduce a two-dimensional Quality-Deployability capability map to assess models for practical mobile use. The map shows that current on-device models can achieve efficient generation or editing but expanding their task coverage deserves greater attention than further improving deployment efficiency. Further progress requires improving editing quality, particularly identity preservation and text rendering, while broadening task coverage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MoI- Bench:移动设备图像生成和编辑基准
articles.content_zh: 开发在线图像模型需要考虑实际用户需求,任务类型以及设备资源限制. 然而,现有基准在查明安装设备模型和服务器侧模型之间能力差距方面提供了有限的指导。 我们介绍了MoI-Bench,这是基于移动用户需求的基准,由64个子任务和1150个样本组成. 它定义了去除和替换等16个操作,并定义了涵盖肖像和文字等内容的8个视觉目标类别. 这些组成了两个正交轴,其适用的组合定义了具体的任务,例如去除面部化妆. 为了更好地指导模型的改进,我们进一步提出MOI-Eval,它引入了针对特定任务的标准,包括后续指令,视觉质量和细节保存. 我们进一步构建抽样评价问题,并沿业务、目标和标准轴将其分数汇总为总体质量和能力概况。 我们评价具有代表性的安装模型和服务器侧模型,并衡量移动部署费用。 结果表明,这种脱钩行动x目标设计为改进紧凑模型提供了更精细的指导. 例如,它强调需要将具体能力差距(如文本替换)放在广泛的应用层面目标(如改进文本编辑)之上。 与使用一分制对模型进行排序的常规基准不同,我们引入了二维质量-可部署性能力图,以评估模型用于实际移动使用. 地图显示,目前的设备模型可以实现高效的生成或编辑,但扩大其任务范围比进一步提高部署效率更值得注意。 要取得进一步进展,就必须提高编辑质量,特别是身份保存和文本制作,同时扩大任务范围。

articles.title: Zero-Shot Multimodal Event Spotting in Soccer Broadcasts
articles.content: Automatic soccer event spotting supports highlight generation, video indexing, and sports analytics, but existing methods depend on large annotated datasets and soccer-specific training. We present a zero-shot framework that detects, classifies, and temporally localizes events in full-length soccer broadcasts without task-specific parameter training. Each match is segmented into overlapping clips represented by a compact visual storyboard and the aligned commentary transcript, which a general-purpose multimodal model processes jointly. On three manually annotated matches containing 130 events, the best configuration achieves 72.0% F1@5s and outperforms SoccerNet-trained CALF and NetVLAD++ in a cross-dataset setting, while the storyboard representation reduces inference cost by 72% compared with individual frames. We further analyze the effects of model family, input representation, and prompt optimization, and introduce an evidence-grounded excitement-scoring stage that ranks detected events with natural-language explanations for highlight selection.

articles.title: As the Story Unfolds: Watching a Film and Identifying Characters as a Human Does
articles.content: Films introduce characters incrementally as they progress. We study the problem of identifying principal characters and assigning their names directly from the movie itself, without using external cast lists, actor photographs, or pre-built character banks. We introduce the character naming task: given a name mentioned in dialogue and the associated video context, the model must determine which visible character bears that name. This task is challenging because name resolution often depends on cinematic cues such as shot-reverse-shot structure, self-introduction, direct address, third-party reference, gaze, and temporal continuity. We provide a dataset and annotations for evaluating character naming and first character appearances, develop a video-and-dialogue model for the task, and compare it with proprietary multimodal large language models. We further introduce a progressive framework for building a character bank as the film unfolds. Together, these contributions support online, human-like movie understanding in which character identities are inferred from the film itself.

articles.title_zh: 作为"故事"的"不折不扣":观看一部电影并识别人物为"人类做"

articles.title: The Noise Plane: A Diffusion Bridge Across Exponent and Dispersion
articles.content: Diffusion-based denoising commonly uses Gaussian perturbations, whereas sensor noise follows diverse signal-dependent statistical laws. In this paper, we propose $p$-Bridge, a unified measurement-indexed diffusion framework for Tweedie noise. The noise exponent $p$ describes the variance--intensity relation, while accumulated measurement $ν$ controls the noise level. Together, they define a noise plane that includes Gaussian, Poisson, and Gamma models. The stochastic bridge connects measurement distributions through independent increments, giving denoising a physical interpretation as progressive measurement accumulation. Both the starting and stopping indices can be specified, allowing restoration from an observed measurement level to a prescribed higher level. Measurement superposition yields a shared reverse-mean update, paired with a deviance-based objective for learning the required conditional mean. A latent compound Poisson--Gamma construction enables sampling at intermediate exponents. A single exponent-conditioned network adapts to different Tweedie noise models without separate training for each exponent. Experiments show that exponent conditioning improves cross-exponent robustness over fixed-exponent models. Using estimated exponents, the shared network achieves robustness comparable to an oracle-selected set of five specialist models. Experiments on synthetic images, FMD fluorescence microscopy, and multi-sensor SAR images further demonstrate its effectiveness across different signal-dependent noise regimes.

articles.title: ReferStream: Interactive Subject Injection for Streaming Video Generation
articles.content: Injecting new subjects naturally during streaming video generation requires integrating newly supplied visual references into the existing video while preserving established subjects and the scene. Encoding references independently of the current scene provides little guidance for this integration, while keeping their features in persistent memory can interfere with established context. We propose ReferStream, a framework that requires no additional training and combines reference construction using the current scene with transient cache injection. Joint Latent places reference latents in target regions of the latest scene latent, allowing reference features to be extracted in context. Cache Restoration uses these features to condition the injection chunk, then restores the overwritten global cache entries while retaining the newly generated history. This procedure incorporates new visual conditions without retraining the generator or revising emitted frames. We further introduce ReferStream Bench, a new benchmark with scheduled reference arrivals, evolving instructions, and explicit annotations of subject presence for InShot and MultiShot generation. Evaluation follows the event schedule and measures both the fidelity of new subjects and the preservation of established subjects, alongside video quality, text adherence, and count accuracy. Experiments on ReferStream Bench show higher scores for text adherence, subject similarity, and count accuracy than the compared baselines, including offline methods given all references in advance. Project page: https://xushuolin.github.io/ReferStream/.

articles.title: GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
articles.content: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction, and only relies on posed street and satellite views. Our experiments on outdoor datasets show that our model is better than both satellite-conditioned or street-view conditioned baselines on novel-view synthesis, especially on challenging cases where target views have very little overlap with source views. articles.title: A note on data-efficient finetuning of vision foundation models
articles.content: Adapting foundation models to a new task within or beyond the training domain is the de facto standard for building specialized machine learning models. Recently, Visual Prompting (VP) has emerged as a promising technique for efficient knowledge transfer. As new foundation model families~(like Mamba) get introduced and VP pipelines such as AutoVP reach greater maturity, we find a growing need for a systematic evaluation of current approaches. In this work, we assess the performance of the latest models, comparing them to earlier architectures and alternative fine-tuning methods, to better understand the progress, challenges and opportunities in the field of efficient fine-tuning under resource limitations. Towards this goal, this paper provides a concise empirical overview of the interactions among foundation model families (Attention-, Convolution-, and Mamba-based) and transfer paradigms: VP, Linear Probing (LP), Full Fine-tuning (FFT) and Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our work builds up on previous findings by broadening the selection of evaluated models and techniques while tuning hyperparameters. In the interest of delivering practical guidelines for the user, we also explore application of prevalent regularization techniques to boost performance in the context of VP.

articles.title_zh: 关于对愿景基础模型进行数据效率微调的说明
articles.content_zh: 使基础模型适应培训领域内外的新任务是建立专门机器学习模型的实际标准。 最近,视觉刺激已成为高效知识转让的一种有希望的技术。 随着新的基建模式家庭被引入-(如曼巴),以及诸如AutoVP等VP管道的更成熟,我们发现越来越需要系统地评价目前的方法。 在这项工作中,我们评估了最新模型的性能,将其与早期的架构和替代的微调方法相比较,以更好地理解在资源限制下有效微调领域的进展、挑战和机遇。 为实现这一目标,本文件简明扼要地总结了基础模式家庭(以 " 留守 " 、 " 革命 " 和 " 曼巴 " 为基础)与转移模式之间的相互作用:VP、Linear Probing(LP)、Full Fine-t(FFT)和Low Rank Aditation(LORA)。 我们的工作以以前的调查结果为基础,在调整超参数的同时,扩大了评估模型和技术的选择范围。 为了向用户提供实用指南,我们还探索应用了普遍的规范化技术来提升在VP背景下的性能.

articles.title: ALADDIN: Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping
articles.content: Face swapping transfers a source identity onto a target image while preserving the target's pose, expression, hair, and lighting. The most realistic current methods are diffusion-based, but they need many network evaluations per image. GAN-based methods are fast, yet trained from scratch they must learn realism from the adversarial signal alone and produce visibly weaker results. We present ALADDIN (Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping), a one-step face swapper obtained by initialising the generator from a pre-trained multi-step flow-matching model and training it adversarially under identity and target-preservation constraints. We expose a controllable trade-off between identity transfer and target-attribute preservation by training a student model with triplet pseudo-label supervision. We additionally identify a bias in the standard evaluation protocol, which favours methods trained against the same identity encoder used to score them, and re-evaluate all baselines with an independent one. ALADDIN is state-of-the-art among one-step methods in realism and target preservation at comparable identity transfer, and matches the best multi-step model with 28 times fewer network evaluations and an order of magnitude fewer training pairs.

articles.title_zh: ALADDIN:用于一阶身份洗刷的逆源扩散分化
articles.content_zh: 面相相互换将源身份传递到目标图像上,同时保留目标姿势,表情,发型和照明. 目前最现实的方法都是以传播为基础的,但是每个图像都需要许多网络评价. 以全球网络为基础的方法很快,但从零开始训练,它们必须仅从对抗信号中学习现实主义,并产生明显较弱的结果。 我们提出ALADDIN(Aversarial Lententnt Difusion Distillation for One-Step Independence Swapping),这是通过从预先训练的多步相容模型初始化发电机并在身份和目标保护限制下进行对抗性训练而获得的一步相容交换机. 我们通过培训三重假标签监督的学生模型,在身份转移和目标属性保存之间暴露出可控的取舍. 此外,我们还发现标准评价协议中存在偏差,它倾向于使用同一身份编码器对经过培训的方法进行评级,并用独立的编码重新评价所有基线。 ALADDIN是现实主义中最先进的一步方法,在可比较的身份传递时是目标保存,并且与最佳多步模式相匹配,网络评价减少28倍,培训对等数量级也减少.

articles.title: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
articles.content: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop a strong population-shared pattern. We recommend reporting scan-rescan reliability together with a permutation-null control, rather than within-session proxies alone, to avoid overstating individual specificity.

articles.title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
articles.content: Fine-grained visual perception remains a bottleneck during post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as perceptual errors can constrain gains from reasoning-focused optimization. Although image-caption pre-training improves perception, its influence can weaken as subsequent stages change data mixtures and objectives. Continuing caption supervision during post-training is challenging because subjective, information-dense descriptions complicate verifiable reward design. We present PerceptRL, which strengthens perception at two complementary levels. Perception RL uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract verified errors from dense image captions and convert the corresponding visual facts into QA pairs with fixed answer labels and rule-based rewards. Chain QA links correlated errors, while multiple-choice QA combines unrelated errors. A specialized route targets high-error domains with tailored verification, and a domain-agnostic general route covers errors beyond these domains. Perception Agentic RL addresses fine-grained and dense cases unresolved by single-turn Perception RL through multi-turn inspection with visual tools. We observe coordinate drift even in models trained to use tools, where incorrect crops or annotations distort evidence and propagate errors. Coordinate Injection corrects spatial operations in cold-start trajectories, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate spatial fidelity alongside final-answer correctness. Training proceeds through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL. Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL achieves 71.6% average accuracy, surpassing the base model with the same tools and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 15.7 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively.

articles.title_zh: 感受RL:使视觉感受在MLLMs中从回答到交互可得到回报
articles.content_zh: 在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的后期培训中,精细的视觉感知仍然是一个瓶颈,因为知觉错误会限制从注重推理的优化中获得的收益. 虽然图像封装前训练会提高知觉,但其影响会随着后续阶段改变数据混合物和目标而减弱. 培训后继续进行字幕监督具有挑战性,因为主观、信息密集的描述使可核查的奖励设计复杂化。 我们提出 " 认知 " (PerceptRL),它加强了两个互补层面的认识。 Perception RL使用多代理管道从密集的图像标题中提取已核实的错误,并用固定的答案标签和以规则为基础的奖励将相应的视觉事实转换为QA对. 链式QA链接关联出错,而多选择QA结合了无关出错. 一个专门的路由以高error域为目标,并有定制的验证,一个域不可知的一般路由覆盖了这些域以外的出错. 感知Agentic RL通过有视觉工具的多回转检查,解决了被单回转Peption RL所未解决的精细而密集的案件. 我们观测到坐标漂移,即使是在受过使用工具训练的模型中,错误的作物或说明扭曲了证据并传播了错误。 坐标注入会纠正冷起动轨迹中的空间操作,而地心意识过程的奖励则会监督中间空间忠诚度与最终答案正确性. 训练通过共享冷起动SFT,单回合感知RL和多回合感知Agentic RL来进行. 在共享工具使用协议下的7个基准中,PerceptRL平均精确度达到71.6%,以相同的工具超越了基准模型,并分别以15.7%和5.2个百分点最强的边疆VLM得到评价.

articles.title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
articles.content: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代表"幽灵":反思视觉想象空间理性
articles.content_zh: 视觉世界模型通过产生未被观测国家的RGB观点,日益支持空间推理. 然而,RGB成为了默认接口,主要是因为它非常适合视觉生成,而不一定是下游推理最有效的代表. 不同的空间问题可能得益于同一想象状态的不同表现:自上而下几何可以促进全球相距比较,而全景观则为开阔空间的推理提供了更广泛的背景. 为了孤立在空间想象中代表的作用,我们引入了ImagiRep,一个由922个问题组成的模拟基准,涵盖7个问题类型,涉及两个设置,即 Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Institution,提供oracle RGB和6个没有观测状态的替代代表(如深度,全景,自上而下几何等). 这种有控制的比较揭示出,即使准确的想象中的RGB也不能保证准确的空间推理,不同的问题也从不同的表述中受益. 由世界模型估计的国家得出的表述也呈现出类似趋势。 值得注意的是,仅靠估计的RGB就可能误导空间推理,而替代表述保留了互补的好处。 基于这些发现,我们引入了GEARS, 一种轻量级测试时间策略,用于适应性表现选择, 优于现有空间想象方法, 并显示对不可见状态的推理 需要的不仅仅是产生RGB的观点。

articles.title: Segmentation Confidence for Arbitrary CNNs
articles.content: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are widely used for medical image segmentation. However, they lack an inherent measure of confidence. Existing methods for estimating prediction uncertainty often require a custom network architecture and/or dedicated training setups and need to be trained from scratch. In addition, the deduction of a single confidence score per input from the uncertainty maps is not always straightforward. In this study, we explore voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods that can be added to existing segmentation pipelines without training from scratch. We also propose a novel method to estimate a single confidence score from the uncertainty maps. Our evaluations on different ROIs and modalities suggest that our confidence score can predict segmentation performance in unseen data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 任意CNN的片断信心
articles.content_zh: 革命神经网络(CNN)被广泛用于医学影像分解. 然而,它们缺乏内在的信任。 估计不确定性的现有方法往往需要定制网络架构和(或)专门的培训设置,需要从零开始培训。 此外,从不确定性图中扣除每个输入的单一信任分并不总是直截了当的. 在这项研究中,我们探索了基于Voxel的不确定性估计方法,这些方法可以被添加到现有的分块管中而无需从零开始训练. 我们还提出一种新颖的方法,从不确定地图中估计出一个单一的置信分. 我们对不同区域办事处和模式的评价表明,我们的信心得分可以预测在无形数据中的分化性能。

articles.title: When Visual Evidence Is Insufficient: How Instructions, Post-Training, and Internal Activations Shape Refusal in Multimodal Language Models
articles.content: For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers. Yet refusal alone is not necessarily evidence of such recognition: models may refuse because of unrelated safety constraints or without identifying the missing evidence. We study how refusal on visually unanswerable questions is shaped by three sources of control: inference-time instructions, post-training, and internal activation interventions. Across three MLLMs on the MoHoBench benchmark, we systematically manipulate the meaning and placement of refusal instructions, compare supervised and preference-based post-training, and intervene on a refusal-related activation direction derived from naturally answered and refused examples. We find that refusal is highly sensitive to both the meaning and placement of instructions, with model-specific changes at the sample level that are obscured by aggregate refusal rates. Evidence-aware and general refusal instructions have stronger effects than an intentionally mismatched safety instruction. Post-training produces larger increases in refusal, but can also induce responses that combine refusal language with attempted answers. In contrast, activation intervention produces smaller yet transferable changes across prompt conditions, without evidence of indiscriminate refusal on tested visually answerable samples. These findings show that refusal is jointly shaped by external instructions, post-training, and internal representations, highlighting the need to disentangle evidence recognition from a model's learned propensity to refuse.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当视觉证据不足时:多种语文模式中的指示、培训后和内部活动形状如何拒绝
articles.content_zh: 对于可靠的部署,多式大语言模型(MLLMs)应当识别当一个图像提供不充分的证据来回答一个问题并扣取不支持的答案时. 然而,单是拒绝并不一定是这种承认的证据:模型可能因为无关的安全限制而拒绝,或者没有识别缺失的证据。 我们研究对视而不见问题的拒绝如何由三个控制来源决定:推断时间指示、培训后和内部激活干预。 在MoHo Bench基准上,我们通过三个MLLMs系统操纵拒绝指示的含义和位置,比较有监督的和基于优惠的后培训,并干预从自然回答和拒绝的例子中得出的与拒绝有关的激活方向。 我们发现,拒绝对指示的含义和位置都高度敏感,在样本一级有特定模式的变化,被总拒绝率所掩盖。 证据意识指示和一般拒绝指示的效力比故意不匹配的安全指示更强。 培训后产生更大的拒绝增加,但也可能诱发将拒绝语言与尝试答案相结合的反应. 相比之下,激活干预在快速条件下产生较小但可转移的变化,没有证据表明在经过测试的可视性可回答样品上不加区分地拒绝。 这些调查结果表明,拒绝是由外部指示、培训后和内部陈述共同形成的,这突出表明有必要将证据确认与模型所学的拒绝倾向分开。

articles.title: CTBakeGS: training-free baking of photorealistic CT volume renderings into 3D Gaussian splats
articles.content: Photorealistic volume rendering of computed tomography (CT) may convey anatomy intuitively, but it needs the CT data, dedicated software and a powerful graphics processor. Three-dimensional Gaussian splatting (3DGS) displays photorealistic scenes in real time on less powerful devices, but existing medical approaches train each scene for minutes to hours. We aimed to convert a CT volume rendering directly into a 3DGS model without training. Splats were placed on an adaptive octree of millimetre-sized cells. Their colour and opacity were computed on the graphics processor with the renderer's lighting, cell opacity was converted analytically into splat opacity, and faint splats were retained stochastically above the 1/255 opacity floor of standard 3DGS rasterisers. Six public CT scans (1.5-mm voxels) were converted with three transfer functions and compared with converged references by peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity and a learned perceptual metric. Two-million-splat models reached a PSNR of 32.6 +/- 0.9 dB for bone, 30.1 +/- 1.0 dB for contrast-enhanced vessels and 32.3 +/- 1.5 dB for skin and bone. A conversion pass (usually two or three per model) took 4-30 s on a current laptop and 9-60 s on a desktop with a 4-GB graphics card. On the laptop, the models rendered at 68 frames per second at 800 x 800 pixels. Training-free conversion produced real-time 3DGS models of photorealistic CT renderings in about a minute or less per conversion pass on ordinary computers, with fidelity that we consider sufficient for interactive viewing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CTBakeGS:将光现实化的CT卷渲染成3D高斯平板
articles.content_zh: 计算成像法(CT)的光现实化量渲染可以直观地传达解剖学,但它需要CT数据,专用软件和强大的图形处理器. 三维高斯克平板(3DGS)在不太强大的设备上实时显示光现实主义场景,但现有的医疗方法对每个场景进行数分钟到数小时的训练. 我们的目标是将一个CT卷直接渲染成3DGS模型而不经过训练. 将花板放入一个适应性小于大小的细胞。 在图形处理器上用渲染器的照明计算出它们的颜色和不透明性,从分析上将电池不透明性转换为平板不透明性,将微弱的平板保留在标准3DGS光栅的1/255不透明地上方。 6个公用CT扫描(1.5-mm voxels)被转换出有3个传输功能,并与以峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR),结构相近和一个有学识的知觉度量度来对比的引用. 200万平板模型的PSNR为:骨干32.6+/-0.9分贝,30.1分贝+/- 对比增强的器皿为1.0分贝,皮肤和骨骼为32.3分贝+/-1.5分贝. 转会通行证(通常每个型号为2到3个)用4-30 s来换取当前笔记本电脑,9-60 s来换取4-GB图形卡. 在笔记本电脑上,模型以每秒68帧,800x800像素提供. 无训练转换在每一次转换中大约一分钟或更短的时间内就产生了相片现实化CT渲染的实时3DGS模型被普通计算机传出,其忠诚性被我们认为足以进行互动取景.

articles.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
articles.content: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PDRVLA:具有物理动态表现的远景-语言-行动模型
articles.content_zh: Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模型从视觉观测和语言指令中生成机器人动作,但他们对物理动态的了解仍然有限. 视频世界模型可以捕捉到场景动态,而未来生成的视频将高潜入控制回路. 我们引入了PDRVLA,其轻量级物理动力模块从视觉语言特性中提取出物理符号,以条件生成动作而无需在线视频生成. 该模块通过直接预测未来的RGB,深度和光学流出特征来学习,并通过被冷冻的预训视频世界模型进行辅助监督. 培训完全依靠公开提供的数据,通过人对机器人的合成、子任务注释和体现的思想链注释加以扩展。 在四个模拟基准中,PDRVLA在LIBERO上的成功率为99.3%,在LIBERO-Plus上的成功率为89.9%,在RoboTwin~2.0上的成功率为93.6%,在SimmerEnv上的成功率为81.5%。 校对显示未来对世界模型监督的预测有所改进,并评估子任务配置、未来对对象的监管以及ECoT培训如何影响行动的成功。

articles.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
articles.content: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 嵌入Gemma2:统一而高效的多式联运代表
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍EmbeddingGemma 2,这是一种开放式的多模式嵌入模型,在本地代表文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合在一个统一的空间。 我们的方法提出了改进办法,如简化每个层次的嵌入方式和多阶段课程,其模式和客观进展确保单式、跨模式和混合模式评价的质量。 值得注意的是,在综合嵌入所有模式的基准中,EmbeddingGemma 2建立了一个新的Pareto前沿,在专家模型和模型方面都比专业模型和模型大2至12倍。 此外,我们的设计为资源受限的环境提供了灵活性,支持选择性模式编码器加载、可调整的视觉符号预算、可移动嵌入维度和量化权重。 我们提出分析关键决定的废墟,并释放EmbeddingGemma 2,以促进进一步研究。

articles.title: TimeLineXR: An Interactive Exploration of Time in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Recently, it has been shown that vision-language models (VLMs) have a certain intrinsic understanding of time. They can estimate the temporal origin of objects and encode time along a low-dimensional, non-linear manifold inside their embedding space~\cite{tekaya2025matter}. That result is quantitative and reproducible, but the structure itself stays out of reach for end users: they cannot see it, query it with their own images, or inspect where a query lands relative to other years on the time axis. We present TimeLineXR, an interactive demonstration that turns this time axis into an explorable 3D scene. A web demo lets users upload or select images and see each placed on a color-coded 3D time axis; a Three.js WebXR scene renders the same time axis as a room-scale representation that can be grabbed, scaled, inspected, and queried by throwing image cards into it. Both clients run the same prediction pipeline against the same cached temporal index: encode the query with CLIP, project it through cosine-kernel KPCA, and snap it to the Bézier time axis. The system turns each image into a point on the time axis, so users can compare where different objects land and read off their estimated first year of appearance.Code source and reproduction steps can be found in: https://github.com/sterngefeuert/timeline-xr.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TimeLineXR:远景-语言模型中对时间的互动探索
articles.content_zh: 最近,有迹象表明,视觉语言模型(VLMs)对时间有一定的内在理解. 它们可以估计物体的时间来源,并沿着其嵌入空间内的一个低维的非线性多倍体来编码时间__cite{tekaya2025matter}. 这种结果是定量的和可复制的,但结构本身对于终端用户来说是无法达到的:他们无法看到它,无法用自己的图像查询它,或者检查时间轴上相对于其他年份的查询位置. 我们介绍TimeLineXR,一个交互演示,将这个时间轴变成可扩展的3D场景. 一个web演示让用户上传或选择图像,并看到每个图像被放入一个有色码的3D时间轴;一个Tree.js WebXR场景使时间轴与一个可被抓取,缩放,检查,并通过将图像卡扔入其中来询问的房间比例代表制相同. 两个客户根据相同的缓存时间索引运行相同的预测管道:用 CLIP 编码查询,通过相弦内核 KPCA 进行投影,并按到贝塞尔时间轴上. 系统将每个图像转换为时间轴上的一个点,因此用户可以比较不同对象降落的地方并读取其估计的第一年外观. 代码来源和复制步骤见:https://github.com/sterngefeuert/timeline-xr.

articles.title: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
articles.content: Video captioning aims to preserve visual information through compact descriptions, predominantly using natural language. However, precisely expressing fine-grained spatial structures and temporal dynamics in natural language often leads to lengthy and potentially ambiguous descriptions. In this work, we explore Code as Video Caption, a paradigm where executable programs serve as a complementary representation of visual content through graphical primitives, layout rules, and functions of time. To examine whether code captions effectively preserve video information, we compare them with natural language captions on downstream question answering and video reconstruction tasks. Our results show that code captions achieve superior reasoning accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Despite these advantages, realizing the potential of code captioning depends on whether current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate faithful code captions. To systematically assess this capability, we introduce CodeCap-Bench, which comprises 323 videos spanning five categories of structured 2D content, along with fine-grained annotations and a multi-level evaluation framework. Extensive experiments reveal that while leading proprietary MLLMs demonstrate promising code captioning capabilities, they still struggle to faithfully capture complex temporal dynamics, with open-source models lagging substantially behind.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代码Cap-Bench:代码可以作为好视频字幕服务?.
articles.content_zh: 视频字幕旨在通过紧凑的描述来保存视觉信息,主要使用自然语言. 然而,在自然语言中精确地表达精细的空间结构和时间动态往往导致冗长而可能模糊的描述. 在这部作品中,我们探索代码作为Video Caption,一种范式,可执行程序通过图形原始,布局规则,以及时间的功能来作为视觉内容的补充表现. 为了检查代码标题是否有效保存了视频信息,我们把它们与下游问答和视频重建任务的自然语言标题进行比较. 我们的结果显示,代码标题 实现更高的推理精度 和重建忠诚。 尽管有这些优点,实现代码标题的潜力取决于目前的多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)能否产生忠实的代码标题. 为了系统地评估这一能力,我们引入了CodeCap-Bench,它包括323个视频,涵盖五类结构化的2D内容,以及精细的说明和多层次的评价框架。 广泛的实验显示,虽然领先的专有MLLMs展现出有希望的代码字幕能力,但它们仍然难以忠实地捕捉到复杂的时间动态,开源模型严重落后.

articles.title: ScIntBench: Physical Interaction Plausibility in 3D Scene Generation
articles.content: Existing evaluations of text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation largely emphasize semantic fidelity and physical validity at rest, leaving interaction-time physical reliability insufficiently assessed. To address this gap, we introduce ScIntBench, a unified benchmark centered on interaction readiness: it executes prescribed manipulation actions (e.g., pushing, opening, and surface probing) in physics simulation and measures task success, capability and progress, post-interaction integrity, and dynamic plausibility. Multi-view semantic and static physical evaluations complement these metrics and help explain interaction outcomes. We systematically evaluate 12 state-of-the-art scene generation systems across 10 room types. Our results reveal that strong semantic and static physical performance does not necessarily translate into interaction readiness: a system with near-perfect static plausibility completes only 11.54% of interactions, 7 of the 12 systems produce scenes that cannot support any interaction, and even the best system succeeds in only 36.92% of prescribed tasks. These findings highlight two fundamental challenges in generating interaction-ready scenes: providing the necessary physical interaction capabilities and ensuring reliable physical behavior under active manipulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ScInt Bench: 三维场景生成中的物理相互作用可视性
articles.content_zh: 现有对文字条件3D室内场景生成的评价主要强调语义忠贞和休息时的物理有效性,使互动时间的物理可靠性得不到充分的评估。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了ScInt Bench,一个以互动准备状态为中心的统一基准:它在物理模拟中执行规定的操纵动作(如推取,开取和地表探测)并测量任务成功,能力和进展,互动后的完整性,以及动态的可信度. 多视图语义和静态物理评价补充了这些衡量标准,并有助于解释互动结果。 我们系统评估了10个房间类型的12个最先进的场景生成系统。 我们的结果显示,强健的语义和静态物理性能并不一定会转化为互动准备:一个具有近乎完美的静态性能的系统只完成11.54%的相互作用,12个系统中的7个产生无法支持任何相互作用的场景,甚至最好的系统也只成功36.92%的规定任务. 这些发现凸显出产生互动准备场景的两个根本挑战:提供必要的物理互动能力和确保在主动操纵下可靠的物理行为.

articles.title: Hierarchical Sparse Graph for Multi-dimensional Assignment in Event-based Tracking
articles.content: Existing event-based tracking methods typically operate in an online manner, associating tracklets across adjacent batches. However, this limited temporal window often leads to failures in challenging scenarios, such as long-term occlusions or missed detections, where broader temporal context should be incorporated for high-precision tracking. To achieve robust and accurate tracking, this paper concentrates on the event-based multi-dimensional assignment that associates tracklets across multiple batches simultaneously. Unlike image-based detectors, event-based detectors can generate multiple correct yet spatially distinct tracklets for a single object per batch. This violates the one-to-one rule in classic data association, making event-based association an underdetermined many-to-many matching problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to tackle this NP-hard problem. To address its underdetermined nature, we formulate the assignment problem via fuzzy logic, where pairwise tracklet correlations are quantified through multiple long-range kinematic metrics. This fuzzy design eliminates the need for hard tracking thresholds and enables multiple heterogeneous metrics to be integrated into a unified correlation. By treating tracklets as nodes and their fuzzy correlations as edges, we construct a Hierarchical Sparse Graph (HSG). Building upon the HSG, we pose assignment as a graph partition task, and employ a heuristic solution that measures vertex affinity for partitioning adaptively. The entire pipeline is training-free. Comprehensive experiments on two challenging event datasets, eTram and Ev-UAV, show that our method outperforms existing event-based and most image-based association models. Particularly, it achieves over 2$\times$ the performance of OC-SORT across all metrics in the many-to-many association scenario.

articles.title_zh: 事件跟踪中多维任务分层图
articles.content_zh: 现有的基于事件的跟踪方法一般以在线方式运行,将相邻批次的跟踪轨道连接起来. 然而,这种有限的时间窗口往往导致在具有挑战性的情景中出现失败,例如长期隔离或检测缺失,而对于高精度跟踪,应当纳入更广泛的时间背景。 为了实现稳健而准确的跟踪,本文集中论述基于事件的多维任务,该任务同时连接多批次的跟踪. 与以图像为基础的探测器不同,以事件为基础的探测器可以为每批单个物体产生多条正确而空间上独立的轨道. 这违反了经典数据关联中的一对一规则,使得事件关联成为未确定的许多比对问题. 据我们所知,这是处理这一核问题的第一个工作。 为了解决其确定性不足的问题,我们通过模糊的逻辑来提出分配问题,通过多种远距离运动测量法,将对等轨道的关联量化。 这种模糊的设计消除了硬追踪阈值的需要并使得多种不同度量标准能够被整合到一种统一的关联中去. 通过将轨迹作为节点和模糊的相通性作为边缘,我们构建了分级分层图(HSG). 在卫生与安全小组的基础上,我们把任务定位为图分任务,并采用一个高压解决方案,以适应性的方式衡量顶点的亲和性。 整个管道都是免费的 eTram和Ev-UAV这两个具有挑战性的事件数据集的全面实验显示,我们的方法优于现有的基于事件和大多数以图像为基础的关联模型。 特别是,它实现了OC-SORT在众多关联情景中所有度量标准上的性能超过2美元\%.

articles.title: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN with Saliency-Map Interpretability for Skin Cancer Detection
articles.content: Skin cancer is among the most prevalent and life threatening forms of cancer worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis significantly improves patient survival rates. However, manual dermoscopic assessment remains challenging due to visual similarity. This study proposes an Explainable AI-driven framework for automated binary classification of skin lesions using a lightweight attention-based convolutional neural network (CNN-Attention). The model integrates channel attention to focus on informative regions of dermoscopic images while maintaining low computational complexity. A publicly available dataset comprising 2,637 training and 660 test images was used, with balanced class weights. The proposed model achieved 87 percent accuracy with 1.95 million parameters and 7.45 MB of storage, matching the best baseline (MobileNet) while using approximately half as many parameters and half as much storage. ROC AUC and PR AUC scores reached 0.9475 and 0.9430, respectively. Additionally, saliency maps were incorporated as an explainability technique to visualize regions that influence model decisions. Comparative analysis with VGG16,VGG19,ResNet101,and MobileNet demonstrates the proposed models effectiveness in balancing classification results, computational efficiency, and interpretability.

articles.title_zh: 基于轻量级关注的有线电视新闻网,具有皮肤癌检测的显著性-映射可解释性
articles.content_zh: 皮肤癌是全世界最普遍和最有生命威胁的癌症。 早期和准确的诊断大大地提高了病人的存活率. 然而,由于视觉相似,人工皮肤评估仍然具有挑战性。 本研究提出一个可解释的人工智能驱动框架,用于使用轻量级的注意力分泌神经网络(CNN-Atenty)对皮肤损伤进行自动二进制分类. 该模型将注意力集中到信息性区域,同时保持较低的计算复杂性。 使用了一套公开的数据集,包括2 637个培训和660个测试图像,并具有均衡的班级权重。 拟议模型精确度达到87%,有195万个参数和7.45 MB储存,与最佳基线(MobileNet)相匹配,同时使用了大约一半的参数和一半的储存。 ROC AUC和PR AUC的分数分别为0.9475分和0.9430分. 此外,还纳入了显著地图,作为可视化影响示范决定的区域的一种解释技术。 与VGG16、VGG19、ResNet101和Mobile的比较分析 净值显示拟议模型在平衡分类结果、计算效率和可解释性方面的效力。

articles.title: MvT: Event-based Multi-view Projection for Multiple Object Tracking
articles.content: Event cameras are increasingly used for Multiple Object Tracking (MOT), but their asynchronous event output often requires specialized methods. Existing processing methods primarily follow two paradigms, pseudo-frames and event-by-event. The former is the prevailing approach since its data format aligns with images, making image-based techniques applicable. However, it suffers from tracking failures when trajectories overlap or are spatially close on pseudo-frames. Facing this challenge, we propose a multi-view pipeline, Multi-view Tracking (MvT), which preserves the 2D data format to leverage image-based techniques directly while introducing additional spatio-temporal views to resolve tracking ambiguities in a single view. MvT comprises a Multi-view Projection (MvP) module and a Multi-view Fusion (MvF) stage. MvP encodes events into three complementary spatio-temporal views while mitigating the pattern discretization. Within MvF, multi-view results are unified into a 3D coordinate system, and tracklets are associated through an optimization model subject to specific criteria combination. Evaluations on four datasets, including our self-collected Small Objects Dataset (SOD), show that MvT seamlessly integrates image-based methods and outperforms existing non-learning and learning trackers in generalized scenarios, and effectively resolves the single-view tracking ambiguities. Being training-free, MvT is applicable when ground-truth annotation is infeasible, thereby highlighting its practical, data-efficient potential. Code is available at https://github.com/zhazhabiu/MvTracking.

articles.title_zh: MvT: 多物体跟踪基于事件的多视图投影
articles.content_zh: 事件相机被越来越多地用于多物体跟踪(MOT),但其同步事件输出往往需要专门的方法. 现有的处理方法主要遵循两个范式,即伪框和事件逐一处理. 前者是通行的方法,因为其数据格式与图像一致,使基于图像的技术得以适用。 然而,当轨迹重叠或空间接近于伪框时,它会遇到跟踪故障. 面对这一挑战,我们提议采用多视图管道-多视图跟踪(MvT),它保留了2D数据格式来直接利用以图像为基础的技术,同时引入了额外的斯皮提奥-时态观点,以解决单一视图中的跟踪模糊性. MvT包含一个多视图投影(MvP)模块和一个多视图融合(MvF)阶段. MvP将事件编码为三个互补的spatio-timperal视图,同时缓解了模式盘式. 在MvF内部,多视图结果被统一为一个3D坐标系统,通过一个受具体标准组合约束的优化模型来连接轨道. 对包括自取自用的小物体数据集(SOD)在内的四个数据集的评价显示,MvT无缝地整合了以图像为基础的方法并超越了通用情景中现有的非学习和学习跟踪器,并有效解决了单视跟踪的模糊性. 由于MvT是无培训的,因此,当地面真实说明不可行时,MvT就适用,从而突出其实际的、数据效率高的潜力。 代码见https://github.com/zhazhabiu/MvTracking.

articles.title: TRUCO: A Scalable Lock-Free Algorithm for Parallel Contour Extraction
articles.content:
Transforming binary masks into geometric contours remains a critical step in many computer vision pipelines, particularly for post-processing high-resolution segmentation outputs. Yet, standard algorithms such as the Suzuki-Abe method are limited by their sequential nature and the overhead of building topological hierarchies. As modern applications transition to high-resolution imaging, there is a critical need for contour extraction that leverages multi-core CPU architectures without the complexity of tile stitching or heavy synchronization.
  This paper presents TRUCO (Threaded Raster Unrestricted Contour Ownership), a lock-free parallel algorithm designed for high-performance geometric boundary extraction. TRUCO introduces a start-point ownership rule, combined with a speculative tracing model, in which threads trace contours downward into adjacent regions and use an upward-termination logic to ensure each contour is processed exactly once.
  Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets, conducted on both consumer and server-grade CPUs, demonstrate that TRUCO significantly outperforms existing baselines. The method achieves speedups of over an order of magnitude compared to the industry standard while maintaining robust scalability on high-resolution scenes across diverse hardware architectures.

articles.title_zh: TRUCO:用于平行轮廓提取的可缩放无锁算法
articles.content_zh:
将二进制口罩转换为几何轮廓仍然是许多计算机视觉管道的关键步骤,特别是对于处理后高分辨率分解输出来说. 然而,铃木-阿贝方法等标准算法因其相继性以及建筑地貌分级的起伏性而受到限制. 随着现代应用向高分辨成像的过渡,迫切需要利用多核心CPU架构来取回轮廓取出,而不需要瓷砖缝合或重同步的复杂性.
本文介绍TRUCO(Threaded Raster Unrected Contour Owide),是一种为高性能几何边界取出而设计的无锁平行算法. TRUCO引入了起始点所有权规则,并结合了投机性追踪模型,其中线程向下向下向相邻区域跟踪等同,并使用向上终止逻辑,以确保每个等同被精确地处理一次.
在消费者和服务器级CPU上进行的合成和现实世界数据集实验结果表明,TRUCO的绩效大大超过现有的基线。 该方法与行业标准相比,实现了超过一个数量级的速度,同时在高分辨场景上保持了跨越不同硬件架构的强伸.

articles.title: Taming Noise Initialization for Zero-shot Video Restoration with Image Diffusion Priors
articles.content: Recent advances in diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in restoring high-quality images in a zero-shot manner. Unfortunately, extending this success to video restoration is challenging due to the substantial computational resources required to pre-train video diffusion models. A rising trend seeks to address video restoration by utilizing a pre-trained image diffusion model, initiating restoration from either frame-wise independent or identical Gaussian noise. Yet, these approaches often fall short, as such simple noise initiations fail to capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlations within degraded video frames. In this work, we propose taming noise initialization for zero-shot video restoration, which preserves the intrinsic temporal correlations by generating initial noises directly using DDIM inversion on the corrupted video frames themselves. Building on this, we introduce an adaptive noise blending strategy that suppresses degradation patterns encoded during DDIM inversion while gradually steering the noise toward a Gaussian distribution. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose measurement-guided trajectory attention to better align features across frames. Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing zero-shot approaches, consistently achieving superior results on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.

articles.title_zh: 使用图像传播前传进行零相片视频修复的打压噪声初始化
articles.content_zh: 最近传播模型的进步在以零镜头方式恢复高品质图像方面取得了显著成功. 不幸的是,将这一成功推广到视频修复方面具有挑战性,因为预先培训视频传播模型需要大量的计算资源。 一种上升趋势试图通过使用经过预先训练的图像传播模型来解决视频恢复问题,从帧式独立或相同的高斯噪音开始恢复。 然而,这些方法往往不够充分,因为这种简单的噪音起动无法捕捉和利用已退化的视频框架内固有的时间相关性。 在这部作品中,我们提出将噪声驯化初始化为零镜头视频修复,通过直接使用DDIM倒置在被腐蚀的视频帧上产生初始噪声来保存固有的时间相关性. 在此基础上,我们引入了适应性噪声混合策略,抑制DDIM倒置期间所编码的降解模式,同时将噪声逐渐引导到高斯分布. 为了进一步强调时间上的一致性,我们建议以衡量为指南的轨迹注意更好地调整跨框架的特征。 多项视频修复任务的广泛实验表明,我们的方法比现有的零镜头方法要好,在DAVIS、REDS4和Set8数据集上不断取得优异的结果。

articles.title: GradCO: Behavior-Aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
articles.content: Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) retrieves a target pedestrian using natural-language descriptions of appearance and normal or anomalous behavior. Unlike conventional text-based person retrieval, TPAS must preserve identity cues while distinguishing fine-grained behaviors. It presents two challenges: same-identity, different-behavior hard negatives cause gradient conflict during granular alignment, while strong appearance cues can obscure weak behavioral evidence during aggregation. We propose GradCO (behavior-aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading), comprising three complementary components. Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) forms appearance, normal-behavior, and anomalous-behavior streams whose roles are learned from retrieval objectives without expert-specific semantic labels. Conflict Offload Learning (COL) uses pair-conditioned offload anchors in similarity computation to reduce the conflicting-gradient burden on the main text representations. Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA) aggregates expert similarities and features using query-conditioned weights. Experiments on five TPAS/TIPR benchmarks show GradCO significantly surpasses SOTA methods and validate our design.

articles.title_zh: GradCO: 基于文本的人异常搜索的 行为- 警惕渐变- 冲突卸载
articles.content_zh: 基于文字的人物异常搜索(TPAS)利用自然语言的外观描述和正常或异常行为来取回目标行人. 与传统的以文字为基础的个人检索不同,TPAS必须保留身份提示,同时区分细纹行为. 它提出了两个挑战:同名同名,不同行为硬负数在颗粒对接时会引发梯度冲突,而强出相提示在聚合时会模糊弱的行为证据. 我们提议由三个互补部分组成的GradCO(行为意识分级-冲突卸载)。 Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) 形成外观,常态-行为和异常-行为流,其角色从检索目标中学习而无专家特有语义标签. 冲突卸载学习(COL)在类似性计算中使用配对条件卸载锚来减轻主文本表述中相冲突分级的负担. 分级意向对齐(HIA)利用有查询条件的权重来汇总专家的相似性和特征. 对五个TPAS/TIPR基准的实验显示,GradCO大大超越了SOTA方法并验证了我们的设计.

articles.title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
articles.content: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.

articles.title_zh: GameVerse:用于长效互动世界建模的分钟级游戏播放数据集
articles.content_zh: 互动世界模型的最近进展使得有可能从行动投入中产生可控制、能动的环境。 然而,目前的模型在大约推出一分钟之后仍难以保持一致性,这一局限性不在于模型能力,而在于缺乏长期的培训数据。 现有的游戏游戏视频数据集一般由十秒以下的片段组成,并有描述整段片段的字幕用粗糙而无区别的文字来描述,这不足以控制长视距生成. 我们用GameVerse来解决这个问题,GameVerse是一个小尺度的游戏游戏游戏视频数据集,目的为长视互动世界建模. GameVerse 包含 69.7K相隔1655小时和相距34.96万帧的剪辑跨越了不同的第一人称和第三人称游戏游戏,包括1,358小时的连续两分钟序列,这个数量级比之前的数据集要长. 剪贴经过一个统一的管道,包括符合场景的分块、质量过滤、相机进行估计以及基于事件的说明。 每个片段都配有一段时间稳定的相机轨迹,该轨迹在分分钟之间保持连贯,并配有将静态场景背景与动态前地事件区分开来并符合事件边界而非固定的时间窗口的字幕. 综合分析显示,GameVerse在规模,多样性和注释质量上超过了现有的公共数据集. 实验进一步证明,关于GameVerse的培训大大扩展了互动世界模型的时间范围.

articles.title: HDVS: semi-supervised semantic segmentation via heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision
articles.content: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation, which aims to utilize large volumes of unlabeled images to achieve accurate segmentation results with fewer human annotations, has attracted increasing attention. Prior methods were primarily based on the assumption that the pseudo-labels generated by each branch were sufficiently reliable to supervise the remaining branches. However, there is a concern that the errors in pseudo-labels could accumulate during co-training, potentially resulting in suboptimal performance. To this end, we present a novel framework called heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision (HDVS), which is designed to enhance the reliability of pseudo-labels and mitigate the issues arising from pseudo-labeling. Specifically, based on the cross-supervision framework, we introduce a voting mechanism that correlates pseudo-labels from heterogeneous branches to produce pseudo-labels with enhanced reliability. Concurrently, we employ a feature communication module to introduce perturbations at the feature level in each branch to maximize prediction diversity across the dual branches while maintaining convergence. Comprehensive evaluations of the proposed HDVS on two benchmark datasets (PASCAL VOC 2012 and Cityscapes) demonstrate its superiority to the state-of-the-art approaches.

articles.title_zh: HDVS:通过多种双分支投票监督进行半监督语义分解.
articles.content_zh: 半受监督的语义分解旨在利用大量无标签的图像来得到准确的分解结果而减少人类的注释,这引起了越来越多的关注. 先前的方法主要是假设每个分支产生的伪标签足够可靠,足以监督其余分支。 然而,人们担心,假标签的错误可能在共同训练期间会累积起来,可能导致性能不理想. 为此,我们提出了一个称为多样化双重分支投票监督(HDVS)的新框架,其目的是提高伪标签的可靠性并减轻由伪标签引起的问题。 具体而言,根据跨监督框架,我们采用了一种表决机制,将不同分支的伪标签联系起来,以产生更可靠的伪标签。 同时,我们使用一个特征交流模块,在每个分支的特征层面引入扰动,以在保持趋同的同时最大限度地预测两分支之间的多样性. 对两个基准数据集(PASCAL VOC 2012和Cityscapes)的拟议HDVS进行综合评价,显示出其对最先进方法的优越性.

articles.title: Subspace Clifford Networks
articles.content: In this work, we propose Subspace Clifford Networks, a reformulation that replaces global cyclic rolling with grouped subspace interactions. Instead of sampling sparse cyclic diagonals across the entire $D$-dimensional channel space, we project the features into an aligned space $\R^{\tilde{D}} = \bigoplus_{g=1}^{G} V_g$ partitioned into $G$ low-dimensional groups $V_g \cong \R^k$ with $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$. Within each $k$-dimensional group, we compute all $\binom{k}{2}$ wedge coordinates and concatenate them with $\operatorname{SiLU}$-activated coordinate-wise products, while sandwiching the grouped interaction between learnable $1\times 1$ linear projections to enable cross-group channel mixing. This design reduces intermediate feature expansion from $2|\mathcal{S}|D$ (typically $10D$ for 5 shifts) down to $1.5\tilde{D}$ ($k=2$), $2.0\tilde{D}$ ($k=3$), or $2.5\tilde{D}$ ($k=4$). Furthermore, exploiting the small, fixed group size $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$, we implement a fused CUDA kernel that evaluates the forward interaction and a recomputation-based analytical backward pass using thread-local variables without allocating global-memory buffers for elementwise intermediates. Finally, we extend the backbone from an isotropic columnar layout to a multi-resolution Hierarchical Clifford Network with configurable per-stage subspace dimensions. Experiments on CIFAR-100 show that the proposed models substantially reduce parameter count and training time across both regimes, while the hierarchical variants also improve classification accuracy over the evaluated shift-based hierarchical baselines.

articles.title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
articles.content: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. articles.title_zh: 远景-语言-行动还是世界-行动? 只是行动模式
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言行动(VLA)和世界行动模式(WAM)社区就控制政策是否应当从视觉-语言模式或视觉生成者那里继承经过预先培训的知识展开辩论。 然而,辩论将三种可分离的选择捆绑在一起:骨干初始化、适用于未来观测的目标,以及未来损失的处理机制是否仍然处于推论之中。 因此,不能简单地将志愿军和妇女军之间的差距归咎于其中任何一个。 我们显示,把这些选择脱钩为两个家庭带来一个共同的框架,我们称之为Just Action Model(Just Action Model(JAM)):一个预先训练的视觉骨干,有一个行动专家,训练有素的动作损失和前瞻损失。 展望损失列车电流-观测功能通过训练后丢弃的预测头来预测被记录的未来被冻结的编码,因此没有视觉生成参与训练或推断,骨干可以自由选择. 我们首先比较固定政策结构中的目标,然后评价各骨干家庭的展望方案。 由此产生的JAM政策在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上超过了它们对应的FastWAM和ImageWAM,在RoboTwin上取得了相近或略高的成功率. 与FastWAM相比,JAM的成功率分别从97.0%/55.3%/91.2%提高到98.2%/64.5%/91.4%。 根据缓存的展望目标,与FastWAM相比,JAM将每个样本的在线培训FLOP估计数减少了73%. 我们的结果表明,未来的监督可以改善控制,而无需视觉生成或额外的推论机制,而利用发电机初始化或视觉语言主干线可以实现强有力的展望性能。 项目网页:https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

articles.title: TopoField: Technical Report for ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge
articles.content: Functional segmentation requires locating small interactive parts, such as knobs, buttons, and sockets, in indoor point clouds and returning confidence-ranked instance masks. A point-wise semantic predictor produces a continuous probability field, whereas the benchmark evaluates a discrete set of scored instances. This creates a substantial field-to-instance gap. We present TopoField, a deterministic decoder built on top of VOLT. TopoField first converts 13 test-time forward passes into a semantic consensus field, then decodes instance candidates from the consensus geometry, and finally ranks the candidates in a class-aware manner. The augmentation stage retains the processed-point identity of every fragment prediction, accumulates probabilities in a common point array, normalizes by coverage count, and fuses the resulting caches. The decoding stage separates high-confidence cores from broader support regions, constructs a symmetric radius-pruned point graph, and uses a multi-source graph-geodesic partition to split support regions that contain multiple seeds. On 561 ground-truth instances across 30 validation scenes, an IoU-0.5-valid candidate exists for 67.2% of instances, and top-1 coverage is 20.0%. These complementary measurements motivate joint attention to candidate construction and ranking. TopoField achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP50, and 47.558% AP25. TopoField achieved second place on the ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge.

articles.title: Zhengrong-Spatial-Aware 1.0: Advancing 3D Multimodal Intelligence
articles.content: This report presents the implementation and validation of two end-to-end multimodal adaptation pipelines for 3D-aware visual question answering on a custom spatial dataset. The first pipeline fine-tunes HiSpatial-3B, which augments RGB observations with metric-scale 3D point maps; the second adapts Qwen3-VL through memory-efficient QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning. The completed engineering stack covers dataset conversion, image-annotation alignment, monocular geometry preprocessing, instruction construction, mixed-domain training, checkpoint management, batch inference, and automated evaluation. On the target spatial benchmark, HiSpatial adaptation increases overall accuracy from 1.73% before fine-tuning to 79.89% at 3,600 steps. On a separately collected styled split, accuracy improves from 14.9% to 55.1%, indicating transfer beyond the original training set. The Qwen3-VL pipeline is likewise implemented end-to-end for both 8B- and 32B-scale models using mixed-domain QLoRA adaptation. The resulting accuracy improves from 20.74% to 45.27% for Qwen3-VL-8B and from 30.79% to 47.60% for Qwen3-VL-32B. Together, these results establish two complementary and reproducible adaptation pipelines for geometry-aware and general-purpose multimodal spatial reasoning. These results establish a reproducible engineering foundation for subsequent work on metric 3D reasoning, spatial grounding, and domain-adapted multimodal systems, while also identifying training-data composition as a central factor in preserving general multimodal capability during specialization.

articles.title_zh: 郑龙-空间-Aware 1.0:推进三维多式智能
articles.content_zh: 本报告介绍3D-意识视觉问题回答自定义空间数据集两个端到端多模式适应管道的实施和验证情况。 第一条管线微调HiSpatial-3B,用公尺比例的3D点地图来增强RGB的观测;第二条通过内存高效的QLORA监督微调来调整Qune3-VL. 已完成的工程堆栈包括数据集转换,图像-注释对接,单相位几何预处理,指令构建,混合域培训,检查站管理,分批推论,以及自动化评价. 在目标空间基准上,HiSpatial适应将总体精度从微调前的1.73%提升到3600步的79.89%. 在单独收集的分词中,精度从14.9%提高到55.1%,表明转调超过了原培训集。 Qune3-VL输油管同样采用混合域QLORA的适应性,为8B和32B级两种型号实施端到端. 由此产生的精度从20.74%提高到45.27%,Qune3-VL-8B的精度从30.79%提高到47.60%. 这些结果共同为几何意识和通用多模式空间推理建立了两个互补和可再生的适应管道. 这些结果为今后关于计量三维推理、空间地基和经域调整的多模式系统的工作奠定了可复制的工程基础,同时也将培训数据构成确定为在专业化期间保持一般多模式能力的一个核心因素。

articles.title: Retrospective macromolecular pool fraction mapping from conventional clinical MRI: a physics-guided self-supervised deep learning framework
articles.content: Macromolecular pool fraction (MPF) is a quantitative imaging biomarker sensitive to myelin integrity and other changes in tissue macromolecular content, but specialized acquisitions and reconstruction methods limit its use in large-scale studies. We present a physics-guided, self-supervised deep learning framework for retrospectively estimating MPF directly from conventional clinical brain MRI ($T_1$-weighted, $T_2$-weighted, and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery [FLAIR]) without paired quantitative reference scans. The framework embeds an analytical two-pool magnetization transfer signal model that related sequence-averaged radiofrequency transmit power to apparent longitudinal relaxation. To accommodate heterogeneous clinical protocols, the network conditions intermediate features on acquisition parameters via adaptive instance normalization. It was trained and evaluated on a multisite, multivendor, multiprotocol dataset of 7,705 MRI sessions (3 T). Across 1,237 test sessions, mean MPF was $0.182 \pm 0.007$ in white matter and $0.144 \pm 0.009$ in gray matter, with limited variation across vendor-by-protocol groups (between-group coefficient of variation: 2.65% and 5.63%, respectively). In 70 sessions with demyelinating-disease labels, MPF was 35.6% lower in segmented lesions than in normal-appearing white matter. MPF maps from two different clinical protocols acquired in a healthy volunteer showed a mean voxel-wise absolute percentage difference of 7.7% and a concordance correlation coefficient of $0.888$, indicating good cross-protocol consistency. These results suggest that magnetization transfer-informed self-supervised learning enables stable MPF mapping from conventional clinical MRI, providing a scalable approach to investigate demyelinating pathology in both existing imaging archives and prospectively acquired conventional clinical scans without dedicated qMT acquisitions.
