articles.title_zh: 常规临床核磁共振的回溯性宏分子池分数图:物理自导自导的深层学习框架
articles.content_zh: 相克分子池分量(MPF)是一种能对蛋白质完整性以及组织上大型分子含量的其他变化具有敏感性的定量成像生物标记,但专业的获取和再生方法限制了它在大规模研究中的使用. 我们提出了一个物理学指导、自我监督的深层学习框架,以便直接从常规临床脑磁共振中追溯性地估计磁共振(T_1美元加权、T_2美元加权)和流体增压倒置恢复[FLAIR],而不进行定量参考扫描。 框架嵌入了分析双集合磁化转移信号模型,相关序列平均射频将功率传递给明显的纵向放松. 为了适应各种临床协议,网络通过适应性实例正常化为获取参数提供中间特征。 它在7,705个磁共振场(3个T)的多站点、多毒多菌多菌数据集中接受了培训和评估。 在1,237次测试中,平均MPF在白色物质中为0.182 \pm 0.007美元,在灰色物质中为0.144 \pm 0.009美元,不同供应商群体之间的差别有限(不同类别之间变化系数分别为:2.65%和5.63%)。 在70个带有去酵-病标签的病程中,分层损伤的MPF比正常出现的白色物质低35.6%. 一个健康的志愿者从两个不同的临床协议中获得的MPF地图显示,平均阴道绝对百分比相差7.7%,相和系数为0.888美元,表明跨议定书的一致性良好。 这些结果表明,磁化转移知情的自我监督学习能够稳定地从常规临床核磁共振中绘制出多氯联苯图谱,提供了一种可扩展的方法来调查现有成像档案和预期获得的常规临床扫描中除虫病理学,而无需专门获得qMT。

articles.title: Uncovering Shortcut Amplification in Video RLVR through the Lens of Perceptual Uncertainty Collapse
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.

articles.title_zh: 在视频 RLVR 中无法覆盖快捷键 。
articles.content_zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为一个有效的培训后范例,可以提高大型多式联运模型的视频推理能力。 尽管它具有经验效力,但我们表明,结果级优化可以引入一种不可取的快捷方式放大效应,即模型越来越倾向于文本优先答案,即使这些答案没有视觉证据的支持。 为了描述这种行为,我们通过透视不确定性的镜头来调查视频RLVR的训练动态,分析预测不确定性如何在视频条件化和文本化的情况下演变. 我们的分析发现了一种感知不确定性崩溃现象,在这种现象中,RL培训不断使模型的答案分布更加清晰,而可归因于视觉证据的不确定性减少则逐渐减少. 进一步的梯度方向分析显示,这种增强信心越来越不适应视向不确定性的减少,而是以文本优先压缩为主。 基于这些调查结果,我们提议采用双功能自失能政策优化(BSPO),这是一种自失能框架,通过两个互补的分布信号调节政策更新。 具体来说,BSPO从群体内部的正确和不正确的推出中得出经验推理原理,以识别对推理敏感的符号,并引入了快捷感视觉扰动,以惩罚在与任务相关的视觉证据被削弱时仍然不稳定的预测. BSPO通过适应性地重新加权最初的RL优势,保留了RLVR的任务解决效益,同时促进既注重推理又注重视觉的更新. 广泛的实验验证了BSPO在提高视频推理性能和增强视觉忠实性方面的有效性.

articles.title: 3D-SceneQ: Empowering 3D LLM With Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning and Multi-Modal Feature Enhancement
articles.content: Current 3D scene understanding pipelines typically concatenate vast numbers of 3D object tokens with text tokens and feed the resulting sequence to a Large Language Model (LLM). However, existing 3D-LLMs for scene understanding encounter two major limitations: (i) excessive inclusion of task-irrelevant object data, introducing noise that reduces reasoning accuracy and increases hallucinations; and (ii) reliance solely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks the rich semantic information available in complementary 2D modalities, such as color, material properties, texture, and high-level contextual relationships. To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a 3D LLM that unifies adaptive token pruning with multimodal semantic enrichment, markedly advancing scene understanding, reasoning, and grounding. Specifically, we propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module that adaptively selects task-relevant objects based on the intended meaning of user instructions, leveraging a learnable latent query to retain critical information while effectively suppressing irrelevant noise. In addition, we introduce a Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates 2D feature embeddings from pre-trained models into 3D representation to enrich object-level semantic information. Evaluations show that 3D-SceneQ outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr on Scan2Cap and +17.0 EM@1 on SQA3D), demonstrating its remarkable capabilities in various 3D language reasoning tasks.

articles.title_zh: 3D- SceneQ: 赋予 3D LLM 与 Query- Guided 适应性跑步和多模式特性增强
articles.content_zh: 当前3D场景理解管路一般会将大量3D对象符号与文本符号相接并反馈到一个大语言模型(LLM)上. 然而,现有的用于场景理解的3D-LLM遭遇了两大限制:(一)过多地收录了与任务无关的对象数据,引入了降低推理精度并增加幻觉的噪声;和(二)完全依赖点云数据,而点云数据本身缺乏在互补的2D模式中可以获得的丰富的语义信息,如颜色,物质属性,纹理等高层次上下文关系. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了3D-SceneQ(3D-SceneQ),这是一种3D LLM,它统一了适应性标志,使多模式语义丰富,显著地推进了场景理解,推理和地平线. 具体地说,我们提议一个查询- Guided Adaptive Pruning(QGAP)模块,根据用户指令的预期含义,适应性地选择与任务相关的对象,利用可学习的潜在查询保留关键信息,同时有效抑制无关的噪音. 此外,我们引入了多模式对象级地物增强(MOFE)模块,该模块将2D特性从预先训练过的模型嵌入到3D表达中来丰富对象级语义信息. 评价显示,3D-SceneQ超越了目前跨越多条基准的先进方法(例如:Scan2Cap上的+5.7 CIDER和SQA3D上的+17.0 EM@1),显示出其在各种3D语言推理任务的卓越能力.

articles.title: How Much Can Best-of-N Help a World Action Model? Measuring Selectable Headroom and Realizing It in Closed Loop
articles.content: World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.

articles.title_zh: 最佳N能帮助世界行动模式多少? 可选择的会议室和实现 在闭锁圈里
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型(WAMs)预测它们产生的行动的视觉后果,这使得测试时间选择成为改进固定政策的自然方式:想象候选行动的未来,执行最好的行动. 选择的好处以可选的会议室为界,最佳候选人真正有多好,但标准估计使每个候选人执行一次并保持最佳结果,使候选人的质量与随后一切的随机性相混为一谈。 我们引入了基于比特-再生分支的去诺化反事实协议,重复续作,被搁置的甲骨文,以及常见的随机数,用来测量一个选择者能够实现的头室,并用它的测量来构建出一个被失败选择者. 在四个WAM中,两个基准,超过10万个分支的推出,以及预先登记的测试,我们发现(一) 标准估计过高地指出了当地样本的可选取头室:每个候选人17个续作的界限将其可选份额从24%到66%置于三个WAM之间;(二) 结构化的动作扰动创造了最多16个可选取头室的点;以及(三) 在两个WAM中,有行动条件的想象力,想象中的期货载有候选人结果信息,相对于真实的期货来说,没有可察觉的损失,关于宇宙政策的价值负责人未使用的信息。 只有在WAM的读取失败时,选择者才将封闭式启动任务的成功率从76.9%提高到81.6%,在被搁置的培训任务中,政策失败率最大,隐蔽任务成功率从62.6%提高到69.8%。

articles.title: VGIQA: Fine-Grained Image Quality Assessment with Visual Grounding Rewards
articles.content: Image quality assessment (IQA) aims to evaluate the perceptual visual quality of images. Recently, the rapid development of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has significantly advanced the IQA field. By integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reinforcement learning (RL), these models can generate more accurate and interpretable results while relying on less training data. However, existing MLLM-based methods are predominantly constrained to holistic, image-level evaluations and lack the capability to produce fine-grained, localized assessments, which substantially limits their practical applicability. To address this limitation, we propose VGIQA, a novel IQA model endowed with both local and global quality assessment capabilities. VGIQA is trained via a two-stage paradigm comprising a cold-start phase followed by reinforcement learning. Driven by carefully designed local quality assessment reward functions, our model exhibits exceptional image quality understanding on VGSR-2K, a new dataset we propose specifically for local quality evaluation, significantly outperforming existing open-source MLLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct. Furthermore, the local quality evaluation task can effectively enhance the model's performance on the degradation perception task.

articles.title_zh: VGIQA:有视觉地平面奖励的精细图像质量评估
articles.content_zh: 图像质量评估(IQA)旨在评价图像的感知视觉质量. 最近,多式大语言模型(MLLMs)的快速发展大大地推动了IQA领域. 通过整合思维链(COT)推理和强化学习(RL),这些模型可以产生更准确和可解释的结果,同时依赖较少的培训数据. 然而,现有的基于最低生活水平的方法主要局限于整体的、图像一级的评价,并缺乏编制精细的局部评估的能力,这大大限制了其实际适用性。 为了消除这一局限性,我们提议采用具有地方和全球质量评估能力的新型IQA模式。 VGIQA是通过一个两阶段的范式进行训练的,包括一个冷启动阶段,然后是强化学习阶段。 在精心设计的地方质量评估奖励功能的推动下,我们的模型在VGSR-2K上展现出超乎寻常的图像质量理解,这是我们专门为当地质量评价而提出的一款新数据集,显著优于已存在的开源MLLM,如Qun2.5-VL-72B-Instruct和Qun3-VL-32B-Instruct. 此外,地方质量评价任务能够有效地提高模型在退化感知任务方面的业绩。

articles.title: INTR++: INterpretable TRansformer with better Accuracy, Interpretability, and Adaptability
articles.content: Interpretable Transformers often perform well in domain specific settings but lose effectiveness beyond that. Achieving ViT-like broad applicability requires models with consistent performance across domains. Recent works on Interpretable Transformers, INTR and Prompt-CAM, were developed keeping domain adaptability in mind. Prompt-CAM leverages learnable prompts to promote adaptability. However, these prompts are fixed in nature and therefore struggle to adapt to domains with substantial variation in input image characteristics, resulting in reduced interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose INTR++, which extends Prompt-CAM by incorporating a lightweight Prompt Adapter Module (PAM). PAM enables prompts to be adaptive by enriching them with domain-specific knowledge, thereby ensuring consistent interpretability across diverse domains including those with varying image characteristics such as medical imaging, micro-scopic imaging, and remote sensing imagery. INTR++ retains the standard architecture and end-to-end learning of Interpretable Transformer based models, while adding only a small number of additional parameters compared to Prompt-CAM. We demonstrate that INTR++ delivers consistent improvements in all aspects across domains like animals, plants, medical imaging, microscopic imaging, remote sensing imagery and object-centric data.

articles.title_zh: INTR++: 具有更好的准确性、可解释性和可适应性的不成熟的TRansformer
articles.content_zh: 可解释的变形器在域特定设置中往往表现良好,但丧失了超出域的效能. 实现类似虚拟技术的广泛适用性,需要具有各领域一致业绩的模式。 最近关于可解释变换器、INTR和即时-CAM的著作是在铭记域适应性的情况下开发的。 快速-CAM杠杆可以学习,促进适应性。 然而,这些提示在性质上是固定的,因此难以适应输入图像特性差异很大的域,导致可解释性降低. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议INTR++,通过纳入一个轻量级的即时适配器模块(PAM)来扩展即时CAM。 PAM通过丰富特定领域的知识,使提示具有适应性,从而确保不同领域的一致解释性,包括具有不同图像特征的领域,如医学成像、微镜成像和遥感成像。 INTR++保留了以可解释变形器为基础的模型的标准架构和端到端的学习,而与"Poan-CAM"相比,仅添加了少量的额外参数. 我们证明,INTR++在动物、植物、医疗成像、显微镜成像、遥感成像和以物体为中心的数据等各个领域的各方面都取得了一致的改进。

articles.title: FastBEVFusion: Simple Multi-Modal Fusion for 3D Object Detection at 50 FPS
articles.content: Reliable real-time 3D object detection based on LiDAR and camera data is critical for safety in autonomous driving, where systems must accurately perceive their surroundings with minimal latency. Many state-of-the-art systems achieve high-quality detection results but fail to meet real-time constraints, limiting their practical use. To address this challenge, we propose FastBEVFusion, a simple, fast, and robust fusion system for 3D object detection. Based on modality-specific features, FastBEVFusion projects these features into semi-aligned modality-specific BEV spaces, without relying on a computationally intensive and potentially error-prone depth estimation. Given these BEV spaces, we propose a light-weight, soft, and dynamic fusion module based on cross-attention, which adapts dynamically to the scene context and enables feature fusion across the entire BEV spaces. Experiments on the complex nuScenes dataset show that FastBEVFusion outperforms state-of-the-art real-time systems, and achieves over 50 FPS without deployment libraries. Additionally, our system shows strong robustness to calibration errors, making FastBEVFusion a powerful 3D object detection system for real-world applications.

articles.title_zh: 快速BEV组合 : 50 FPS 3D 对象检测的简单多模组
articles.content_zh: 基于LiDAR和相机数据的可靠实时3D物体检测对于自主驾驶的安全至关重要,在自主驾驶中,系统必须精确地感知到其周围的地貌并尽量不留情. 许多最先进的系统都取得了高质量的检测结果,但未能满足实时限制,限制了其实际使用. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出FastBEVFusion,一个简单,快速,强健的聚变系统,用于3D对象检测. 基于特定模式的特性,FastBEVFusion将这些特性投放到半相通模式特定的BEV空间中,而不依赖于计算密集而可能发生出错的深度估计. 鉴于这些BEV空间,我们提出一个基于跨心的轻量级,柔和和活性聚变模块,这个模块能动态地适应场景背景,并使得整个BEV空间的特性聚变成为可能. 在复杂的nuScens数据集上进行的实验显示,FastBEVFusion超越了最先进的实时系统,在没有部署库的情况下实现了超过50个FPS. 此外,我们的系统显示出强大的校正出错能力,使得快取BEV Fusion成为适用于现实世界应用的强大的3D对象检测系统.

articles.title: GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
articles.content: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.

articles.title_zh: GCSR-OCC:开放词汇占用预测的几何校正和语义路线
articles.content_zh: Open-vocabulary 3D占用预测代表了场景几何学和语义学在一个统一的voxel网格中,能够超越预先定义的类别进行识别. 一种方法是用3D高斯人重建场景,并把它们转换为活塞占用. 然而,高斯规模膨胀和过度重叠会扭曲voxel占用预测,而语义混合则可能在跨越多类的高斯内部和3D-2D语义特征对接期间出现. 我们提出GCSR-OCC,它结合了几何校正和多模态的查询条件语义路由,用于从单一的RGB图像进行室内占用预测. 证据保护高斯人对占领操作员(EC-G2O)使用内核质量正常化,美元-规范聚合,以及可学习的收益来抑制规模通货膨胀和过度的当地证据积累,同时校正入住反应. 多模式查询-First Gaussian语义查询(MM-QGSR)通过可学习的文本条件路由器,将多语义模式在每高斯语中匹配为文本查询并汇总出特定查询证据为voxel. 精细的子类查询和平滑的语义集合可以进一步精炼出活塞级的预测. 没有3D语义说明,GCSR-OCC在Occ-ScanNet的开通地道占用预测中实现了最先进的性能,有63.31%的几何IoU和27.44%的语义mIoU. 它还会将几何集合的延迟从19.76ms降低到12.88ms. 我们的代码会公开

articles.title: MixSIS: Mixed-supervised instance segmentation
articles.content: Weakly-supervised instance segmentation (WSIS) based on either box-, point-, or image-level annotations has been proposed to overcome the labor-intensive annotation process in fully-supervised instance segmentation. Despite decent results, most WSIS methods only focus on a single annotation level, ignoring that some objects are easy to spot from point annotations, while others require box or even mask annotations. Therefore, we propose the Mixed-Supervised Instance Segmentation (MixSIS) task, which allows a flexible mix of annotation levels (image, point, box, and mask) within a dataset. MixSIS has a high practical relevance, as it allows optimizing the annotation process by annotating challenging objects in more detail, while saving time on simpler instances with less detailed annotations. To address MixSIS, we propose AnnotationsMixer (AnnsMixer) as a baseline. AnnsMixer is a truly mixed-supervised instance segmentation system, which generates pseudo mask annotations from all annotation levels, even mixed within a single image. We evaluate AnnsMixer on both WSIS and MixSIS tasks, largely outperforming state-of-the-art methods. In three case studies, we also demonstrate how the unique features of MixSIS and AnnsMixer can substantially reduce the annotation time (-90%) or improve the results (+34%) in instance segmentation with a simple annotation rule or leveraging heterogeneous data. Our code is available at https://github.com/chwilms/MixSIS

articles.title_zh: MixSIS: 混合监督实例分割
articles.content_zh: 提议根据框、点或图像层面的说明进行薄弱的个案分类(WIS),以克服在完全的个案分类中劳动密集型的注释过程。 尽管取得了好的结果,但大多数信息社会世界峰会的方法只注重单一的注解级别,而忽略了某些物体很容易从点注中被分辨出来,而另一些则需要框注甚至口罩注解. 因此,我们提出混合-超级监督实例分解(MixSIS)任务,允许在一个数据集中灵活组合注释级别(图像、点、框和口罩)。 MixSIS具有很强的实用性,因为它能够通过更详细地注释挑战对象来优化注释过程,同时将时间节省在较不详细注释的更简单的实例上. 为了解决MixSIS问题,我们提议将说明Mixer(英语:AnnsMixer)作为基线. AnnsMixer是一个真正由混合监督的实例分解系统,它从所有注解级别产生伪口罩说明,甚至在一个单一图像中混合. 我们评价AnnsMixer对信息社会世界峰会和信息社会世界峰会的任务,这在很大程度上超过了最先进的方法。 在3个案例研究中,我们还展示了MixSIS和AnnsMixer的独特性如何可以大幅缩短注释时间(-90%)或改进结果(+34%),例如用简单的注释规则进行分解或利用各种数据。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/chwils/MixSIS上查阅。

articles.title: Physics Guided Diffusion Model Based Exposure Interpolation for High Dynamic Range Imaging
articles.content: Ghosting artifacts are an open problem for popular multi-shot based high dynamic range (HDR) imaging. An effective solution is to capture two large-exposure-ratio (LER) standard dynamic range (SDR) images simultaneously via a single-shot. Brightness order reversal (BOR) artifacts are generated when the two LER images are directly fused together. It is crucial to interpolate an image with an exposure time in between the exposure times of two LER images. In this paper, a novel physics-guided diffusion model based exposure interpolation algorithm is proposed to address the BOR artifacts. An initial image is interpolated by a physics-driven component, and the residual high-frequency details are generated by a new diffusion model based component. The new diffusion model is based on the correlation analysis of generative models and includes a new predicted target to reduce the variation of the Pearson correlation between the noisy data and the target, as well as the amplification factor of the fitting error. Compared with existing neural augmented exposure interpolation algorithms on top of convolution neural networks, the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm has an inherent advantage to generate more high frequency information. Experiment results validate the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm.

articles.title_zh: 物理导引扩散模型基于高活性照射的内插 区域映射
articles.content_zh: 幽灵文物对于受欢迎的多镜头高动态范围(HDR)成像来说是一个公开的问题. 一个有效的解决方案是通过一发一发同时捕获出两个大曝光-鼠标(LER)标准动态范围(SDR)图像. 亮度令倒置(BOR)文物在两个LER图像被直接融合在一起时生成. 至关重要的是,在两个LER图像的曝光时间之间将一个图像与曝光时间相插。 在本文中,提出了一个基于曝光插入算法的新型物理导传播模型,以解决BOR文物问题. 初始图像由物理驱动组件插出,剩余高频细节由以新的扩散模型为基础的组件生成. 新的扩散模型以基因模型的关联性分析为基础,并包括了一个新的预测目标来降低吵吵的数据与目标之间的皮尔逊关联的变异,以及适配出错的放大因子. 相较于现有神经增生的接触内插算法上于同分神经网络之上,所拟议的接触内插算法具有产生更高频信息的内在优势. 实验结果验证了拟议的曝光内插算法.

articles.title: MRI-to-CT Translation of Spinal Images via Anatomy-Guided Pseudo-Pairing and Adversarial Diffusion
articles.content:
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is routinely used to diagnose spinal disorders, but surgical planning often requires Computed Tomography (CT) for better visualization of vertebral bone anatomy. Synthesizing CT from MRI could avoid additional radiation exposure and streamline preoperative assessment.
  We propose a three-stage framework for spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. First, an anatomy-guided vertebral matching system identifies similar sagittal MRI and CT slices using spine segmentations and aligns them through rigid registration, creating pseudo-paired data from unpaired scans. Second, these pairs train an adversarial diffusion model for MRI-to-CT translation. Third, synthesized slices are assembled into 3D volumes and refined by a network that improves inter-slice continuity and structural coherence.
  The framework was trained on over 10,000 unpaired sagittal MRI and CT slices and evaluated on 1,911 slices from 83 MRI volumes spanning all spinal regions. Assessment combined distribution-based measures with vertebral segmentation metrics. Compared with diffusion alone, the proposed approach increased binary 3D vertebral Dice from 0.666 to 0.739. Volumetric post-processing reduced visible discontinuities between stacked slices and improved vertebral coherence in axial and coronal views.
  Combining anatomy-guided pseudo-pairing, adversarial diffusion and 3D refinement improves spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. Vertebral matching primarily enhanced anatomical alignment and fidelity, while volumetric refinement improved 3D consistency. These findings support further development of MRI-derived CT-like visualization for preoperative planning, particularly to preserve fine intensity details while maintaining volumetric coherence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过解剖学指导的Pseudo-Pairing和逆向分泌将脊柱图像翻译为MRI-to-CT
articles.content_zh:
磁共振成像(MRI)被例行地用于诊断脊髓紊乱,但外科规划往往需要计算出通心术(CT)才能更好地可视化脊椎骨解剖. 从核磁共振中合成CT可以避免额外的辐射照射并简化操作前的评估.
我们提出脊椎核磁共振至CT合成的三阶段框架。 首先,一个解剖学制导的脊椎对接系统通过脊椎分解来识别出相近的相片核磁共振和CT切片,并通过硬化的登记来对齐,从未分解的扫描中生成出伪的活化数据. 其次,这些对子为核磁共振至CT翻译训练出一种对抗性扩散模型. 第三,被合成的切片被组装为3D卷并被一个网络精炼而来,这个网络可以提高切片间连续性和结构一致性.
该框架接受了1万多块未标清的磁共振和CT片的培训,并评估了从涵盖所有脊柱区域的83个磁共振卷中得出的1 911个片段。 评估以分布为基础的综合措施与脊椎分化指标。 与单传播相比,拟议方法将二进制3D脊椎Dice从0.666增加到0.739. 卷状后处理减少了堆叠片之间的明显不连续,并改进了轴和冠视图中的脊椎一致性.
结合解剖学制导的伪pairing,对抗扩散和3D精细化,可以改善脊椎核磁共振到CT的合成. Vertebral配对主要强化了解剖对接和忠贞性,而音量精细则提高了3D的一致性. 这些研究结果支持进一步发展核磁共振衍生出类似CT的可视化,用于操作前的规划,特别是为了保持精细的强度细节,同时保持体积一致性.

articles.title: MCP-Net: Real-Time Coronary Perception Network and Topological Analysis for Robotic Guidewire Navigation
articles.content: Coronary guidewire navigation during percutaneous coronary intervention requires continuous interpretation of vessel anatomy, guidewire position, and target stenosis under two-dimensional X-ray fluoroscopy. While existing approaches commonly address vessel segmentation or device localization as separate tasks, a robotic system requires a more structured perception of the coronary scene to support downstream navigation. In this work, we present a simulation-driven framework centered on a Multi-Task Coronary Perception Network (MCP-Net) for robotic guidewire navigation, integrating coronary vessel segmentation, vascular topology extraction, and roadmap generation. Starting from three-dimensional coronary CT angiography, we generate simulated fluoroscopy images containing vascular structures, simulated guidewires, stenotic lesions with varying severity, and diverse vascular geometries, together with simulation-derived ground truth. MCP-Net jointly performs coronary vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, and stenosis localization from a single fluoroscopic frame. These predictions are subsequently converted into a structured vascular graph containing centerlines, bifurcations, endpoints, branch directions, and branch angles. By associating the predicted stenosis with this graph, the framework generates a roadmap from the automatically selected graph root toward the target lesion. The results demonstrate that the proposed framework can jointly recover coronary perception targets and transform them into an interpretable vascular representation suitable for downstream robotic navigation.

articles.title_zh: MCP-Net:机器人导线导航实时冕能感知网络和地形分析
articles.content_zh: 近冠干扰期间的冠状导线导航需要在二维X射线含氟镜下持续地解释舰体解剖,导线位置,以及目标快感. 虽然现有方法通常将船舶分出或装置定位作为单独的任务处理,但机器人系统需要对冠状场景有更有组织的感知,以支持下游通航. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了一个模拟驱动的框架,其中心是机器人导线导航的多任务冕能感网络(MCP-Net),其中结合了冠状舰船分解,血管地貌提取和路线图生成. 从三维冠状CT血管造影学开始,我们生成含血管结构、模拟导线、不同严重程度的快感损伤、多种血管几何等模拟成像以及模拟产生的地面真象。 MCP-Net联合进行冠状船分化、导线-尖端本地化以及从单一氟化框架进行快感本地化。 这些预测随后被转换为结构化的血管图,包含中线,双线,端点,分支方向和分支角度. 框架通过将预测的快感与这个图表联系起来,从自动选定的图表根生成一个行进图去向目标损伤. 结果显示,拟议框架可以联合恢复冠状感知目标,并把它们转化为适合下游机器人导航的可解释血管表现.

articles.title: Multibranch Ensemble Head in Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Cucumber Phenological Stage Classification
articles.content: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) pretrained with self-supervised learning, such as DINOv2, provide highly transferable features, yet adapting them to small, domain-shifted datasets is still challenging. We propose a regularizing multibranch ensemble head: a training and inference scheme that pairs low- and high-capacity branches, samples a single branch stochastically at each training step, and averages both branches in probability space at inference. The design adds negligible parameters and essentially no inference overhead over a single heavy head, while improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under data-scarce conditions. Accurate classification of plant growth stages is critical for precision agriculture, enabling timely decisions on fertilization, irrigation, and harvesting. Therefore, as a challenging practical case we use cucumber phenological stage classification, in which flowers and fruits are frequently occluded by foliage, and stage transitions manifest primarily as subtle changes in leaf morphology. The NALEF Food Safety dataset contains images of five cucumber growth stages captured under diverse real-world conditions. On it we evaluate a broad range of backbones, including DINOv2 and DINOv3 ViT and ConvNeXt variants, against strongly supervised counterparts (ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT). The proposed DINOv2 ViT-S with multibranch head achieves a Macro F1 of 0.978 and Cohen's Kappa of 0.971, matching the performance of models more than ten times larger in parameters and GFlops, while requiring only 12.2 GFlops and 22.3M parameters, making it deployable on smartphones and edge devices for phenological stage classification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效花木植物学阶段分类的远景基础模型
articles.content_zh: Vision Foundation Models(VFMs)通过自我监督的学习进行预训,如DINOv2,提供了可高度可转移的功能,然而将其适应于小型的,域位转移的数据集仍然具有挑战性. 我们提出一个规范化的多分支组合头:一个将低能分和高能分对齐的训练和推论方案,在每个训练步骤上抽取一个单一分支的分样,在推断时将两个分支在概率空间中平均. 设计增加了可忽略不计的参数,基本上没有对一头重头进行间接推断,同时在数据稀缺的条件下改进精确效率取舍。 植物生长阶段的准确分类对精准农业至关重要,能够及时就受精、灌溉和收割作出决定。 因此,作为一个具有挑战性的实际案例,我们采用了黄瓜苯基阶段分类法,其中花和果实经常被叶片所吞噬,而相位过渡主要表现为叶子形态的微妙变化. NALEF食品安全数据集包含了在不同的现实世界条件下捕获到的五个黄瓜生长阶段的图像. 就此,我们对照受到严格监督的对口单位(ResNet、高效网、VIT),对包括DINOv2和DINOv3 VIT和ConvNEXt变体在内的一系列骨干进行广泛的评价。 拟议的多分支头部的DINov2 VIT-S实现0.978的Macro F1和0.971的Cohen's Kappa,在参数和GFlops中匹配了十倍多的模型性能,同时只需要12.2 GFlops和22.3M参数,使其可被可被应用在智能手机和边缘设备上来进行苯基相级分级.

articles.title: A First-Step Bias Restores Lost Diversity in Diffusion Model Distillation
articles.content: Distribution-matching distillation enables high-quality image generation in only a few denoising steps. However, distilled student models often map different initial noise samples to similar outputs under the same prompt. To locate where diversity is lost, we compare the teacher and student along the sampling trajectory. The largest measured reduction in the response to different initial noises occurs during the first, high-noise step. When we replace the first step with the teacher's corresponding trajectory and leave the final three student steps unchanged, most of the output diversity returns. This suggests that the first step is a key point for restoring diversity. Motivated by this finding, we introduce \emph{ReSeed}, a post-distillation method that adds a seed-response bias adapter only to the first student step and aligns its velocity with the teacher's first-interval secant velocity. All student weights and later denoising steps remain unchanged. We evaluate ReSeed on three text-to-image models (SD3-Medium, SD3.5-Medium, and FLUX.1-dev) and one text-to-video model (Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B). For a distilled 4-step FLUX.1-dev model, \emph{ReSeed} requires only $0.00196\%$ additional trainable parameters relative to the base model and is trained on 8,000 prompt--noise pairs, while keeping the distilled student fully frozen and requiring no target images, perceptual losses, or adversarial losses. It improves DINO diversity by $48.3\%$ while maintaining competitive visual quality. These results show that substantial diversity can be recovered through a lightweight, data-efficient tuning of only the first denoising step, without finetuning the full student model.

articles.title_zh: 在扩散模式分解中恢复丧失的多样性
articles.content_zh: 分布相匹配的蒸馏能只在几个去诺化步骤中产生出高质量的图像. 然而,被蒸馏出的学生模型往往会将不同的初始噪声样本映射到相同快克下的类似输出. 为了找到多样性丧失的地方,我们比较了师生在采样轨迹上的情况。 不同初始噪声反应中测得的最大减量发生在第一个高噪声步骤. 当我们用老师相应的轨迹来取代第一步,使最后三个学生步骤保持不变,大多数输出多样性返回. 这表明第一步是恢复多样性的关键。 基于这个发现,我们引入了\emph{ReSeed},一种后固态方法,它只为学生的第一步添加了种子反应偏差适配器,并使其速度与老师的第一个相接相接速度一致. 所有学生的权重和后来的去名步骤保持不变. 我们用三个文本到图像模型(SD3-Medium,SD3.5-Medium,和FLUX.1-dev)和一个文本到视频模型(Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B)来评价ReSeed. 对于蒸馏出4步FLUX.1-dev型号,\emph{ReSeed}相对于基准型号,只需要0.00196美元的额外可训练参数,并经过了8000个快速-噪声对等的训练,同时使蒸馏出的学生完全被冷冻并不需要目标图像,知觉损失,或者对抗性损失. 它提高了DINO的多样性,提高了48.3美元,同时保持了有竞争力的视觉质量. 这些结果显示,只有第一个去诺步骤的轻量级,数据效率高的调试,而不对学生的完整模式进行微调,就可以恢复实质性的多样性.

articles.title: SplatScout: Query-Driven Part-Level Referring Segmentation in Gaussian Scenes
articles.content: Existing referring segmentation methods on Gaussian scenes primarily target whole objects, relying on segmenter-generated candidates from which a vision-language model (VLM) selects. Such predetermined fixed candidates may omit fine-grained parts needed as targets or cues for identifying objects. We introduce SplatScout, a query-driven, closed-loop approach that places perception under VLM control. The model actively selects views, directs segmentation, and inspects rendered 3D results to refine its predictions. For part-level evaluation, we introduce PartRef-ScanNet++, comprising 261 manually verified queries across 12 ScanNet++ scenes with mesh-derived ground truth. On PartRef-ScanNet++, SplatScout achieves 0.538 mIoU, substantially outperforming existing methods. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of iterative refinement, while comparisons across VLM backbones highlight the importance of effective tool-feedback utilization. SplatScout also achieves higher scores on four existing referring benchmarks. Code and the PartRef-ScanNet++ benchmark are available at https://github.com/kaust-violab/SplatScout.

articles.title_zh: 浮点数 : 高斯风景中的查询- 驱动分级
articles.content_zh: 高斯场景上现有的参考分解方法主要针对整个对象,依靠分解器生成的候选人,从中选择一个视觉语言模型(VLM). 这种预先确定的固定候选人可以省略作为确定物体的目标或提示所需的精细部分。 我们引入了SplateScout,一种由查询驱动,闭路操作的方法,将感知置于VLM控制下. 该模型积极选择观点,引导分解,并检查得出了3D结果来完善其预测. 对于部分层面的评价,我们引入了Part Ref-ScanNet++,由261个人工核实的询问组成,涉及12个ScanNet++场景,并带有网格衍生出地面真伪. 在 Part Ref-ScanNet ++上, SplateScout 实现了 0.538 mIoU, 表现大大超过现有方法. 缺损表明迭代完善的好处,而跨VLM主干网的比较则突出了有效利用工具的重要性。 平板 童子军还在现有四个参考基准上取得了较高的分数. 代码和参考文件部分ScanNet+++基准可在https://github.com/kaust-violab/SplatScout上查阅。

articles.title: TriDifNet: A Unified Three-Task Diffusion Network for End-to-End RGB-T Perception
articles.content: Infrared--visible (IR--VIS) multi-modal perception supports robust scene understanding under challenging illumination. Infrared and visible images are often misaligned due to platform motion, viewpoint changes, and modality-dependent distortions, causing registration errors to propagate into subsequent fusion and detection stages. We propose TriDifNet, a unified three-task diffusion network for end-to-end RGB-T perception. To the best of our knowledge, TriDifNet is the first diffusion-based network that jointly optimizes registration, fusion, and detection for misaligned RGB-T pedestrian perception. TriDifNet consists of three diffusion-based modules, i.e., the Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM), the Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM), and the Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM). RegDM aligns the unaligned infrared image to the optical reference by estimating a dense deformation field. FusDM performs residual conditional diffusion to generate a detection-oriented fused representation with optical structural cues and complementary infrared saliency. DetDM formulates pedestrian detection as an iterative denoising process in bounding-box space. To couple the three tasks, TriDifNet introduces a closed-loop optimization mechanism, where detection semantics guide fusion and registration, and the fusion result further regularizes geometric alignment. A stage-wise progressive training strategy and a lightweight Nash multi-task learning (Nash-MTL)-based late-stage refinement are further adopted to balance registration, fusion, and detection optimization. Extensive experiments on the KAIST multispectral pedestrian benchmark show that TriDifNet achieves superior downstream detection performance under misaligned RGB-T settings. Against strong system-level competitors, TriDifNet achieves 65.44\% Recall, 57.55\% mAP$_{50}$, and 26.83\% mAP$_{50:95}$.

articles.title_zh: TriDifNet:一个用于端到端RGB-T感知的统一的三任务传播网络
articles.content_zh: 红外可见(IR-VIS)多模式感应支持在有挑战性的照明下进行强力场景理解. 红外线和可见图像往往由于平台运动,观点变化和模式依赖的扭曲而错位相通,导致注册错误被传播到随后的聚变和检测阶段. 我们提议TriDifNet,一个统一的三任务传播网络,用于端到端的RGB-T感知. TriDifNet是第一个基于传播的网络, TriDifNet由三个以扩散为基础的模块组成,即注册分化模块(RegDM),融合分化模块(FusDM)和检测分化模块(DetDM). RegDM通过估计一个密集的变形场来将不相通的红外图像与光学参考物相配合. FusDM进行残留的有条件扩散,以产生以探测为导向并带有光学结构提示和互补的红外光光亮度的引信表示. DetDM在边框空间中将行人检测设定为迭代去名过程. 为了对接这三项任务,TriDifNet引入了闭路优化机制,其中检测语义指导聚变和注册,聚变结果进一步将几何对接规范化. 进一步采用分阶段渐进式培训战略和以纳什为主的轻量级多任务学习(Nash-MTL)后期改进,以平衡登记、聚变和检测优化。 对KAIST多光谱行人基准的广泛实验表明,TriDifNet在RGB-T错配的设置下实现了优异下游检测性能. 对抗强大的系统级竞争者, TriDifNet实现65.44\% 召回,57.55美元/50美元/和26.83美元/50:95美元。

articles.title: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
articles.content: Visual perception is evolving from passive recognition toward active, task-oriented observation. We investigate GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision for learning observation behaviors that transfer beyond interfaces. We introduce LBS (Look Beyond Screens), a vision-language model trained through supervised initialization on teacher-generated GUI grounding trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions. Under fixed inference settings, LBS models based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B consistently improve over their corresponding baselines. Gains beyond supervised fine-tuning transfer to PerceptionBench for both backbones and to HR-Bench and ChartQAPro for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, supporting observation strategies that generalize beyond GUI-specific imitation. Further analysis suggests complementary roles for the two stages: SFT establishes visual inspection primitives, while RL improves their downstream effectiveness. These findings support GUI grounding as a practical supervision paradigm for transferable active visual perception and broader multimodal reasoning. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS and https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/LBS-27B, respectively.

articles.title_zh: 学习面向屏幕之外:从图形用户界面定位中可转移的视觉观测
articles.content_zh: 视觉感知正在从被动的识别演变为主动的、以任务为导向的观察。 我们调查GUI定位作为空间监督的可扩展来源,用于学习超越界面的观测行为。 我们引入了LBS(Look Beyond Screens),这是一个通过在教师生成的GUI地平线上监督初始化培训的视觉语言模型,随后为多回合作物和检查决定进行强化学习. 在固定推论设置下,基于Quen3.5-35B-A3B和Quen3.8-27B的LBS模型 在相应的基线上不断改进。 收益超出监督微调,将骨干和HR-Bench转移到Pereption Bench,以及Qune3.5-35B-A3B的ChartQAPro,支持通用于GUI特定仿真之外的观察战略. 进一步的分析提出两个阶段的互补作用:SFT建立视觉检查原始,而RL则提高其下游有效性. 这些结论支持将GUI作为可转移活性视觉感知和更广泛的多式联运推理的实际监督范式。 我们的代码和模型分别在https://github.com/inclucionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS和https://huggingface.co/inclucionAI/LBS-27B上公开。

articles.title: Systematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding for Representation Learning in Neurodegenerative Diseases
articles.content:
Early identification of neurodegenerative disorders using structural T1-weighted MRI is essential for timely clinical intervention, yet supervised deep learning models often struggle to generalize due to limited annotations and scanner-induced distribution shift. Self-supervised learning offers a promising alternative; however, existing approaches are largely adapted from natural image paradigms, relying on contrastive objectives or generic masked reconstruction with voxel-wise losses, which may not fully capture the distributed morphometric patterns associated with neurodegeneration.
  We introduce SYMBA (SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed for structural brain MRI. SYMBA integrates anatomically constrained masking, a multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM) reconstruction objective, and a progressive curriculum that transitions from local anatomical detail to global brain morphology. These components explicitly incorporate neuroanatomical structure into the self-supervised objective rather than relying on generic image priors.
  Pretrained on 6,953 T1-weighted MRI scans from nine heterogeneous cohorts, SYMBA is evaluated using frozen linear probing on two independent unseen datasets, enabling a strict assessment of out-of-distribution generalization. Across multiple clinical tasks, SYMBA consistently outperforms recent neuroimaging foundation models, achieving 0.930 AUROC for Alzheimer's disease classification, 0.772 for mild cognitive impairment conversion prediction, and strong performance in amyloid status prediction. In low-label regimes, SYMBA demonstrates high sample efficiency, reaching approximately 0.90 AUROC for AD/CN classification using only six labeled subjects.

articles.title_zh: 系统测距 神经性疾病代表性学习的大脑自动编码
articles.content_zh:
利用结构T1加权核磁共振早期识别神经退化性疾病对于及时进行临床干预至关重要,然而,由于说明有限和扫描仪引起的分布转移,受监督的深层学习模型往往难以概括。 自我监督的学习提供了一个有希望的替代方法;然而,现有方法在很大程度上是从自然图像范式中改编而来,依靠对比目标或带有阴道损失的被遮盖的通用重建,可能无法完全捕捉到与神经衰变相关的分布式的摩擦模式.
我们引入了SYMBA(Systematic Morphometer Brain Autoencoding),这是专门为结构脑核磁共振设计的自控预训框架. SYMBA整合了解剖受限的面具,多尺度结构相似性(MS-SSIM)重建目标,以及从局部解剖细节向全球脑形态学过渡的渐进式课程. 这些构件明确将神经解剖结构纳入自控目标,而不是依赖通用图像前作.
对来自9个不同组群的6 953个T1加权核磁共振扫描进行预先培训,SYMBA通过在两个独立的隐形数据集上进行冷冻线性检测来进行评估,从而能够严格评估分布外一般化。 在整个多个临床任务中,SYMBA的性能始终高于最近的神经成像基础模型,在阿尔茨海默氏病分类方面实现了0.930 AUROC,在轻度认知障碍转换预测方面实现了0.772,在酰胺状态预测方面实现了强效. 在低标签制度中,SYMBA显示出高样本效率,对AD/CN分类而言,只有6个标有标有标有标有标有标的的AUROC达到约0.90个AUROC.

articles.title: Quantized Edge Inference of a Self-Supervised SAR-Optical Encoder on Commodity x86 Hardware
articles.content: Self-supervised vision transformers are increasingly used as reusable encoders for Earth observation, but their inference cost on the hardware available in the field is rarely characterized. We deploy a pretrained SAR-optical masked-autoencoder encoder on three commodity x86 nodes, from a low-power CPU without AVX2 to an AVX2+VNNI reference, at FP32, FP16 and INT8 on the CPU and, where present, the integrated GPU, and report latency, energy (RAPL and wall plug) and linear-probe accuracy. Quantization is accuracy-neutral: INT8 changes micro-mAP by only +0.0006, within the seed spread, so precision becomes a pure cost decision. INT8 lowers CPU latency on every node, by 1.45x even on the CPU without AVX2, and CPU energy wherever it is measured, and the VNNI reference (1.53x) suggests a further gain beyond AVX2. The Pareto-optimal device shifts from the integrated GPU, which is 4.38x faster than the CPU on the weakest node, to the CPU as the CPU class improves.

articles.title: Learning to Code the World: Harness Evolution for Compositional 3D Reconstruction
articles.content: Reconstructing editable and compositional 3D scenes from a real image requires jointly reasoning about geometry, object structure, and spatial relationships. We introduce SceneEvolve, a framework that represents 3D scenes as executable code and improves reconstruction by evolving the harness around a small open-source agent. SceneEvolve combines SceneAct, a compositional semantic action interface built on parameterized primitives, hierarchical composition, and semantic spatial relations, with SceneHarness-RSI, which leverages a stronger teacher agent to iteratively evolve the harness using feedback from development-set reconstructions. Throughout harness evolution, the model parameters, action semantics, and execution backend remain fixed. The resulting harness provides a reusable reconstruction procedure that enables the small open-source model to reconstruct unseen scenes without parameter updates or teacher assistance. Across two in-domain datasets and one out-of-domain dataset, SceneEvolve with the comparatively compact Qwen3.8-27B model improves all four evaluated reconstruction metrics while reducing mean inference time by 47.0% relative to the base model. More notably, despite relying on a substantially smaller model, SceneEvolve achieves 32.3% higher reconstruction quality than the large proprietary GPT-5.6-Sol model, while reducing mean equivalent deployment cost by 59.8%. Furthermore, the harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B also generalizes to Kimi-K3, achieving comparable reconstruction performance to GPT-6-Astra. The project page is https://haoyu-agent.github.io/SceneEvolve.

articles.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
articles.content: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.

articles.title_zh: 无缩放 缩放 v2: 从查看细节到通用多模式感知的连接证据
articles.content_zh: 多式联运概念构成了多式联运智能的基础。 特别是,空间感知和多式联运长文理解是体现AI和多式联运代理人的两个关键任务。 然而,为这些任务综合目标明确、高质量的培训数据仍然是困难和昂贵的。 我们的关键洞察力是,这些任务具有一种基本的能力,我们称之为连接证据:确定相关的视觉事实,将它们与正确的实体联系在一起,恢复它们的关系,把它们编成一个答案。 关键是,为这种能力而综合有针对性的培训数据比这些任务本身容易得多。 为了加强这种能力,我们提议采用证据连接(VidenceConnect)这一易于执行的数据综合框架,利用在单一图像中放大的有关区域的观点来产生需要比较、汇总或连锁视觉证据的问题。 为了确保质量,只有在独立的自愿活动清单达成一致时,才保留参考答复,而区域比对测试则放弃了在选定区域被清除后仍能回答的问题。 然后,我们用RLVR对生成的数据进行基础VLM进行训练,在不使用ZwZ2(ZwZ2)的情况下获得Zoming. 虽然综合数据不适应任何下游基准,但ZwZ2改进了精细和空间感知,在体现的空间推理、多式长文理解、多式代理任务和一般视觉推理方面有了进一步的收益。 这些结果将证据连接确立为监督证据联系的有效框架,并表明加强这种共同能力会导致更普遍的多模式观念。

articles.title: GraftRay: Physically Based Mesh Insertion into Gaussian Splatting Scenes via Path Tracing
articles.content: Inserting virtual objects into scenes reconstructed via 2D or 3D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS/3DGS) is a key capability for content creation, AR, and synthetic data generation. However, realistic insertion requires the object to be seamlessly lit by the scene and, conversely, to cast physically plausible shadows onto it. Existing approaches either harmonize appearance in image space, sacrificing multi-view consistency, or approximate scene illumination with an environment map at the insertion point, which cannot represent near-field area lights such as windows and lamps that dominate indoor lighting. To address this, we present GraftRay, a unified method for physically consistent insertion of mesh objects into indoor scenes represented by either 2D or 3D Gaussians. We recover scene materials and surface normals with diffusion-based priors, and explicitly model spatially-extended emitters, solving their radiance in closed form. A hybrid renderer then jointly path-traces the scene Gaussians and inserted meshes, producing view-consistent shading, interreflections, and soft shadows. On FIPT, GraftRay sets a new state of the art, outperforming recent baselines such as ComGS and EAG-PT in rendering fidelity and shadow accuracy, while maintaining highly competitive rendering efficiency.

articles.title_zh: GraftRay:通过路径追踪在高斯大陆镀层中插入物理基网
articles.content_zh: 将虚拟对象插入到通过2D或3D高斯平板重建的场景中(2DGS/3DGS)是内容生成,AR,和合成数据生成的关键能力. 然而,现实的插入要求物体被现场无缝地点燃,反之,将物理上可信的阴影投入其中. 现有方法要么将图像空间的外观相统一,牺牲多视图的一致性,要么在插入点用环境图进行近似场景照明,这不能代表以室内照明为主的窗户和灯光等近地区域灯光. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了GraftRay,一种在物理上一致地将网状物体插入由2D或3D高斯人代表的室内场景的统一方法. 我们回收场景材料和表面常态,以扩散为主的前兆,并明确模拟空间延伸的发射器,以封闭的形式解决它们的光能. 混合渲染器随后联合追踪了场景高斯人并插入了 meshes,产生了与景色相符合的阴影,相互折射,和柔软的阴影. 在FIPT上,GraftRay设定了一种新的技术水平,在保持高度竞争性的渲染效率的同时,在提供忠诚度和阴影精确度方面优于ComGS和EAG-PT等近期基线。

articles.title: Interpretable Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Diagnosis Using Medical Imaging
articles.content: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用医学成像法进行乳腺癌诊断的可解释的深层学习模式
articles.content_zh: 深入的学习显示了乳腺癌诊断的希望,但有限的可解释性阻碍了临床的采纳. 我们以10个图像网预限模型(ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、OxilNet、ConvNeXt、VIT和Swin Transformer)为基准,利用患者的分级方法,对断裂式组织病理数据集进行良性与恶性分类,并用Grad-CAM、LIME、综合梯度和LRP来解释其预测。 DenseNet121的性能最好,测试精度为99.4%,AUC-ROC为0.999,并显著地超过了所有其他型号(p < 0.001)。 基于变形器的模型跟随有线电视新闻网. 这些解释始终强调具有诊断相关性的多核体和腺体区域。 因此,将转移学习与可解释的人工智能结合起来,可以产生准确、可解释的乳腺癌诊断工具。

articles.title: Ground-to-Satellite Knowledge Distillation for Crop Classification under Temporal and Geographic Shift
articles.content: Continuous and up-to-date crop type mapping is essential for agricultural monitoring but is often hampered by limited reference data. The growing availability of ground-level field photographs offers a promising way to address this challenge. When combined with satellite time series, these images provide complementary perspectives on the same parcel, capturing crop characteristics from distinctly different perspectives. However, field photographs are not always available for each satellite pixel at inference time, limiting their potential in scalable crop type mapping. We investigate whether ground photographs can provide privileged supervision for crop classification built on pretrained satellite embeddings. A photo teacher based on frozen CLIP features supervises classifiers trained on AlphaEarth and TESSERA representations; photographs are used only during training. On a paired field photo and satellite imagery dataset with 17 crop classes, knowledge distillation consistently improves over satellite-only classification; for frozen embeddings the margin grows under temporal shift, reaching up to +5.5 macro-F1 points, and widens in geographic holdouts (+3.7 vs +3.0 in-distribution). These results show that ground-view supervision can complement satellite embeddings and improve their robustness without changing inference requirements.

articles.title_zh: 根据时间和地理变化对作物分类进行地对地知识稀释
articles.content_zh: 持续和最新的作物类型测绘对农业监测至关重要,但往往受到有限参考数据的阻碍。 地面实地照片越来越多,为应付这一挑战提供了有希望的途径。 这些图像与卫星时间序列相结合,为同一个包裹提供了互补的视角,从截然不同的视角捕捉作物特征。 然而,在推算时间并不总是可以获得每个卫星像素的实地照片,这限制了其在可伸缩作物类型的绘图方面的潜力。 我们调查地面照片是否能够对利用预先训练过的卫星嵌入的作物分类提供特权监督。 一个基于被冻结的CLIP特性的相片教师监督接受过阿尔法地表和TESSERA表示法培训的分类人员;照片只在培训期间使用. 在一个配对的有17个作物类的野外相片和卫星图像数据集上,知识分馏比仅用卫星分类不断改进;对于被冻结的嵌入物,比值在时间变化后会增加,达到+5.5个宏观-F1分点,在地理阻力上会扩大(+3.7对+3.0分流)。 这些结果表明,地面观测监督可以补充卫星嵌入并提高其稳健性而不会改变推论要求。

articles.title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. Because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill, this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: V-LUMEN:在视觉语言模型中嵌入缩放的视觉搜索记忆
articles.content_zh: 嵌入级的缩放通过基于取景的内存来扩展语言模型的能力,而不是通过增加模型的深度,宽度,或密集的计算来扩展. 将这个想法扩展至视觉语言模型(VLMs)具有挑战性,因为视觉特征是连续的,空间结构化的,并且依赖查询,与自然支持n克取景的离散文本符号不同. 我们介绍V -LUMEN, 一个视觉的查看记忆 VLMs。 V-LUMEN将可视特征用被冷冻的编码本进行盘片化,通过基于空间聚合的散列来构建空间意识内存键,并用文本条件的关联信号来调节;所有地址都是非参数化的,被取回的嵌入通过有门的剩余通道被熔接入骨干. 在五个推理密集型基准上,V-LUMEN大大改进了被冻结的Qune3-VL-2B主干线,并将零射入三个基准,其图像与培训数据脱节。 在相匹配的参数预算中,将LORA或MOE适配器的部分容量移入V-LUMEN上保留了两个主干线上的精度,表明外视内存是一个独立的容量轴而不是更强的适应方法. 因为表大小不变,而且只在预填时发生一次,所以这种容量在存储而不是每盘计算时会增长. 代码见https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen。

articles.title: RePAIR: Inverting Backdoor Attacks in Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Despite significant advances in computer vision, semantic segmentation models remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks, posing a security risk. These attacks redirect pixels of a chosen victim class to an attacker-specified target class when a trigger is present, while preserving clean predictions. Existing defenses are largely derived from image classification, while dedicated segmentation defenses remain scarce and typically require retraining or model modification. We introduce RePAIR, a post-hoc, label-free, attack-unaware defense based on the observation that backdoor-induced shifts can be stronger in the classifier head than in internal representations, leaving recoverable victim-class semantics. RePAIR infers the victim-target relation from an unlabeled, potentially contaminated image pool, constructs a safety-approved semantic reference, and localizes suspicious pixels by comparing head predictions with internal semantic evidence. It then applies feature-space and output corrections toward the inferred victim semantics, while conservative localization and output constraints limit changes to benign predictions. We model the attack as adversarial probability transport and repair as its approximate reversal, deriving bounds and sufficient conditions for localization, residual attack success, clean-side changes, defense-induced target predictions, and attack-unaware pair identification. Experiments across segmentation architectures and attack settings show that RePAIR substantially reduces attack success while largely preserving clean performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RePAIR: 语义分裂中反向后门攻击
articles.content_zh: 尽管在计算机视觉方面取得了重大进展,语义分解模型仍然容易受到后门攻击,造成了安全风险. 这些攻击将选择的受害者类的像素在触发器出现时重定向到攻击者指定的目标类,同时保留了干净的预测. 现有的防御主要出自于图像分类,而专用分解防御仍然很少,通常需要再培训或模型修改. 我们引入了RePAIR,一种后热,无标签,攻击-unaware的防守,基于以下观察,即后门引发的转向在分类头部比内部代表部更强,留下了可恢复的受害者类语义. REPAIR推断出未加标签、可能受污染的图像池中的受害人-目标关系,构建了安全核准的语义参考,通过将头部预测与内部语义证据进行比较,将可疑像素本地化。 然后,它将特征空间和输出校正适用于被推断出的受害者语义,而保守的局部化和输出限制限制了良性预测的变化. 我们把攻击作为敌方概率的迁移和修复作为大概的倒转, 得出局部化的界限和足够条件, 残余的攻击成功, 干净的侧面变化, 防御引起的目标预测, 以及攻击-无意识的对称识别。 跨分解架构和攻击设置的实验显示,RePAIR在基本保持清洁性能的同时会大幅降低攻击成功.

articles.title: GPA-VGGT: Geometry-Preserving Acceleration of VGGT
articles.content: Feed-forward geometry models such as VGGT recover camera parameters, depth maps, and point maps from one to hundreds of views in a single forward pass, making them powerful backbones for multi-view 3D perception. However, VGGT's global attention is quadratic in the number of frames and dominates end-to-end runtime on long sequences, which has motivated a range of training-free efficiency methods such as token merging. These methods, however, come with a drop in accuracy that makes them hard to use in place of VGGT. We propose GPA-VGGT, a training-free acceleration method that replaces global attention in early blocks with frame attention augmented by a shared cross-frame K/V set. In the remaining blocks, we merge only keys and values while preserving all queries, restore the attention mass of the tokens each merged key represents, and randomly project the matching metric to 128 dimensions to reduce matching cost. Across diverse multi-view geometry tasks, GPA-VGGT provides training-free acceleration at speedups comparable to prior work while preserving the information required for precise geometric estimation, retaining over 99% of VGGT's pose accuracy under AUC@3.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GPA-VGGT: 几何-保存 VGGT加速
articles.content_zh: VGGT等Feed-forward几何模型恢复相机参数,深度图,和点地图在单个前行通道中从一到上百个视图,使其成为多视图3D感知的强大骨干. 然而,VGGT的全球关注量在帧数上是四分之一,在长序上主导了端到端的运行时间,这激发出一系列无训练效率方法,如符号合并. 然而,这些方法的准确性下降,使它们很难被取而代之。 我们建议采用GPA-VGGT这一无培训加速方法,在早期将全球注意力取而代之的是框架注意力,并由共用的跨框架 K/V 集来强化。 在所剩的块中,我们只合并了密钥和值,同时保留了所有的查询,恢复了每个被合并的密钥所代表的符号的注意质量,并随机投射匹配的公分量到128维来降低匹配成本. 在各种多视图几何任务中,GPA-VGGT提供与以前工作相仿的无培训加速,同时保留精确几何估计所需的信息,保留了在AUC@3下VGGT的99%以上的平面精度.

articles.title: LearnPrunerV2: Learnable Progressive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal capabilities but suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to the massive number of visual tokens. While token pruning is a promising solution, existing methods still suffer from two major drawbacks: 1) unreliable pruning criteria that fail to accurately localize task-specific regions due to inherent attention biases or query-agnostic designs, and 2) suboptimal pruning strategies that employ rigid, non-adaptive schedules, overlooking the dynamic evolution of token redundancy across different model depths. To address these challenges, we propose LearnPrunerV2, which extends the previous two-stage heuristic framework (LearnPruner) into a fully learnable architecture. Specifically, we integrate lightweight learnable modules into every layer of the VLM backbone, which estimate token importance by fusing intrinsic visual saliency with extrinsic query relevance captured via a shadow token. By uncovering a consistent staircase redundancy pattern across VLM layers, we further introduce Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP) to establish a hardware-friendly schedule with fixed per-layer budgets. Extensive experimental results across various benchmarks and VLMs demonstrate that LearnPrunerV2 consistently outperform previous state-of-the-art methods. Notably, LearnPrunerV2 preserves 99.8% of the original performance when pruning 77.8% of visual tokens on LLaVA-v1.5, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
