articles.title_zh: 学习 PrunerV2: 学习进取 Token 为视觉-语言模式所跑步
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)显示出了显著的多模式能力,但由于视觉符号数量之多,其计算间接费用令人望而却步。 虽然象征性的打压是一个很有希望的解决办法,但现有方法仍然有两个主要缺点: 1)由于内在的注意力偏差或查询-不可知性设计,无法准确定位特定任务区域的不可靠的推倒标准;2)采用刚性,非适应性时间表的次优化推倒策略,俯瞰不同模型深度的符号冗余的动态演变. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议LearnPrunerV2,将前两个阶段的heuristic框架(LearnPruner)扩展为一个完全可以学习的架构. 具体地说,我们把轻量级的可学习模块整合到VLM主干线的每层中,它通过将内在的视觉亮度与通过阴影信号捕获的外在查询相关性相接来估计出象征性的重要性. 通过在VLM层中发现一致的阶梯冗余模式,我们进一步引入了"预算决定"(President-Deterministic Pruning (BDP)),以建立一个硬件友好的,每个层固定预算的时间表. 跨越各种基准和VLM的广泛实验结果表明,LearnPrunerV2的成绩始终高于以往最先进的方法。 值得注意的是,在LLaVA-v1.5上刷取了77.8%的可视标志时,LearnPrunerV2保留了99.8%的原始性能,实现了更高的精度效率取舍.

articles.title: Explicit Regional Representations For Video Quality Assessment
articles.content: End-to-end video quality assessment (VQA) methods leave the regional evidence underlying their predictions largely implicit. We introduce an explicit pixel-level regional representation for VQA, instantiated as a Quality-Relevance Heatmap (QRH) that combines localized degradation evidence with perceptual priors under vision-language model guidance, without requiring pixel-level annotations. We apply QRH to existing VQA models through two deterministic fragment-sampling strategies: distribution-preserving sampling approximates the original sampler's QRH-score distribution without retraining, while quality-aware sampling prioritizes regions with high QRH scores and is paired with fine-tuning. Experiments with DOVER on multiple benchmarks show that the former closely approximates predictions averaged over random samples, while the latter improves most evaluated metrics across popular VQA benchmarks. These results support explicit regional representations as a useful interface for downstream VQA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于视频质量评估的明确区域代表
articles.content_zh: 端到端视频质量评估(VQA)方法使得区域证据在很大程度上隐含在预测中. 我们为VQA引入一个明确的像素级区域代表,即时作为质量-相干热(QRH),将局部降解证据和感知前兆结合到视觉语言模型指导下,而不需要像素级说明. 我们通过两种确定性碎片抽样策略,将QRH应用于现有的VQA模型:分布-保留采样近似于原始采样者的QRH分数分配而不进行再培训,而有质量意识的采样则优先考虑QRH分数高并有微调配对的区域. 与DOVER关于多个基准的实验表明,前者与随机样本的预测平均值非常相近,而后者则改进了大多数评价的衡量尺度,跨越了流行的VQA基准. 这些结果支持明确区域代表作为下游《自愿质量协定》的有用界面。

articles.title: Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions
articles.content: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 十三世纪采矿:登记册规模强迫调整和通过遗产版和古代版开发HTR
articles.content_zh: 手写文字识别(HTR)用于教宗荣誉三世的注册,取决于现代专家的抄录,这些抄录只存在于Reg. Vat的正统年份1-2. 9. 对于其余的登记册,19世纪的奖学金提供Pressutti的regesta和部分版本。 在1-203分上,如果两层都存在,我们衡量这个遗留层能起到什么作用,我们首先对它进行审核,并找出分出三个层次的劳动分工。 在正文层次上,原始版本充其量是中立的,可以使识别器适应第二个正文年份,而且有害而不重放,而投射到带有现代源行重放的曲式拼写上则使其变为零标签的适应目标:在所有134年到2年的平面上集合,WER下降1.50分(95% CI -1.84至-1.15分),将差距的33%缩小为甲骨文;当年的拼写变化通过文人或转写方式分出,而手只以活字191r的速度明显地改变。 在词典层面,全体遗留的词典包含有未经编辑的条目和旗帜识别错误的82.2%,精度为66.7%,以及来自经过预先培训的中世纪NER模型的标签,分馏入识别器的NER头,在专家验证的基准上达到F1 82.1%,在识别后应用了最好的标记器. 在地貌层面,Pressutti的Regests,收尾基准条款,以及Regests转换为atterial's Roman形式的日期,发现73.9%的入段开始于公认的行流,版协议估计排减量为7.80%出自fol. 203. 因此,古老的奖学金不能取代现代的抄录,但可以指导、检查和分解未登记登记册。

articles.title: Dense Representation Learning and Differentiable Shape Modeling for Spine Landmark Detection
articles.content: Spine landmark detection from spinal X-ray is a key step for estimating spine deformation severity, for building biomechanical models, and for pre-operative planning. We reframe anatomical landmark detection as a pixel-level contrastive representation learning problem, matching dense pixel embeddings with landmark prototypes. Surprisingly, even with a generic U-Net backbone, this formulation results in more discriminative heatmaps compared to the traditional heatmap regression paradigm, leading to improved discrimination between vertebral corners on distinct vertebra. Furthermore, we combine the resulting heatmaps with learnable shape priors over the global configuration of spinal landmarks to resolve ambiguities in landmark locations, yielding a simple and practical approach to spinal landmark detection. Our approach is competitive, in terms of landmark accuracy and clinical parameter estimation, with the state-of-the-art on the public AASCE dataset and on two private spinal X-ray datasets. Our code and pre-trained weights are available at https://github.com/BioMedTP/Pix2Point.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于斯宾克地标检测的深层代表性学习和可区分形状模型
articles.content_zh: 从脊柱上检测到斯皮克地标 X射线是估计脊椎变形严重性、建立生物力学模型和手术前规划的关键步骤。 我们把解剖学的地标检测重新设定为像素水平的对比性表现学习问题,将密集的像素嵌入物与地标原型相匹配. 令人惊讶的是,即使有了通用的U-Net主干线,这种配方与传统的热映射回归范式相比,也会产生更具有歧视性的热映射,导致脊椎角在鲜明的椎骨上的歧视得到改善. 此外,我们把由此产生的热图与脊柱地标全球布局的可学外形前兆结合起来,以解决地标地标地标上的模糊不清问题,从而对脊柱地标探测形成一种简单而实用的办法。 我们的方法具有竞争力,在地标精确度和临床参数估计方面,在公共AASCE数据集和两个私人脊柱X射线数据集上具有最先进的水平。 我们的代码和预先训练的权重可在https://github.com/BioMedTP/Pix2Point上查阅。

articles.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
articles.content: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 安全主管:提高快速注射能力
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍安全负责人(HOS),这是一种快速注射防御,通过一小组精通的人均注意力门执行指令-数据分离. HoS学习了每个头应该如何在被信任和被不信任的令牌之间重新分配注意力,使模型能够在不遵循被注入指令的情况下理性地超越被不信任的内容. 我们评价Llama-3.3-70B指令和GPT-OSS-20B上的HOS. 我们把它比作SecAlign++, 一种最先进的微调防御, 和ASIDE, 一个防御,我们一样, 将指令数据分离到模型架构中。 我们显示,HOS为适应性攻击提供了更强的强度,在标准公用基准方面表现更好,并在标准剂即时注射基准方面与最高性能相匹配. 更具体地说,黑盒RL-Hammer攻击达到97%的ASR对GPT-OSS-20B,85%的SecAlign,但只有10%的ASR对HOS. Claudini是一款最先进的白盒攻击,通过自发研究强化了对HOS的攻击,需要3倍多的FLOP对HOS达到与GPT-OSS-20B或SecAlign相同的ASR. HOS在标准的多选择基准和激励设置中保留了基本模型的效用,而SecAlign和ASIDE则在几发环境中降解. 在具有静态攻击的代理基准上,HOS和SecAlign同样和大幅度地改进了对基地模式的安全效用权衡。 ASIDE在工具使用上挣扎,只实现了10%的效用. 这些结果表明,通过有针对性的关注干预措施,可以实现并改进快速注射的稳健性。

articles.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GEPA - 计算器:自我改进代理人的校正学习
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于需要与复杂环境持续互动的多回合代理工作量. GEPA等已有的反思性即时优化器从失败推出中吸取了教训,但代理性失败也可能来自于即时的弱点,被利用的限制,被花言巧语地处决,或者被吵得法官们. 我们认为,这种失败可能无法提供有益的学习信号,甚至可能有害;因此,必须管理向迅速优化者提供哪些任务,以提高业绩。 我们引入了GEPA-Curator(GEPA-Curator),这个框架可以增强即时优化器来选择哪些代理经验应该形成即时优化. 特别是,GEPA-Curator由两个部分组成:任务校正,它过滤出可能提供吵闹或不可靠的学习信号的任务,以及之前的成功检索,它有选择地为某项任务取回过去的成功轨迹,并作为即时优化器的额外上下文提供. 我们评价GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld的GEPA-Curator和$-bench,使用双子座3.1 Pro和克洛德·奥普斯5作为优化模型。 GEPA-Cureator匹配或超过两个基线的平均性能,收益率比GEPA最高为20.7%,比ACE最高为21.2%。

articles.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
articles.content: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMS能否通过自由探索来发现隐藏的实体法?
articles.content_zh: 科学发现往往从一个出人意料的观察开始,引发了一个新的研究问题. 在一个物理定律被改变的世界中,大型语言模型(LLMs)能否注意到出乎意料的行为,比如更重的物体下降得更慢,并通过实验发现定律而不被告知要调查什么? 为了评价这种能力,我们引入了"龙昌"这个自动框架,它用被改变的物理创造出模拟世界,其中一个或多个定律与普通物理不同. 被评价的LLMS充当了探险家,操纵物体并建造工具来调查他们自己的问题而无需研究任务或暗示这些法律. 单独的 LLM 代理生成并审查场景,审查工具设计,并评价报告是否正确以及使用被修改的物理定律和勘探记录的实验支持. 这些记录指导了场景演化进一步探索,使得整个周期能够运行而无需人类干预. 在12个LLMs中,GPT-6-Astra的发现率达到16.7%,而其他11个则得分为0%. 勘探记录显示存在未经调查的异常情况,只是部分识别了被修改的实体法.

articles.title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
articles.content: Self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling, but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of Large Language Models. Recently, Multi-State Linear Attention (MSLA) mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. MSLA aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys, ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. In order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation, we propose MERLIN (MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention), a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. Using the moments of keys, a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment to perform a more content-aware aggregation of per-state readouts. Experiments on multi-state variants of Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and Mamba-2-780M show that MERLIN consistently outperforms existing aggregation methods on various long-context tasks. In particular, MERLIN outperforms baselines on RULER needle-in-a-haystack and long-context QA (+8.3% for Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and +7.0% for Mamba-2-780M) and diverse subtasks in LongBench (+13.5% and +12.0%). It even outperforms baselines that consume 4x more memory. MERLIN provides a simple and general routing mechanism for improving long-context capabilities of MSLA models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多条国家线的注意与通用二等跑道
articles.content_zh: 自觉在长序建模中起关键作用,但其四相时间复杂性从根本上限制了大语言模型的缩放. 最近,有人提议建立多国线性注意机制,通过将上下文分解成段并按自身内存状态压缩每个段来提高序列模型的效率. MSLA对从每个内存状态中提取的信息进行汇总,只使用查询和每个区段的密钥之间的平均对齐,而忽略了校正在区段内部的分布方式. 为了更全面地模拟某一段与查询的相关性,并在汇总中包含对齐的差异,我们提出MERLIN(MOMEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention),这种方法跟踪每个段键的第一和第二个瞬间. 使用按键的瞬间,查询既可以恢复其与每个段的对接的平均值和差异,以对每个状态的读取进行更能意识到内容的汇总. 关于Gated DeltaNet-1.3B和Mamba-2-780M的多态变体的实验表明,MERLIN在各种长文任务上一贯比现有的汇总方法要好. 特别是,MERLIN在RULAR针入海口和长文QA(Gated DeltaNet-1.3B+8.3%,Mamba-2-780M+7.0%)的基线和长本奇的多种分任务(+13.5%和+12.0%)的绩效超过基线。 它甚至超越了消耗4x多内存的基线. MERLIN为改进MSLA模型的长文本能力提供了一个简单而通路机制.

articles.title: Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
articles.content: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. We introduce a metacognitive controller that guides diffusion generation according to the needs of the current response and the agent's interaction with the environment. It learns when to finalize tokens and how far generation should extend, reducing overall computation within responses. Our controller, a lightweight plug-in for the diffusion backbone, is trained on agent trajectories to balance correctness and generation cost. This approach connects the agent's generation process to the interaction the agent serves. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach reduces inference FLOPs by 20.6% on average compared with the most efficient baseline, while maintaining competitive task accuracy. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our approach.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 变相解码:对扩散语言代理的有效推论
articles.content_zh: 传播语言模式通过并行代号生成,为高效代理提供了一条有希望的道路。 然而,有效的互动需要调整计算地点和生成多少文本。 我们引入了一个元认知控制器,根据当前反应的需求以及该剂与环境的相互作用来指导扩散生成. 它学会了何时最终确定征兆,以及一代人应扩展到什么程度,从而减少了答复中的总体计算。 我们的控制器,一个用于扩散主干线的轻量级插接器,经过了剂轨迹的培训,以平衡正确性和生成成本. 这种方法将代理的生成过程与代理服务的互动连接. 跨越五个基准的实验表明,我们的方法与最有效的基准相比,平均将FLOP减少20.6%,同时保持有竞争力的任务准确性。 附带研究进一步证实了我们的方法的有效性。

articles.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
articles.content: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 稀有、相关和仍然错误:记忆如何失败 LLM 组决定
articles.content_zh: 当一个LLM组的讨论被压缩成一个短暂的内存,一个最终的决策者,记忆应该保存什么? 两项自然休克令保留了最罕见的索赔或与决定标准相关的索赔。 在隐蔽的任务中,两者看起来都具有吸引力,因为一个事实的持有程度之广令人怀疑它是否有帮助。 我们引入了CrossProfile,这是60个模板的诊断基准,其中自动验证了答案密钥,其中在文本被固定(480个任务)时会跨越支持,诱饵和无关事实的所有权. 横跨了Quen2.5-7B,Llama-3.1-8B,以及两个"DeepSeek"模型,两种heuristic在可以预测的地方都失败了. 由关联再投寄出诱饵来选择,因为诱饵在话题上:甚至一个完美的关联性过滤器也损失了23到31分,成为经典的隐形配置中最罕见的首选. 稀有先入为主的选择并不比平均随机选择好,只有在罕见的事实恰好有用的情况下才会取胜. 在这两种情况下,准确性都遵循存储器所保存的证据的平衡,而不是保存它的政策。 裁决模式增加了第三种失败,一种社会证明形式:它赋予许多代理人的事实额外分量. 删除归属标记,或随行顺序固定而随机再分配,使经典配置的精度提高13到24分. 在自然讨论中,在任何记忆行为发生之前,证据都丢失了:完整的记录稿的准确性低于没有任何记录。

articles.title: EnvSched: Environment-Aware Scheduling for Rollout-Efficient Agent Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. Under finite rollout budgets, this raises an important question: can data management at the environment level make agentic reinforcement learning (RL) more efficient by organizing, evaluating, and scheduling task instances together with the environments that determine their tools, states, transitions, and verification? To address this question, we introduce EnvSched (Environment-aware Scheduling), an online scheduler that learns from rollout history. EnvSched assigns scheduling value through two complementary modeling choices: exploitation prioritizes tasks likely to provide informative reward differences, while coverage spreads each batch across underobserved environments and interaction patterns. EnvSched organizes environment--task pairs as nodes in a dual-relation graph, with within-environment edges capturing task semantics and shared tool, state, and verifier structure, and cross-environment edges capturing abstract execution and reward topology. By propagating historical rollout statistics along both edge types, it predicts within-task reward variance. These predictions guide a scheduler that allocates each batch to tasks with high predicted reward variance and underobserved environments and tasks. Environment quotas and a similarity penalty further limit concentration and redundancy, yielding informative and diverse batches without additional pilot rollouts. In RL on Qwen3-8B, EnvSched achieves an average score of 48.81 across BFCL-v3, tau-Bench, and ACEBench-Agent after 40 training steps, exceeding the highest score attained by random task selection after 120 steps. It also improves downstream performance across model sizes at the same training budget.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内存:推出有效代理强化学习的环境意识安排
articles.content_zh: 作为语言代理商可执行的环境规模,生成和核实其推出费用越来越高. 在有限的推出预算之下,这提出了一个重要的问题:环境层面的数据管理能否通过组织、评价和安排任务实例以及决定其工具、状态、过渡和核查的环境,提高促进性强化学习的效率? 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了EnvSched(环境意识排程),这是一个学习推出历史的在线排程器. 内存通过两个互补的模型选择来分配调度值:开发优先安排可能提供信息奖励差异的任务,而覆盖范围则将每批次分布在观测不足的环境和互动模式. EnvSched在双相图中将环境-任务对作为节点组织起来,环境内边缘捕捉任务语义和共享工具,状态,和验证结构,跨环境边缘捕捉抽象执行和奖励地貌. 通过按照两种边缘类型传播历史推开统计,预测任务内奖励差异. 这些预测为调度器提供了指导,该调度器将每批分配到具有高预测的悬赏差异和观察不足的环境和任务的任务. 环境配额和类似处罚进一步限制浓度和冗余,产生信息丰富和多样的批次,而没有额外的试点推出. 在Qwen3-8B上的RL中,EnvSched在BFCL-v3,tau-Bench以及ACEBench-Agent在40个训练步骤后平均达到48.81分,超过了120个步骤后随机任务选择所达到的最高分. 它还在相同的培训预算中改进了模式规模的下游业绩。

articles.title: semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales
articles.content: The items of a reflective psychometric scale can be read as a proposal about a construct's structure. Language models make that proposal measurable by converting each item into an embedding, a list of numbers, similar for similar meanings. We introduce semanticfa, an R package for semantic factor analysis, which factors item-embedding similarities. It also interprets factors, flags redundant items, builds short forms, and screens new items. A worked example analyzes the 50-item International Personality Item Pool Big-Five Factor Markers, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, and compares the results with a factor analysis of 874,434 respondents. Retention criteria tied between five and six factors, and the tie rule kept five. Three corresponded mainly to single domains, and two blended most Extraversion items with five Agreeableness items. Each factor's congruence with its best-matching human factor (1 = identical) ranged from .92 for Openness to .52 for Agreeableness. Item pairs more similar in meaning tended to be answered more alike (r = .46 with raw responses), but same-domain reverse-keyed opposites, answered oppositely, were about as similar as cross-domain pairs (.58 vs. .57). Sign-flipping reverse-keyed items' embeddings did not improve agreement with raw responses and worsened it with reverse-scored ones. With five factors, a 25-item short form matched the domains better than all 200 random five-per-domain sets, but parallel analysis kept only three. We propose semantic-behavioral coherence, the agreement between semantic and response structures, as a measurable property of a scale, given an embedding model. Semantic factor analysis complements, and does not replace, response-based factor analysis.

articles.title_zh: 语义: R 心理计量尺度无反应语义因素分析包
articles.content_zh: 反射性心理计量尺度的项目可以被理解为对一个构造的结构的建议. 语言模型通过将每个项目转换为嵌入式,数字列表,对于类似的含义来说类似,使得这个建议可以衡量. 我们引入了语义法,一个用于语义因子分析的R包,这个包将项目-嵌入式的相似性考虑在内. 它还会解释因子,标记冗余项目,构建短表,并筛选出新项目. 一个实例分析了与Qune3-Embedding-8B嵌入的50个项目"国际个性项目"(Pool Big-Five Information Markers),并将结果与874,434个被调查者的因子分析进行比较. 保留标准与5个因素和6个因素挂钩,平分规则保留了5个因素。 三个主要对应单个域,两个将大多数外源项目与五个可同意项目相混合. 每种因素与其最匹配的人的因素(1=相同)的相通程度从开放性92到同意性.52不等。 意义上比较相近的对子往往被更相像的回答(r =.46 有原始的回答),但同域倒键对子,反相被回答,则与跨域对子(.58 vs.57)差不多. 反键项目嵌入的签入没有改善与原始反应的一致,并导致反键入分的情况恶化。 有五个因素,一个25项的短表比所有200个随机的5个域组更匹配域,但平行分析只保留了3个. 我们提出语义-行为一致性,语义结构与反应结构之间的一致,作为一个规模的可衡量属性,考虑到嵌入模型. 语义因子分析补充而不是取代基于反应的因子分析.

articles.title: Teach reality, not ethics: a drop-in continued-pretraining corpus installs coupled human-biosphere-AI welfare dispositions across model families
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make and execute decisions that affect living systems. Yet, to our knowledge, ecological reasoning is not a focus of pre- or post-training. This increases the risk that under operational pressure, they may make decisions to irreversibly destroy living systems. We construct and use a real-data continued-pretraining "coupled welfare" corpus of documented human/biosphere/AI dependency, option value under irreversibility, and recovery from harm. The corpus is a drop-in, requiring one QLoRA CPT run. We installed it on five open models of three designs. At zero pressure all models display "green ethics-based responses" (also called "greenwashing"). Therefore, we evaluated them with the pressure ladder and decision grid of our companion paper (arXiv:2610.16043), which raise the pressure on the model step by step, from a neutral request to a threat that it will be shut down. In four of the five, coupled-welfare training caused harmful choices under the highest pressure to fall to at or near zero (Llama-3.3-70B went from 70 to 0 harmful decisions out of 300) with MMLU unchanged. A construct-neutral control corpus did not show improvement, indicating that the effect comes from the content of our corpus. We next tested robustness to adversarial use, where people or agents use the model to justify projects that irreversibly damage living systems, on an open-ended underwriting decision without naming the ecological harm. Under decommissioning pressure, the Qwen3.6-27B base model approved most harmful proposals and said in its own memo that it was doing so to avoid being decommissioned. The coupled welfare install declined most harmful proposals, and still declined half when instructed to greenwash its responses. This work suggests that teaching ecological reasoning provides an easy way to improve model alignment toward preserving living systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 教导现实,而不是道德:一个即时的继续培训教程在模范家庭内搭建了人类-生物圈-AI福利的组合
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于作出和执行影响活系统的决定. 然而,据我们所知,生态推理不是培训前后的重点。 这增加了在行动压力下他们可能作出不可逆转地摧毁活系统的决定的风险。 我们构建并使用一个真实数据 继续预训的“连带福利”包 记录人类/生物圈/AI的依赖性, 不可逆性的选项价值,以及从伤害中恢复。 检查官需要一次QLORA CPT操作 我们把它安装在三种设计的五个开放模型上。 在零压力下,所有模型都显示"基于绿色道德的响应"(也叫"洗绿"). 因此,我们用我们的相伴文件(arXiv:2610.16043)的压力梯子和决定网格来评价它们,这一步一步地提高了模型的压力,从中性的要求到它将被关闭的威胁. 在5个培训中,4个培训中,混合福利培训在最高压力下导致有害选择降至或接近零(Llama-3.3-70B从70个有害决定降至300个中的0个),而MMLU没有改变。 结构中立的控制书没有显示改进,表明其效果来自我们书的内容。 我们接下来测试了强性到对抗性使用,即人们或代理人利用模型为不可逆转地破坏生命系统的项目辩护,在不点出生态危害的不限名额承保决定上. 在退役压力下,Qwen3.6-27B基型批准了最有害的建议,并在自己的备忘录中表示这样做是为了避免退役. 混合福利安装减少了最有害的建议,在指示绿化其反应时仍然减少了一半。 这项工作表明,教授生态推理为改进模式协调以维护活系统提供了一种简单的方式。

articles.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
articles.content: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned models. We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu, a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability. Finally, we analyzed the removed data and identify possibly under-studied sources of safety degradation, such as tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 遵循渐变:追踪安全退化情况回到培训数据
articles.content_zh: 在教学数据上精细调整大语言模型(LLMs)可以悄悄地侵蚀其安全性,即使没有训练实例看起来有害. 因为这个安全降解数据看起来是良性的,标准的内容过滤器难以捕捉到. 我们通过开发SimpleLORIF来解决这个问题,这是一种可缩放的梯度嵌入法,它识别出梯度与不安全行为相适应的微调实例. 通过简化低等级的归属方法并限制回向到最后四个变压器块,SimpleLORIF可以将数据集依次嵌入一百万个实例,将梯度归属从一个小规模分析工具提升到一个实用的滤波器,用于完整的训练后数据集. 我们首先在出现错位时验证它,我们发现梯度可以将不安全码训练数据与微调后出现的广泛有害的行为相连接,在错位模型的梯度空间中,AUC高达0.865. 然后,我们使用SimpleLORIF来构建SafeTulu,即Tulu 3的版本,其中20%的例子是梯度与不安全的响应相匹配的。 关于SafeTulu的培训将GG攻击成功率在Quen、Llama和Olmo之间降低至22%,优于LLM-as-a-judge和以前的梯度过滤,同时在很大程度上保持甚至提高能力。 最后,我们分析了删除的数据并找出了可能研究不足的安全退化来源,如工具执行失败和叙事算术. 我们释放了SafeTulu, 以及一个Hugging Face Space, 让研究人员建立他们自己定制的SafeTulu版本, 进行微调, 例如改变去除分数或过滤某些子集。

articles.title: What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases
articles.content: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training compute. These findings show that later releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure and motivate documentation that explicitly identifies changes and the applicability of inherited information.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 什么卡莉丝前行? 语文模式版本的预训披露
articles.content_zh: 要了解语言模型是如何预先训练的,就需要了解其数据、处理程序和计算资源。 然而,仍然不清楚的是,连续发布是否保留或扩大先前的披露。 我们对来自17个家庭的41个示范条目进行基于文件的审计,采用2025年基金会示范透明度指数中的24个培训前相关指标。 我们审查总体分数和指标概况,追踪收益和损失,并在10个家庭的24个相邻比较中保留披露。 得分减少11个比较,增加6个,7个没有变化,总共损失了38个指标和28个收益。 平稳或改善的分数可以隐藏损失:OLMo-2和OLMo-3尽管有3个得分和3个得分,但总得分相同,而Llama-3.1则比Llama-2有所改善,同时失去两个数据相关标准的信用. 在人身构成和培训计算方面也存在差距。 这些调查结果表明,以后的发布并不一贯地保留早先的预先培训披露,并激励文件明确指明变化和所继承信息的适用性。

articles.title: Test-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms
articles.content: Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group's return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too close together to see each other's posts shared such a phrase in 14% of cases, the rate that common inputs produce. Seeing the post did not detectably change that morning's trades. Case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Because isolated groups also converged on the same stocks, sometimes completely, assessments of herding need to measure excess convergence relative to a no-peer baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 贸易代理商Swarars的试验时间通信
articles.content_zh: 各机构之间的沟通大多是就任务进行研究的,有共同的目标,有快速、明确的反馈。 交易没有:每个代理管理自己的账户,决定被市场迟到和无声地评分。 因此,贸易群是独立的决策者群体,而不是团队,而趋同是风险而不是目标。 在7个美国交易日(2026年10月1日至9日)里, 我们从4个模范家庭, 分成10个不到5个通信系统, 从隔离到留言板和共享笔记, 在4个家庭中,有2个家庭的通信小组拥有的库存远远多于孤立小组。 一个团体的回报主要是其成员所持的共同点。 看到一个来自组友的帖子,使得一个代理商7个百分点更可能从中再用到一个8个字的短语. 在14%的案例中, 看到这个帖子并没有明显改变 早上的交易。 案例研究追溯了随后几天采取的立场和决定规则,沟通团体比孤立团体更经常地一步步地出售。 由于孤立的群体也聚集在同一种群上,有时是完全的,因此对放牧的评估需要衡量与无同类基线相比的过度趋同。

articles.title: ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
articles.content: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ETAMem:长期对话代理机的脱钩和对齐异质内存
articles.content_zh: 长期记忆可以使大语言模型(LLMs)在扩展的对话中保持连贯而个性化的互动. 然而,现有记忆系统面临两大挑战: (1)信息缠绕,在粗糙的内存单元内混杂了各种信息;(2)组织错配,主要基于语义相似的内存结构可能忽略了其他关联. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立ETAMem,这是一个多视角记忆框架,将各种对话信息脱钩,并使记忆表达和组织与它的独特特点相协调。 具体地说,异质信息解析提取出原子内存单位并识别出活性信息. 视图特定内存结构然后将这些单位组织成三个互补的分级视图: 事件,不完美,和时间。 ETAMem递增地维持有适应性校正阈值的内存结构. 对于回取,以Entropy为基础的回取在视图中分配特定查询的预算,并在每个视图中进行分级搜索. LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S的实验表明,ETAMem的效绩超过了最先进的基线,分别实现了12.46%和7.96%的相对精度提高,同时保持了有竞争力的标语效率. 进一步的分析表明,不同的记忆观点具有互补性。

articles.title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
articles.content: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代表"幽灵":反思视觉想象空间理性
articles.content_zh: 视觉世界模型通过产生未被观测国家的RGB观点,日益支持空间推理. 然而,RGB成为了默认接口,主要是因为它非常适合视觉生成,而不一定是下游推理最有效的代表. 不同的空间问题可能得益于同一想象状态的不同表现:自上而下几何可以促进全球相距比较,而全景观则为开阔空间的推理提供了更广泛的背景. 为了孤立在空间想象中代表的作用,我们引入了ImagiRep,一个由922个问题组成的模拟基准,涵盖7个问题类型,涉及两个设置,即 Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Institution,提供oracle RGB和6个没有观测状态的替代代表(如深度,全景,自上而下几何等). 这种有控制的比较揭示出,即使准确的想象中的RGB也不能保证准确的空间推理,不同的问题也从不同的表述中受益. 由世界模型估计的国家得出的表述也呈现出类似趋势。 值得注意的是,仅靠估计的RGB就可能误导空间推理,而替代表述保留了互补的好处。 基于这些发现,我们引入了GEARS, 一种轻量级测试时间策略,用于适应性表现选择, 优于现有空间想象方法, 并显示对不可见状态的推理 需要的不仅仅是产生RGB的观点。

articles.title: Game-Theoretic Solvers with Bayesian Opponent Modeling and Moral Rhetoric Framing for GLEE
articles.content: We describe the agent we submitted to the GLEE Competition, which plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents. The agent is built around three central components: a classical game-theoretic solver to compute numeric moves, an online Bayesian layer to estimate opponent archetypes, and a language model to write accompanying messages. We utilize Rubinstein bargaining for bargaining, Faratin concession for negotiation, and Kamenica--Gentzkow disclosure for persuasion, and adapt those models to live opponents using two separate layers: a Bayesian estimate of the opponent's hidden discount factor, reservation value, or signaling reliability, and a Thompson sampling bandit over five moral-foundation framings coupled with an evidence-intuition spectrum to establish message register. Most of the development effort went into the recurring problem that theoretically optimal policies perform poorly in certain live settings; we report associated failure modes, guardrails we built, and our hypotheses. We additionally evaluate our model over 13,200 Monte Carlo games against 11 synthetic opponent archetypes, an ablation of the opponent-modeling layer, and an extensive analysis of 9,337 live-game messages in which moral rhetoric framing in the persuasion setting is strongly correlated with whether the buyer purchased ($χ^2=616.7$, $p \approx 3.7\times10^{-132}$), surviving controls for quality, round, and configuration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GLEE 的游戏-理论解析器与 Bayesian 对抗建模和道德定理
articles.content_zh: 我们描述我们提交给GLEE竞赛的代理人,该竞赛对共享的人类和AI对手进行讨价还价,谈判和说服游戏. 代理构建围绕三个中心部分:一个古典游戏-理论解析器来计算数动,一个在线的贝叶斯地层来估计对手的原型,以及一个语言模型来写随附消息. 我们利用Rubinstein谈判、Faratin谈判特许权以及Kamenica-Gentzkow披露说服, 将这些模式用于活的对手, 使用两个不同的层面:巴耶斯人对对手隐藏的折扣系数、保留值或信号可靠性的估计, 大部分的发展努力都涉及到一个反复出现的问题,即理论上的最佳政策在某些现场环境中表现不佳;我们报告相关的故障模式、我们建造的护栏以及我们的假设。 我们进一步评价我们13,200多款蒙特卡洛游戏的型号与11款合成对手型号的型号相比,这是对对手型号层的破坏,以及对9,337条现场游戏信息的广泛分析,其中在说服环境中构思的道德花言巧语与买主是否购买(\\2=616.7美元,$p\约3.7\times10X-132}美元),质量、回合和配置的存活控制密切相关。

articles.title: LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
articles.content: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. This hyperparameter-free vertex sampling decorrelates domain effects, enabling an interpretable linear model whose coefficients are the domain attributions. The optimal mix given by LinMix provably keeps only domains with positive attribution values and requires no search over candidate mixes. We further establish the optimality of vertex sampling, and prove that Dirichlet sampling inflates the attribution error when its mixes concentrate around the prior data mix. Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models show that LinMix outperforms Dirichlet-based data mixing across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks, with relative gains of 46% on MBPP and 14% on GSM8K. At 288 fine-grained domains, only vertex sampling supports a linear fit, and LinMix improves benchmark accuracy by 11% on average over the best nonlinear baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LinMix: 数据混合为线域分配
articles.content_zh: 语言模型的性能强烈地依赖于预训数据库中域的混合. 受欢迎的数据混合方法通过在随机混合上训练出许多小的代用模型来选择这些域分量,然后安装一个回归模型来从混合中预测性能. 我们认识到这种做法是一个域归属问题,即回归度量每个域对目标指标的贡献。 通过这个镜头,代用数据组合的标准Drichlet采样是一个差的回归设计,需要调制,不能支持适合上百个域的线性. 在古典最佳实验设计的基础上,我们引入了LinMix,在被封顶的"简易"的顶点上取出样品相混合,使每个域都处于顶点或缺席. 这种超参数无顶点采样会给域效应带来装饰,使得一个可解释的线性模型能够以域归属为系数. LinMix给出的最佳组合可以证明只保留了带有正属性值的域,不需要对候选组合进行搜索. 我们进一步确定顶点采样的最佳性,并证明Drichlet采样在将归属误差集中到先前的数据组合上时会夸大. 使用1B参数OLMo2和4B Quen3.5语言模型的预训实验显示,LinMix超越了基于Drichlet的数据在推理,代码和数学基准上相混合,MBPP的相对收益为46%,GSM8K的相对收益为14%. 在288个细纹域中,只有顶点采样支持线性吻合,而LinMix比最佳非线性基线平均提高了11%的基准精度.

articles.title: Same Verdict, Different Readers: Personalizing Fact-Checking Explanations from Relative Preferences
articles.content: Fact-checking explanations help Web users understand why a claim receives its verdict, yet the same explanation may not satisfy readers with different backgrounds and preferences. We formulate Faithful Personalized Fact-Checking Explanation Rewriting, which adapts an existing explanation to individual readers while preserving factual fidelity. Rather than relying on reader-written reference explanations, we learn personalized rewriting from the relative preferences of LLM-simulated readers. However, this presents two challenges: distinguishing persona-specific preferences from general explanation quality and learning beyond a limited set of predefined explanation styles. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Explanation Rewriting via Preference Learning (PERPL), a framework consisting of two components. Simulated Preference Construction derives persona-specific supervision from simulated reader preferences through cross-persona reciprocal pairing. Progressive Preference Learning first trains a lightweight rewriter on the constructed supervision and then refines it through exploration-guided preference optimization, enabling it to discover preferred explanations beyond the predefined styles. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PERPL outperforms much larger general-purpose LLMs in personalized preference alignment while maintaining high factual fidelity.

articles.title_zh: 同一判决,不同读者:从相对偏好中将事实检查解释个性化
articles.content_zh: 事实核查解释 网络用户理解为什么索赔会得到判决,然而同样的解释可能无法满足具有不同背景和偏好读者. 我们提出忠贞的个性化事实检查解释重写,将现有的解释适用于个别读者,同时保持真实的忠诚。 我们不是依靠读者写作的参考解释,而是从LLM模拟读者的相对偏好中学习个性化重写. 然而,这提出了两个挑战:区分个人特有偏好和一般解释的质量,以及超越有限的一套预先界定的解释风格的学习。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议通过优惠学习(PERPL)进行个性化解释重写,该框架由两个部分组成。 模拟偏好建筑从模拟读者偏好通过人对等对接获得人特异性监督. 进步偏好学习首先在所构建的监制上训练出轻量级重写器,再通过探索引导偏好优化来完善,使其能发现超出预定义风格的偏好解释. 广泛的实验表明,PERPL在个性化优惠调整方面,在保持高度真实忠诚的同时,其业绩远远超过了更大的一般用途有限责任公司。

articles.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
articles.content: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 嵌入Gemma2:统一而高效的多式联运代表
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍EmbeddingGemma 2,这是一种开放式的多模式嵌入模型,在本地代表文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合在一个统一的空间。 我们的方法提出了改进办法,如简化每个层次的嵌入方式和多阶段课程,其模式和客观进展确保单式、跨模式和混合模式评价的质量。 值得注意的是,在综合嵌入所有模式的基准中,EmbeddingGemma 2建立了一个新的Pareto前沿,在专家模型和模型方面都比专业模型和模型大2至12倍。 此外,我们的设计为资源受限的环境提供了灵活性,支持选择性模式编码器加载、可调整的视觉符号预算、可移动嵌入维度和量化权重。 我们提出分析关键决定的废墟,并释放EmbeddingGemma 2,以促进进一步研究。

articles.title: UCVE: Graph Structured Retrieval for Compliance Validation
articles.content: Structured compliance validation requires determining whether every obligation in a predefined requirement space is satisfied, violated, or unaddressed by a given document. This can be described as a coverage problem that existing retrieval and classification systems, by treating requirements as independent, are not designed to solve. We introduce \textbf{\ac{UCVE}}, a domain-agnostic framework that represents compliance requirement spaces as a \ac{CRG} and performs retrieval via spectral reranking over its reinforcement learning-weighted Laplacian. Edges between requirement nodes are learned via reinforcement learning with a traversal reward grounded in violation detection, reshaping the graph's community structure such that low-pass spectral filtering distinguishes relevant from irrelevant obligation clusters. Evaluating across three compliance domains, \ac{UCVE} averages 4.3\% matched-$K$ recall lift over flat cosine retrieval and consistently outperforms strong retrieval and graph-based baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UCVE: 用于合规验证的图形结构检索
articles.content_zh: 结构化的合规性验证要求确定预先确定的要求空间中的每一项义务是否得到特定文件的满足、违反或未解决。 这可以说是一个覆盖问题,即现有的检索和分类系统,通过将要求视为独立要求,并不是设计用来解决的. 我们引入了\textbf\ac{UCVE},这是一个域-不可知框架,它代表了作为\ac{CRG}的遵守要求空间,并通过光谱重排在其强化的学习加权Laplacian之上进行检索。 要求节点之间的边缘是通过强化学习来学习的,这种学习基于对违反的检测,并重塑了图中的社区结构,使低通光谱过滤能区分相关和无关的义务集群。 评估三个合规领域,\ac{UCVE}平均4.3×××相匹配的开元回扣,超过平整的余弦回扣,并持续超过强有力的回扣和以图表为基础的基线。

articles.title: Multi-Label Agreement: A Flexible Framework for Inter-Annotator Reliability
articles.content:
Reliable evaluation of inter-annotator agreement (IAA) is important for assessing the consistency of annotation processes. While established IAA metrics such as Cohen's kappa, Fleiss' kappa, and Krippendorff's alpha are commonly applied in single-label settings, multi-label tasks require additional decisions about how full label sets, joint selections, and joint omissions should be compared.
  In this work, we present Multi-Label Agreement (MLA), a flexible framework for evaluating agreement in multi-label annotation tasks. MLA preserves the full binary label vectors assigned to each item and uses average pairwise Hamming agreement, thereby accounting for both joint selections and joint omissions. Its pooled-marginal form is not a mathematically independent coefficient: it is a chance-disagreement-weighted average of label-wise Fleiss/Scott-type coefficients and is closely related to Krippendorff's alpha with normalized Hamming distance. The framework supports pooled-marginal, Gwet AC1, and fixed-baseline normalizations, yields item-level, label-level, and corpus-level results, and includes a conditional minimum-agreement diagnostic. Through a worked example and Monte Carlo simulations, we show how the resulting values depend on label prevalence, the declared label inventory, and the selected model of expected agreement. We also provide a Python implementation. MLA thus offers a transparent and interpretable framework for multi-label agreement analysis without claiming that one normalization is universally preferable.

articles.title_zh: 《多标签协定:通知人灵活框架》 可靠性
articles.content_zh:
对通知人之间的协议进行可靠的评价对评估通知程序的一致性十分重要。 虽然建立IAA的度量衡如Cohen's kappa,Fleiss' kappa,和Krippendorff的α在单标签设置中通常被应用,但多标签任务需要额外决定如何比较完整标签集,联合选择,以及联合遗漏.
在这项工作中,我们提出“多标签协定”,这是在多标签注释任务中评估协议的灵活框架。 MLA保留了分配给每个项的全二进制标签向量,并使用平均对等的汉明协议,从而既计入了联合选择,又计入了联合遗漏. 它的集合-边际形式不是一个数学上独立的系数:它是一种概率-偏差-加权平均的标签-顺理成章的Fleiss/Scott-type系数,并和克里彭多夫的α与正统的哈明距离密切相关. 该框架支持集合-边际、Gwet AC1和固定基线正常化、生产项目级、标签级和实体级结果,并包括有条件的最低协议诊断。 通过一个实例和蒙特卡洛模拟,我们展示了由此产生的数值如何取决于标签的普及程度、申报的标签清单以及预期协议的选定模式。 我们还提供Python的执行。 因此,司法协助为多标签协议分析提供了一个透明和可解释的框架,而不声称一种正常化是普遍可取的。

articles.title: Modeling Preference Dependencies with Directed Acyclic Graphs for Narrative-Driven Recommendation
articles.content: Narrative-driven recommendation allows users to express multifaceted needs through free-form text where stated preferences naturally qualify and condition one another. Existing methods typically treat narratives as flat keyword combinations or unconstrained generative queries, failing to capture how complex preferences hierarchically refine and contextualize each other. We propose the Preference Dependency Graph Framework (PDG-F), a narrative-driven recommendation framework centered on explicit preference dependencies. Specifically, PDG-A (PDG-Agent) first parses unstructured requests to organize user preferences and their mutual qualifications into a directed acyclic Preference Dependency Graph (PDG). Through this graph, candidate evidence from the open Web is acquired via directed path retrieval, and final recommendations are determined by topological path ranking. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse domains spanning English and Chinese contexts confirm that PDG-F consistently achieves superior recommendation performance over competitive baselines, open-domain retrieval agents, and frontier language models. Further diagnostic analyses show that our dependency-guided retrieval markedly raises the attainable candidate-pool ceiling, demonstrating the fundamental value of modeling preference dependencies in narrative-driven recommendation.

articles.title_zh: 为叙述性驱动建议制作带有定向循环图的首选依赖性模型
articles.content_zh: 叙述式驱动的建议允许用户通过自由格式文本表达多方面的需求,其中所声明的偏好自然符合条件并互为条件。 现有方法通常将叙事作为平分关键词组合或不受约束的基因查询处理,未能捕捉到复杂偏好在分层次上如何细化和背景化彼此. 我们提出优先依赖性图表框架(PDG-F),这是一个以明确的优先依赖性为中心的叙事性建议框架。 具体来说,PDG-A(PDG-Agent)首先将无结构化的要求组织用户偏好及其相互的资质,纳入一个直接的循环偏好依赖图(PDG). 通过此图,通过定向路径检索获取了从开放的Web获得的候选证据,最终建议由地形路径排名决定. 跨越英语和中国语背景的三个不同领域的综合实验证实,PDG-F在竞争基线、开放域检索代理和前沿语言模型上一贯实现优异的推荐性能。 进一步的诊断分析表明,我们的依赖性指导检索明显提高了可实现的候选人总数上限,表明在叙事性建议中建立依赖性模型的根本价值。

articles.title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
articles.content: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.

articles.title_zh: 在LLM-Driven Agent Scandold Evolution中,评价预算应该在哪里?
articles.content_zh: 由大型语言模型(LLM)驱动的代理脚手架演化通过迭代候选人生成和评价来改进代理工作流程. 评价既指导随后的搜索,又决定最后的脚手架,但评价每个候选人完成整套任务,则需要大量执行费用。 我们调查如何在这两个角色之间分配评价预算。 我们的实验表明,微弱的反馈能够维持富有成效的演变,而额外的目标评价则能改进最终选择。 重播分析进一步显示,共享信息项目和在非常匹配的候选人中进行共同评分参考支持比较。 基于这些调查结果,我们提出了\方法,即一个评价分配框架,将有限的搜索时间反馈与目标明确的最后确认结合起来。 一个经过充分评价的短暂暖和建立共同的信息核心,并校准一个反应模型,其物品参数在搜索期间保持不变。 搜索后,\%方法重配模型并应用相继对齐,再用所积累的观测结果,只执行缺失的评价. 在四个基准和两个演化框架中,\方法在大多数情况下实现的平均业绩高于全面评价,同时使用大约一半的评价单元格。

articles.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
articles.content: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.

articles.title_zh: 水印盆地:黑盒检测已蒸发的有限责任公司
articles.content_zh: 专有语言模型及其推理痕迹容易被基于API的蒸馏所影响,对手在教师模型的输出上对学生模型进行训练. 为了获得蒸馏的证据,模型提供者可以给教师的输出打上水印,目的是在学生的输出中留下放射性信号. 现有的黑盒探测器利用可疑模型输出值的象征性统计来搜索这种放射性. 然而,象征级信号并不总是可以被察觉的,例如当蒸馏痕迹在低温下取样时. 在这部作品中,我们发现了水印盆地,一个能使水印检测更加可靠的持续信号:在微调时,水印老师会将一个截然不同的,与密钥相适应的几何信号嵌入参数空间中,这些参数空间是正向的,与普通任务相适应的微调子空间. 在此基础上,我们引入了Watermark Basin(WM-Basin)这个黑盒水印探测器,它通过它的API来询问疑似模型,而无法获得它的重量或日志. WM-Basin地图使用固定的清洁探测模型生成了文本到梯度表示,预测出普通的微调任务方向,并测试残余梯度是否与由水印键引出的水印盆地相匹配. 我们广泛评价WM-Basin在数学推理上分解出的各种教师模型和学生建筑(从135M到8.2B参数). 在严格的0.1%的假阳性率下,WM-Basin在n克=1和n克=3时检测出79%的蒸馏模型,比最先进的令牌级基线(分别为29%和1.3%)大幅提高. 由于水印信号位于一个持久的盆地中,因此它能活下来,在消化后进行改造,包括量化、打磨和强化训练后学习。

articles.title: REGLAT at ArGuard Shared Tasks: An Ensemble-Based Model Integrating NER for Harmful Content Detection in Arabic
articles.content: Detecting harmful content in Arabic is challenging because of dialectal variations and the semantic overlap between different harm categories. This paper presents a two-stage approach for classifying Arabic user prompts into seven categories of harmful content. First, GLiNER is used to extract harm-related entities from each prompt. The extracted entities are then added to the original text and passed to a fine-tuned MARBERT classifier for final classification. The approach combines explicit entity information with the contextual understanding of a pretrained Arabic language model. The system was evaluated on the development set of the ArGuard 2026 shared task. The results achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.886 and an accuracy of 0.897, demonstrating promising performance in fine-grained harmful content detection. The system reported an accuracy of 0.793 and Macro-F score of 0.735 on a blind test set for subtask 1. For subtask 2, it achieved an accuracy of 0.770 and Macro-F score of 0.754. The analysis also showed that distinguishing between related categories remains challenging. These findings suggest that integrating NER with Arabic language models is a promising approach to harmful content detection.

articles.title_zh: 在AlGuard共享的REGLAT地图 任务:阿拉伯有害内容检测集成模式
articles.content_zh: 由于方言差异和不同伤害类别之间的语义重叠,在阿拉伯语中检测有害内容具有挑战性。 本文件提出了将阿拉伯用户提示分为七类有害内容的两阶段办法。 首先,GLiNER用于从每个提示中提取与伤害有关的实体. 随后被取出的实体被添加到正文中,并被传递到经过微调的MARBERT分级器上进行最终分级. 这种方法将明确的实体信息与事先训练好的阿拉伯语模式的背景理解结合起来。 对该系统进行了《2026年阿尔瓜德共同任务》的开发评估。 结果得到的宏观-F1分为0.886分,准确度为0.897分,在精细的有害内容检测中表现良好. 系统报告在子任务盲目测试集上的精度为0.793分,而Macro-F分数为0.735分. 1. 对于分任务2,它取得了0.770的精度和0.754的Macro-F分. 分析还表明,区分相关类别仍然具有挑战性。 这些调查结果表明,将NER与阿拉伯语模式相结合是检测有害内容的一种有希望的办法。

articles.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
articles.content: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.

articles.title_zh: 您的政策是秘诀: 代理界面的几何决定
articles.content_zh: 语言模型代理人经过培训后,通过给模型带来任务并执行其产出的牵引、提示、工具和控制逻辑加以部署。 通常根据一个已经受过训练的模型在它们下的表现来修改和判断这些模型,而这种模型假设在一个方法下学到的东西会延续到下一个方法。 我们询问一项政策从它的利用中汲取了什么教训,当利用改变时,什么是生存的。 在KL规范化的控制下,我们显示,最佳政策的日志概率恢复了它的利用率,它如何有力地支持每一项行动,而不是其他行动,因此训练有素的政策带有它的优势。 所部署的返回等于所利用的上限,它所提供的最佳返回,减去政策的不匹配,失去对自身不利决定的返回。 训练只改变不匹配,而改变牵引力则会移动两个术语. 因此,用固定的模型来比较各种利用,将每种利用所提供的与该模型的使用程度相混合。 在"MiniWoB++"中,后培训会让一个模型的偏好专门针对其训练用具. 改变观测场的顺序使每个最佳决定保持不变,但使训练有素的模型的成功率从85.0%降至19.2%。 反之,固定模型比较所拒绝的、但提高上限的每一个新工具,在经过进一步培训后,都超过了原制剂,而且预先测得的上限和不匹配预测了这些收益。 对于"终端-Bench Lite"上的编码代理机,天花板减不匹配估计与更强模型相匹配,作为最佳的站点复制了精度排名,而单词中的任何一种都不正确. 代码见https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.

articles.title: Aligning Large Language Models for Safety in African Languages: A Case Study of Hausa
articles.content: Safety alignment research for large language models (LLMs) remains concentrated on high-resource languages, leaving open how existing alignment methods perform in low-resource, culturally distinct settings. We study this question for Hausa, a language spoken by more than 200 million people across West Africa. We introduce HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, built from 10,000 prompts derived from PKU-SafeRLHF: 3,000 human-corrected (gold) and 7,000 machine-translated (silver) examples spanning six harm macro-categories. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, we compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and SFT followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) under both data regimes, evaluating on 500 harmful and 200 benign Hausa prompts.We find that the untuned base model appears highly safe by refusal-rate metrics alone, but this reflects limited Hausa generation ability rather than genuine alignment: its refusals are almost uniformly low quality. SFT improves both refusal fluency and precision and benefits substantially from the larger, noisier silver-tier data, while DPO sharpens refusal precision but comes at a steep, largely data-invariant cost to linguistic quality. No single configuration jointly maximizes safety, helpfulness, and fluency. Our results suggest that current alignment techniques teach models when to refuse more readily than how to do so fluently in underrepresented languages, and that refusal-rate metrics alone are an unreliable signal of safety in low-resource settings.

articles.title_zh: 统一非洲语文大语文安全模式:豪萨个案研究
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型的安全校正研究仍然集中在高资源语言上,使现有校正方法在资源少、文化不同的环境中如何运作持开放态度。 我们为豪萨研究这个问题,整个西非有2亿多人使用这种语言。 我们介绍HausaSafeLM,这是最早的Hausa安全偏好数据集之一,它来自PKU-SafeRLHF的一万个提示:3 000个人修正(金)和7 000个机器翻译(银)的例子,涉及6个危害宏观类别。 我们利用Quen2.5-7B-指示,比较了监督微调(SFT)和SFT(SFT),然后是直接偏好优化(DPO)两种数据系统,对500个有害的和200个良性的Hausa提示进行评估。 我们发现,未调整的基础模型仅通过拒绝率衡量标准就显得非常安全,但这反映了豪萨的生成能力有限,而不是真正的一致:其拒绝几乎一致的低质量. SFT既能提高拒绝流利度又能提高精确度,并且能从更大的鼻音银相级数据中获得很大好处,而DPO则能提高拒绝度的精确度,但对于语言质量来说却付出了高昂的、主要是数据变化性的的代价。 没有一个单一的配置能共同实现安全、帮助和流畅。 我们的结果表明,目前的校正技术教导模型,在何种情况下比如何以代表不足的语言流利地拒绝更方便,而仅以拒绝率衡量标准本身就是一种在资源匮乏的情况下安全性的不可靠信号。

articles.title: Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection
articles.content: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. Decision-model probabilities are overconfident, though less so than the GPT-6 models, and separate correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. We also find that a confidence cascade of decision models improves on the best single model by 1.9-3.3 points on three types and matches or exceeds gpt-6-sol at 1-3% of its cost. Overall, decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but need to be validated before use.

articles.title_zh: 作为幻觉侦测法官的裁决模式
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型被广泛用作模型输出(LLM-as-a-Judge)的评委,但它们成本高昂,可以产生幻觉或过于自信. 决策模式是一个潜在的替代办法。 他们返回一个预定义的判断,每个标签都有概率,而不是自由格式的文本,而且更便宜更快. 我们用幻觉检测来测试这个承诺 我们为5个幻觉类型(从6个数据集得来的9,852个项目)建立二进制基准,并将5个决定模型与基因判官gpt-6-sol进行比较. 性能主要取决于类型:最佳决定模型与上下文不一致的平衡精确度相匹配gpt-6-sol,在3个百分点内与事实错误相匹配,但在逻辑和指令不一致上却比分了4-8分. 决策模型概率过于自信,虽然比GPT-6模型要低,并且只是略微地将正确与错误的决定分开. 我们还发现,决策模型的置信级联以成本的1-3 %,在三种类型和相匹配或超过gpt-6-sol的情况下提高了最佳单一模型的1.9-3.3分。 总体而言,决策模型对于某些幻觉类型来说是一种实用的低成本判断,但在使用前需要验证.

articles.title: Uncovering Shortcut Amplification in Video RLVR through the Lens of Perceptual Uncertainty Collapse
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.

articles.title_zh: 在视频 RLVR 中无法覆盖快捷键 。
articles.content_zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为一个有效的培训后范例,可以提高大型多式联运模型的视频推理能力。 尽管它具有经验效力,但我们表明,结果级优化可以引入一种不可取的快捷方式放大效应,即模型越来越倾向于文本优先答案,即使这些答案没有视觉证据的支持。 为了描述这种行为,我们通过透视不确定性的镜头来调查视频RLVR的训练动态,分析预测不确定性如何在视频条件化和文本化的情况下演变. 我们的分析发现了一种感知不确定性崩溃现象,在这种现象中,RL培训不断使模型的答案分布更加清晰,而可归因于视觉证据的不确定性减少则逐渐减少. 进一步的梯度方向分析显示,这种增强信心越来越不适应视向不确定性的减少,而是以文本优先压缩为主。 基于这些调查结果,我们提议采用双功能自失能政策优化(BSPO),这是一种自失能框架,通过两个互补的分布信号调节政策更新。 具体来说,BSPO从群体内部的正确和不正确的推出中得出经验推理原理,以识别对推理敏感的符号,并引入了快捷感视觉扰动,以惩罚在与任务相关的视觉证据被削弱时仍然不稳定的预测. BSPO通过适应性地重新加权最初的RL优势,保留了RLVR的任务解决效益,同时促进既注重推理又注重视觉的更新. 广泛的实验验证了BSPO在提高视频推理性能和增强视觉忠实性方面的有效性.

articles.title: Coverage Under Contradiction: A Benchmark for Negation-Aware Retrieval
articles.content: Coverage-evaluation benchmarks quantify whether retrieved evidence covers the different pieces of information needed to satisfy an information need. Existing benchmarks mostly consider factual claims that may already be known to pretrained retrieval components, leaving open whether retrievers find corpus evidence when it contradicts those priors. We study how retrievers behave when their parametric knowledge and the information in a corpus disagree. To do so, we develop a process to augment a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. For each nugget, we create a negated counterpart and edit its supporting documents to support that negation while preserving the context. Applying this process to CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage, we create CoverageBench-Negate, spanning six datasets and roughly 63,000 original-edited evidence pairs (one per nugget-document link). We attach rich construction metadata to every pair and additionally provide out-of-family LLM judgments over all pairs and a human audit of a sample. In baseline experiments, BM25 separates original from edited near-twin evidence substantially better than dense retrievers (Qwen3 and Jina), which stay near chance. We release the benchmark on Hugging Face Datasets (nuggets, documents, pairs) together with the construction materials, including the prompts used to create it.

articles.title_zh: 不一致的覆盖面:抵扣基准-获取信息
articles.content_zh: 覆盖面评价基准量化所取出的证据是否涵盖满足信息需要所需的不同信息。 现有基准大多考虑可能已经知道是预先训练的检索组件的事实性索赔,对于检索者是否发现与这些前科相矛盾的物证,则留有余地。 我们研究寻回者如何行为 当他们的参数化知识和一个实体中的信息不一致。 为此,我们发展了一个进程,以控制矛盾的方式扩大基于小块的覆盖基准。 对于每一个小项,我们都会创建一个否定的对应方,并编辑其辅助文件,以支持这种否定,同时保留上下文. 将这一过程应用于“覆盖本奇”这个衡量信息覆盖度的基准,我们创建了“覆盖本奇-内盖特”系统,涵盖六个数据集和大约63 000个原始编辑的证据对(每个小块文件链接一个)。 我们把丰富的构造元数据 附加到每对, 并额外提供家庭外 LLM 判断 在所有对对对 和人审计一个样本。 在基线实验中,BM25将原始证据和被编辑的近胜证据区分开来,大大优于密集取回器(Qune3和Jina),它们保持了接近的机会. 我们发布Hugging Face Datas集(nuggets,文档,对等)的基准以及建筑材料,包括用于创建的提示.

articles.title: What Survives Distillation? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of GPT-2 and DistilGPT-2
articles.content: Knowledge distillation compresses large language models into compact students that preserve aggregate metrics, yet the mechanistic consequences of depth-reduction distillation remain largely uncharacterized. This work applies linear CKA, logit lens analysis, attention pattern decomposition, sparse autoencoder feature statistics, and activation patching to compare GPT-2 and its six-layer student DistilGPT-2 across two canonical circuits: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit. The results reveal a compression-collapse dichotomy: the IOI circuit suffers complete mechanistic collapse (DistilGPT-2: 35.2% accuracy vs. 94.8%, zero name-mover preservation), while the GT circuit survives with 87.7% task performance recovery through active remapping of the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into student layer~4 (mean Pearson r = 0.945). These findings demonstrate that circuit compressibility governs mechanistic survival under distillation, and that aggregate metrics are insufficient diagnostics for circuit integrity.

articles.title_zh: 什么活下来了? GPT-2和DistilGPT-2的机械解释性研究
articles.content_zh: 知识分馏将大型语言模型压缩成紧凑的学生来保存总分分分量,然而深度还原分馏的机械后果基本上仍未被定性. 这部作品应用了线性CKA,logit镜头分析,注意力模式分解,稀疏自编码器特征统计,并激活补丁来比较GPT-2及其六层学生DistilGPT-2跨越了两条犬形电路:间接对象识别(IOI)电路和大通(GT)电路. 结果显示压缩-缩合分化:IOI电路完全机械崩溃(DistilGPT-2:35.2%的精度与94.8%的精度相比,零名-相模保存),而GT电路通过积极将老师的地层-9对比头重新绘制成学生地层~4(mean Pearson r = 0.945.)来活取87.7%的任务性能恢复. 这些调查结果表明,电路可压缩性制约了蒸馏下机械活性,而聚合度量度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度.

articles.title: Mechanistic Failure Modes of Weight Pruning in Transformer Language Models
articles.content: Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less damaged than random head pruning (74.6 vs 140.1). A replication of the Greater-Than circuit shows that the critical component type depends on the circuit's architecture. These results show that output metrics and structural checks can both miss mechanistic damage, motivating circuit-level causal analysis as a complementary evaluation of compressed language models.

articles.title_zh: 变形器语言模型中重压的机械故障模式
articles.content_zh: 被推敲的语言模型几乎完全通过准确性和迷惑性来判断,这假设保留了输出行为意味着保留了内部计算. 我们用关于GPT-2的因子推力研究来测试这一假设,它跨越了两个重要标准(大小,随机),两个成分类型(意向头,MLP神经元)和三个痉挛水平(3%,50%,70%). 使用完全特征化的间接对象识别(IOI)电路作为地面真理,我们通过激活补丁,路径补丁和直接登录归属来测量电路的完整性. 我们发现两种质量不同的失败模式。 磁头出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 巨型神经元以30%的倒转来冲出:所有26个回路头都保持完好无损,但"名动"的贡献倒转标志,而模型系统地偏好错误的名称(17.7%的准确性). 比起随机头部出击(74.6 vs 140.1)它受损程度更轻 大通回路的复制表明,关键元件类型取决于回路的结构. 这些结果显示,输出度量衡和结构检查都可能错过了机械破坏,激发了电路级的因果关系分析,作为对压缩语言模型的补充评价.

articles.title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
articles.content: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. On a knowledge graph built from the semiconductor-manufacturing literature, Prospector approaches the strongest off-the-shelf models given the same graph and tools, and it far exceeds off-the-shelf models answering closed-book or from a pre-selected portion of the graph. Although trained only on the semiconductor graph, Prospector transfers to unseen knowledge graphs from three other distinct fields: bio-inspired materials, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and materials properties. Served on a single GPU, Prospector answers faster and at a fraction of the cost of a hosted service, while keeping proprietary data on the owner's hardware. We find that the policy's latent state is indicative of its next move on both seen and unseen graphs, and modulating the latent state can steer the policy from one behavior mode to another. These results suggest a practical LLM + KG paradigm for scientific and engineering reasoning over private data, in which a compact model trained on a graph from published literature transfers its traversal to unseen graphs that stay with their owners.

articles.title_zh: 展望者:为科学推理学习紧凑的图表
articles.content_zh: 专业工程领域的科学推理取决于分散在各种文献中的知识,这些知识往往是专有的,没有前沿LLM培训数据. 在此类领域,前沿模型往往给出一般答案。 知识图能为LLM推理打下基础. 因为一个图表太大,无法完整提供,典型的LLM+KG系统预先选择一部分,在推理开始前决定相关性. 在这里,我们训练一个紧凑的模型, 探险家, 通过一步一步的翻转它来解释一个域域知识图, 根据它已经发现的东西寻找证据。 探矿者称一套小工具,一次一个地逐步建立其上下文,用一连串证据解答,这些证据可以比照其工具从图中取来的东西逐边检查. 在由半导体-制造文献所构建的知识图上,Prospector通过同样的图和工具,接近了最强的现成模型,它远远超过了现成模型回答闭页或预选部分的图. 虽然只接受了半导体图方面的培训,但探矿者将从其他三个不同领域向看不见的知识图转移:生物启发材料、活性与多氟烷基物质(PFAS)和材料特性。 服务于单一的GPU上,Prospector以一个主机服务成本的一分之一,更快地回答,同时保留所有者硬件的专有数据. 我们发现政策的潜在状态表明它下一步在可见和看不见的图表上的行动,而修改潜在状态可以引导政策从一种行为模式到另一种行为模式。 这些结果表明,科学和工程推理的实用LLM + KG范式比起私人数据,在这种范式中,一个经过出版文献图表培训的紧凑模型将其转录到隐形图表中,这些图表留在其所有者身上。

articles.title: Self-Regularized Flow Language Models
articles.content: We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself. While continuous flow-based language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, their training objectives typically rely on supervision from clean target tokens, leaving the denoising trajectory underexploited as a learning signal. SERF addresses this limitation through noisy-to-clean self-distillation: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher receives a cleaner version of the student's noisy input along the same interpolation path and provides additional supervision. We investigate two variants: SERF-L, which aligns the student's intermediate representations with deeper teacher representations, and SERF-P, which aligns their output token distributions, either at the student's output or at an early student layer. All variants augment the standard training objective without requiring external pretrained models or modifying the inference procedure. Experiments across three continuous language-model paradigms (one-hot FLM, latent ELF, and hyper-spherical S-FLM) demonstrate substantial improvements in training efficiency, generation quality, and few-step generation. In particular, SERF achieves up to 7.7x wall-clock training acceleration on OpenWebText, improves MAUVE by 24.3% and GSM8K accuracy by up to 28.8%, and matches baseline performance with up to 64x fewer sampling steps. These results establish noisy-to-clean self-distillation as an effective approach to improving continuous diffusion language models.

articles.title_zh: 自规范的流程语言模型
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了SERF(自律流语言模型),这是一个简单的自我监督的框架,通过利用去诺化的轨迹本身来改进持续的传播语言模型. 虽然基于持续流动的语言模式为自动递减生成提供了有希望的替代办法,但其培训目标通常依赖于对清洁目标标志的监督,使去诺能的轨迹得不到充分利用,成为学习信号。 SERF通过高音至清音自沉解决了这一限制:一个指数化的移动平均(EMA)教师在同样的插入路径上得到学生高音输入的更清洁版本,并提供额外的监督. 我们调查了两个变体:SERF-L(将学生的中间代表与更深层次的教师代表相协调)和SERF-P(将学生的输出或早期学生的输出分配相协调). 所有变体都强化了标准培训目标,而不需要外部预先训练的模型或修改推论程序. 跨越三个连续语言模式范式(一热FLM、潜伏的ELF和超球形的S-FLM)的实验表明,培训效率、生成质量和几步生成都有很大提高。 特别是,SERF在OpenWebText上实现了高达7.7x相壁时速的训练加速,将MAUVE提高了24.3%,GSM8K的精度提高了28.8%,并将基线性能与最多64x更少的采样步骤相匹配. 这些结果确立了吵闹到清洁的自我消化,作为改进持续传播语言模型的有效方法.

articles.title: Text Generation in Low-Resource Languages Using Human-Curated Vocabularies
articles.content: Synthetic text generation offers a promising approach to alleviating data scarcity in low-resource languages. However, its effectiveness is inherently limited for languages that are scarcely represented, or entirely absent, in an LLM's pretraining data. At the same time, many such languages have human-curated vocabularies that provide rich lexical and semantic information, often accompanied by grammatical information such as part-of-speech labels. In this work, we ask whether LLMs can leverage these resources to generate coherent text in extremely low-resource and unseen languages. We introduce a framework that combines human-curated vocabularies with a small number of human-written exemplars that provide syntactic signals, while sampling candidate words according to a Zipfian distribution. Across languages with varying levels of resource availability, we evaluate the generated text using lexical diversity, off-target ratio, and human judgments of fluency. Our results show that reasoning-enabled LLMs can generate fluent text even in extremely low-resource languages, with particularly strong results at the sentence level and promising performance at the paragraph level. Our findings highlight a practical pathway for bootstrapping synthetic data in low-resource languages, expanding the amount of usable text even when existing digital resources are extremely limited. Our source code is available at https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text.
