articles.title_zh: 使用人语词汇生成低资源语言的文本
articles.content_zh: 合成文本生成为缓解低资源语言的数据稀缺提供了一个很有希望的方法。 然而,对于在LLM预训数据中几乎没有代表或完全没有代表的语言来说,其有效性本来就是有限的. 同时,许多此类语言都有人语化词汇,提供丰富的词汇和语义信息,并经常伴有语法信息,如部分语法标签等. 在这项工作中,我们询问法学硕士是否能够利用这些资源,以极其低的资源和看不见的语言生成一致的文本。 我们引入了一个框架,将人语精准词汇与少量提供综合信号的人类写作实例结合起来,同时根据Zipfian的分布来取样候选词. 在资源提供水平不同的语文中,我们利用词汇多样性、非目标比率以及人对流利性的判断来评价生成的文本。 我们的结果表明,推理驱动的LLMS即使使用极低的资源语言也能产生流利的文字,在句子层面特别有强效的结果,在段落层面有希望的表现. 我们的研究结果突出表明,即使现有数字资源极为有限,也要以低资源语言提供合成数据,扩大可用文本的数量。 我们的源代码见https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text。

articles.title: Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient
articles.content: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. Furthermore,when the parameter count of the original methods is compressed by approximately an order of magnitude, our method can still maintain competitive task performance and even surpass the corresponding baselines in average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: 参数效率的分级低度调整
articles.content_zh: 参数高效微调(PEFT)方法通过引入少量可受训练参数来适应大型模型. 然而,我们发现这些参数仍然含有冗余性,可以在保持强任务性能的同时被进一步压缩. 为此,我们提出了一种新的分级低级再平衡方法. 其核心理念是将PEFT方法的可训练参数重组为大约平方矩阵,再通过低等分解来表达,可递归应用. 这形成了多层次结构,因子按级别压缩,大大减少了可受训练参数的数量. 在我们的实验中,我们把这种再参数化与LORA,DORA,MOSA,以及RASA结合起来. 我们评价LLaMA-31-8B和Quen2.5-7B的常识推理,同时对LLaMA-31-8B进行额外的GSM8K数学推理实验. 根据可比的可训练参数预算,我们的方法与LORA或DORA相结合,取得了更好的业绩。 此外,当原始方法的参数数被压缩大约一个数量级时,我们的方法仍然能够保持具有竞争力的任务性能,甚至能够在8个常识推理基准的平均准确性上超过相应的基线。

articles.title: EnergyCal: Taming Loss Spikes in Muon-Family Optimizers for Sparse MoE Training
articles.content: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.

articles.title_zh: EnergyCal:在Muon-Family优化器中进行Sparse MoE培训的打压损失
articles.content_zh: Sparse混合型专家语言模型培训可以与Muon-family优化器出现巨大损失。 我们引入了EnergyCal,一个轻量级规则,它减轻了路由专家的更新,按照它们有限的步骤牛顿-舒尔茨方向的正方形Frobenius规范. 能源 Cal使光谱变换不变,没有添加持久的优化态. 我们用4B参数模型来评估 EnergyCal-MuonH针对一种发展选择的、学习率较低的MuonH配方,将平均阈值损失-spike负担减少99.51%,将最终几何-平均不确定性减少4.06%,同时降低吞吐量成本。 Plain Muon按相应的名义学习率和体重衰减,两个接受测试的参与者平均平均减少95.98%,同时有小的终点改进。 这些调查结果有助于在评价环境中无论有无超球都实现稳定。

articles.title: Exploring the Limits of the Delta Learning Hypothesis: Single-Pair Generator Biases in Direct Preference Optimization
articles.content: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) typically relies on preference pairs generated from diverse model pools and ranked by an external LLM judge. The recently proposed delta-learning hypothesis suggests that comparable supervision can instead be obtained from a single pair of models by treating the larger model's response as preferred. We investigate the limits of this approach across model families and scales. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that fixed model pairs introduce systematic, generator-dependent biases that are predictive of the preference label independent of response quality. Consequently, DPO trained on single-pair data consistently underperforms multi-model preference data, despite the larger generator producing higher-quality responses, and we trace this gap to training dynamics consistent with reward hacking on these biases. We further show that simply increasing the number of generators, even without an external judge, is enough to partially mitigate this effect. Our results highlight generator diversity as a critical factor in preference-data construction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 探索三角洲学习假设的界限: 直接偏好优化中的单对等发电机比ase
articles.content_zh: 直接偏好优化(DPO)一般依靠由多样模型集合产生的偏好配对,由外部LLM评委排名. 最近提出的三角学习假说表明,可以通过将更大的模型的反应作为首选,从一对模型中获取可比较的监督。 我们调查这一方法在模范家庭和规模中的局限性。 我们从理论上和经验上都表明,固定模型对子引入了系统化的、依赖生成器的偏差,这些偏好标签的预测独立于反应质量。 因此,DPO接受关于单页数据的培训,尽管较大的生成器能产生更高质量的响应,但多模式偏好数据的业绩始终不佳,我们追踪这一差距,使之与对这些偏见的奖励性黑客化相适应。 我们进一步表明,仅仅增加发电机数量,即使没有外部法官,也足以部分减轻这种影响。 我们的成果突出表明,发电机的多样性是优先数据构建的一个关键因素。

articles.title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.

articles.title_zh: Guided-RLVR:以可核实的奖励进行强化学习的被引导探索
articles.content_zh: 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)在提高大语言模型(LLMS)在数学和编程等任务的推理能力方面显示出了强大的实证成果. 然而,最近的研究表明,RLVR的推出经常会倒塌到狭义的推理轨迹上,限制了所探索的推理空间. 由于发现关键步骤的思维象征是LLM推理路径中的关键结构要素,我们提出Guided-RLVR,这是一种用轻量级控制器来增强RLVR的新办法。 控制器在战略上为采样分布注入了精密有意义的指针,鼓励该模型从多种推理角度处理问题,从而扩大探索空间. 关于数学推理和代码生成基准的实验表明,Guided-RLVR一贯优于现有的RLVR方法,同时产生更多样化的推理轨迹.

articles.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
articles.content: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.

articles.title_zh: 无缩放 缩放 v2: 从查看细节到通用多模式感知的连接证据
articles.content_zh: 多式联运概念构成了多式联运智能的基础。 特别是,空间感知和多式联运长文理解是体现AI和多式联运代理人的两个关键任务。 然而,为这些任务综合目标明确、高质量的培训数据仍然是困难和昂贵的。 我们的关键洞察力是,这些任务具有一种基本的能力,我们称之为连接证据:确定相关的视觉事实,将它们与正确的实体联系在一起,恢复它们的关系,把它们编成一个答案。 关键是,为这种能力而综合有针对性的培训数据比这些任务本身容易得多。 为了加强这种能力,我们提议采用证据连接(VidenceConnect)这一易于执行的数据综合框架,利用在单一图像中放大的有关区域的观点来产生需要比较、汇总或连锁视觉证据的问题。 为了确保质量,只有在独立的自愿活动清单达成一致时,才保留参考答复,而区域比对测试则放弃了在选定区域被清除后仍能回答的问题。 然后,我们用RLVR对生成的数据进行基础VLM进行训练,在不使用ZwZ2(ZwZ2)的情况下获得Zoming. 虽然综合数据不适应任何下游基准,但ZwZ2改进了精细和空间感知,在体现的空间推理、多式长文理解、多式代理任务和一般视觉推理方面有了进一步的收益。 这些结果将证据连接确立为监督证据联系的有效框架,并表明加强这种共同能力会导致更普遍的多模式观念。

articles.title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. Because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill, this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen.

articles.title_zh: V-LUMEN:在视觉语言模型中嵌入缩放的视觉搜索记忆
articles.content_zh: 嵌入级的缩放通过基于取景的内存来扩展语言模型的能力,而不是通过增加模型的深度,宽度,或密集的计算来扩展. 将这个想法扩展至视觉语言模型(VLMs)具有挑战性,因为视觉特征是连续的,空间结构化的,并且依赖查询,与自然支持n克取景的离散文本符号不同. 我们介绍V -LUMEN, 一个视觉的查看记忆 VLMs。 V-LUMEN将可视特征用被冷冻的编码本进行盘片化,通过基于空间聚合的散列来构建空间意识内存键,并用文本条件的关联信号来调节;所有地址都是非参数化的,被取回的嵌入通过有门的剩余通道被熔接入骨干. 在五个推理密集型基准上,V-LUMEN大大改进了被冻结的Qune3-VL-2B主干线,并将零射入三个基准,其图像与培训数据脱节。 在相匹配的参数预算中,将LORA或MOE适配器的部分容量移入V-LUMEN上保留了两个主干线上的精度,表明外视内存是一个独立的容量轴而不是更强的适应方法. 因为表大小不变,而且只在预填时发生一次,所以这种容量在存储而不是每盘计算时会增长. 代码见https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen。

articles.title: SpectRAG: Weighted Chunk Graphs for Token-Budgeted Context Selection in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. At query time, SpectRAG builds a high-recall seed set using exact inner-product search and hybrid relevance signals, expands it over the chunk graph, re-scores candidates using graph proximity and spectral information, and assembles the final context under a fixed token budget. The goal is not merely to retrieve individually similar chunks, but to construct a context that is relevant, diverse, structurally connected, and sufficient for grounded reasoning. Experiments on MultiHopRAG, UltraDomain, and long-document question-answering settings show that SpectRAG improves broad evidence recovery and achieves competitive generation quality against dense, hybrid, HyDE, LightRAG, and NaiveRAG baselines. The results further indicate that graph-spectral structure is particularly useful for inference-oriented and cross-document retrieval, while highlighting trade-offs in early precision, computational cost, and domain-dependent performance.

articles.title: The State and Fate of Multilingual, Contextual Evaluation in the NLP World
articles.content: Multilingual evaluation benchmarks are the primary instrument for assessing whether large language models generalize beyond English, yet the adequacy of these benchmarks has received little systematic scrutiny. We present a data-driven audit of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets and 219 languages, organized around three pillars: coverage, representativeness, and rigor. Our analysis reveals that coverage is wide but thin with 36% of evaluated languages appearing in only a single benchmark, entire regions (Oceania, the Americas, Central Asia) are near-zero, and a stark task equity gap leaves low-resource languages evaluated on only 1-3 task categories versus 14 for high-resource languages. Representativeness is structurally compromised: translation from English remains the dominant construction strategy where 56% of all dataset-language instances are translated introducing artifacts and English-centric framing, while culturally grounded content is concentrated in a handful of community-driven benchmarks with narrow language scope. The ecosystem thus forces a trade-off between breadth and validity. Rigor is undermined by benchmark contamination, including translated benchmark leakage and parallel corpus overlap that evade surface-form detection. We synthesize these findings into concrete recommendations for building evaluation frameworks that are natively constructed, culturally grounded, contamination-aware, and designed to serve the communities whose languages they claim to evaluate. The dashboard with all the metadata collected can be found at https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals.

articles.title_zh: NLP世界多语言、背景评价的现状和命运
articles.content_zh: 多语种评价基准是评估大语文模式是否普遍超过英语的主要工具,但这些基准是否充分尚未得到系统的审查。 我们提出对涵盖242个数据集和219个语言的51个最近多语种基准进行的数据驱动审计,围绕三个支柱:覆盖面、代表性和严格度。 整个地区(大洋洲、美洲、中亚)几乎为零, 任务公平差距严重, 低资源语言在1-3任务类别上被评价, 而高资源语言则只有14个。 代表性在结构上受到影响:英文翻译仍然是主要的构建战略,其中56%的数据集语言实例被翻译引进了文物和以英语为中心的框架,而基于文化的内容则集中在少数由社区驱动、语言范围狭窄的基准上。 因此,生态系统迫使在宽度和有效性之间取舍。 由于基准污染,包括翻译基准泄漏和避免地表形态检测的平行实体重叠,使严格度受损。 我们将这些结论综合为具体建议,以建立以本土建设、基于文化、了解污染情况并旨在为其声称评价其语言的社区服务的评价框架。 收集的所有元数据的仪表板可在https://aka.ms/multi-evals上找到。

articles.title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. We evaluate five LLM agents against a rule-based inventory-control baseline and diagnose their site coordination, execution, and performance over time. Four of five evaluated LLM agents fall short of this baseline, and returns per dollar of inference cost rank models differently from returns alone. Operational analyses show that gains in individual metrics do not consistently yield stronger economic growth, as inventory and execution costs erode these gains. Trajectory analysis further reveals difficulties in grounding feasible actions, managing inventory commitments, and converting feedback into effective policy revisions.

articles.title_zh: AutoVend: LLM 代理器在长视自動放送操作上的基准化
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)代理商正在将网上代理中介的商业从为消费者购物扩展到为销售商经营企业. 在在线到离线(O2O)商业中,决定通过网络平台发布,但通过昂贵的实物执行实现. 评估这些代理商需要超越单个交易,询问网上作出的决定是否转化为持续经济收益。 我们引入了AutoVend,一个LLM代理管理20台自动售货机的基准,通过一个基于网络的操作界面,共管理了5个站点类型的自动售货机180个模拟日. 其以数据为基础的模拟器结合了共用仓库、采购周转时间、已付补资、库存到期和经常性业务费用。 我们根据基于规则的库存控制基准评估5名LLM代理商,并分析其现场协调、执行和业绩。 5个经评估的LLM代理商中有4个没有达到这一基线,推算成本的每美元回报率模型与单回报率不同. 业务分析表明,单项衡量标准的收益不能持续地带来更强劲的经济增长,因为库存和执行成本会侵蚀这些收益。 轨迹分析进一步揭示了在确定可行行动的基础、管理清单承诺和将反馈转化为有效的政策修订方面的困难。

articles.title: Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions
articles.content: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.

articles.title_zh: 十三世纪采矿:登记册规模强迫调整和通过遗产版和古代版开发HTR
articles.content_zh: 手写文字识别(HTR)用于教宗荣誉三世的注册,取决于现代专家的抄录,这些抄录只存在于Reg. Vat的正统年份1-2. 9. 对于其余的登记册,19世纪的奖学金提供Pressutti的regesta和部分版本。 在1-203分上,如果两层都存在,我们衡量这个遗留层能起到什么作用,我们首先对它进行审核,并找出分出三个层次的劳动分工。 在正文层次上,原始版本充其量是中立的,可以使识别器适应第二个正文年份,而且有害而不重放,而投射到带有现代源行重放的曲式拼写上则使其变为零标签的适应目标:在所有134年到2年的平面上集合,WER下降1.50分(95% CI -1.84至-1.15分),将差距的33%缩小为甲骨文;当年的拼写变化通过文人或转写方式分出,而手只以活字191r的速度明显地改变。 在词典层面,全体遗留的词典包含有未经编辑的条目和旗帜识别错误的82.2%,精度为66.7%,以及来自经过预先培训的中世纪NER模型的标签,分馏入识别器的NER头,在专家验证的基准上达到F1 82.1%,在识别后应用了最好的标记器. 在地貌层面,Pressutti的Regests,收尾基准条款,以及Regests转换为atterial's Roman形式的日期,发现73.9%的入段开始于公认的行流,版协议估计排减量为7.80%出自fol. 203. 因此,古老的奖学金不能取代现代的抄录,但可以指导、检查和分解未登记登记册。

articles.title: Self-Keyed In-Parameter Memorization for External Memory-Free Dialogue Recall in Frozen Language Models
articles.content: A large language model maintains conversational content in an external storage that is outside the model and grows as the dialogue continues. This work assumes an environment where a language model has no external memory and no prior knowledge of the future question or its answer. The motivation is to research whether a dialogue can be stored in the model parameters and later answer a question about it. This work proposes self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM), a closed-form method in which the model generates its own questions about each dialogue turn and writes those questions into its parameters as the keys that later retrieve the turn's content. Generating many varied questions for each turn allows a later user question to match one even when phrased differently, and its answer is recalled from the parameters alone. Evaluated on five language models, SKIM recalls most stored dialogue turns from later user questions, and it answers from the model parameters without any external storage.

articles.title_zh: 冷冻语言模型中自凯德·因-帕雷米特纪念外部记忆-自由对话
articles.content_zh: 一个大型语言模型在模型外的外置存储器中保持对话内容,随着对话的继续而增长. 这部作品假设一个语言模型没有外部记忆,也没有对未来问题或答案的事先了解的环境. 其动机是研究一个对话是否能够被存储在模型参数中,并随后回答一个有关它的问题. 这部作品提出了自键式的参数内计量法(SKIM),这是一种闭合式方法,模型在这种方法中会生成自己对每个对话框的疑问,并将这些问题转换成其参数来作为后来取回转动内容的键. 为每个转弯生成许多不同的问题,即使措辞不同,也允许后期的用户问题匹配一个,其答案仅从参数中回忆. 在评价了五个语言模型后,SKIM回顾了大多数被存储的对话框从后来的用户提问中转出,它从模型参数中解答而没有任何外部存储.
